Sleep experts have found: people who sleep early generally fall asleep earlier than people who sleep late.

People who sleep late fall asleep later.

As for 'I'm exhausted but I keep scrolling instead of sleeping,' researchers call this revenge bedtime procrastination — meaning you're getting revenge on the person who left you no free time, and that person is you.
en.editorNote: Send at 1am to a friend who's still online, reminding you both you should be asleep and neither of you is
variations: People who get enough sleep are usually more energetic the next day. People who don't power through on coffee.
You said you'd sleep after five more minutes. Verifying that statement requires two more hours of scrolling.

items.sourceNote: 套套邏輯廢話文學新創，參考經典格式

zh-tw.content:
俗話說得好：俗話說得好。

至於是哪句俗話，研究指出，只要它流傳得夠久，就會被稱為俗話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在群組裡有人引用名言時接話，瞬間讓對話原地打轉
variations: 古人說的話，通常都是古人說的。這一點目前還沒有反例。

en.content:
As the old saying goes: the old saying goes.

Which saying exactly? Research indicates that as long as it's been around long enough, it qualifies as old.
en.editorNote: Use this right after someone drops a quote in a group chat — it sends the conversation spinning in place
variations: Things wise people said were, in fact, said by wise people. No counterexamples have been found.

items.sourceNote: 聽君一席話經典變體，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
聽你講了一個小時，我感覺就像聽了一個小時。

資訊量這種東西，有就是有，沒有也看不出來少了什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合朋友長篇大論講完之後，假裝很有收穫地回他
variations: 你這番話讓我恍然大悟，原來我剛剛什麼都沒聽懂。

en.content:
I listened to you talk for an hour, and it felt exactly like listening for an hour.

As for information content — when it's there it's there, and when it's not, you can't tell anything's missing.
en.editorNote: Use after a friend finishes a long-winded explanation, while pretending you got a lot out of it
variations: Your speech was a real eye-opener — it opened my eyes to the fact that I understood none of it.

items.sourceNote: technically true 風格廢話，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
惡夢算是夢嗎？

還是說，那是一部你自己編劇、自己導演、自己主演的免費恐怖片？

專家表示：兩種說法目前都成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合早上傳給昨晚說自己做惡夢的朋友，順便嚇他一下
variations: 你睡覺時閉著眼睛，是為了看夢；醒著時睜開眼睛，是為了看帳單。

en.content:
Are nightmares dreams?

Or are they free horror movies that you write, direct, and star in?

Experts confirm: both descriptions currently hold.
en.editorNote: Send in the morning to a friend who mentioned a bad dream — bonus points for the mild dread
variations: You close your eyes when you sleep to watch dreams, and open them when you wake to watch your bills.

items.sourceNote: 身體哲學 technically true 風格新創

zh-tw.content:
你的身體裡有一副骨頭嗎？

還是說，是你（也就是你的大腦）住在一副骨頭裡面？

這個問題科學家想了很久，結論是：以上皆是。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜睡不著時傳到群組，讓大家一起睡不著
variations: 你不是在用手機，是手機在用你的兩根大拇指。差別只在誰先放下誰。

en.content:
Do you have a skeleton inside you?

Or are you — meaning your brain — living inside a skeleton?

Scientists have pondered this at length and concluded: all of the above.
en.editorNote: Drop this in a group chat at midnight so nobody else can fall asleep either
variations: You're not using your phone — your phone is using your two thumbs. The only question is who puts the other down first.

items.sourceNote: 時間流逝廢話文學經典變體，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
好消息是，過完了五月就到六月了。

壞消息是，過完了六月就到七月了。

日曆專家提醒：這個流程目前沒有暫停鍵。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合月初傳到工作群組，提醒大家又要過一個月了
variations: 週一過完就是週二，週二過完就是週三，至於週末，它過完之後就又是週一了。

en.content:
Good news: once May is over, it'll be June.

Bad news: once June is over, it'll be July.

Calendar experts note that this process currently has no pause button.
en.editorNote: Send to the work group chat at the start of a month, reminding everyone another one's begun
variations: After Monday comes Tuesday, after Tuesday comes Wednesday, and as for the weekend — once it's over, it's Monday again.

items.sourceNote: 「我知道你很急，但你先別急」廢話文學經典變體，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我知道你現在很忙，但你可以先不要忙。

等你不忙的時候，自然就有空了。

心理學家表示，這個說法雖然沒有幫到你，但確實沒有錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給整天喊忙的同事或朋友，看他氣到沒空回你
variations: 我知道你很累，但你累的時候休息一下，就會比較不累。

en.content:
I know you're really busy right now, but you could just not be busy.

Whenever you stop being busy, you'll naturally have free time.

Psychologists confirm this advice doesn't help you, but it isn't wrong either.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's always complaining they're swamped, then watch them get too annoyed to reply
variations: I know you're tired, but if you rest when you're tired, you'll end up less tired.

items.sourceNote: 「you can drink cement, but only once」technically true 風格，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
任何東西你都可以嘗試吃一次。

至於能不能吃第二次，那要看你第一次吃完還在不在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那種什麼都想嘗鮮、看到新口味就要試的朋友
variations: 每件危險的事你都做得到，只是有些事你只做得到一次。

en.content:
You can try eating absolutely anything once.

Whether you get a second try depends entirely on whether you're still around after the first.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who has to taste every new flavor and tries everything at least once
variations: You're capable of doing any dangerous thing — it's just that some of them you can only do one time.

items.sourceNote: 雞是恐龍的 technically true 觀察，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
科學家說，雞其實是一種恐龍。

所以你今天午餐吃的，嚴格來說，是一隻體型縮水、運氣也縮水的恐龍。

這個事實對雞來說沒有任何好處。
zh-tw.editorNote: 吃炸雞的時候傳到群組，讓大家邊吃邊陷入沉思
variations: 鯨魚是哺乳類，所以海裡最大的動物，技術上跟你一樣都得換氣。

en.content:
Scientists say a chicken is, in fact, a kind of dinosaur.

So what you had for lunch was, strictly speaking, a dinosaur that shrank in both size and luck.

This fact does the chicken no favors whatsoever.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat while everyone's eating fried chicken so they chew and contemplate at the same time
variations: A whale is a mammal, so the biggest animal in the ocean technically has to come up for air, just like you.

items.sourceNote: 「我第一次去美國驚呆了，那麼多美國人」廢話文學風格，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我第一次去海邊的時候嚇了一跳，

那裡居然有那麼多的海水。

而且每一滴，據說都是濕的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 出去玩打卡時配這段文案，朋友會懷疑你是不是中暑了
variations: 我第一次去夜市才發現，原來夜市裡賣的東西，幾乎全部都是可以買的。

en.content:
The first time I went to the beach, I was stunned —

there was an unbelievable amount of seawater there.

And every single drop of it, I'm told, was wet.
en.editorNote: Pair this with a vacation photo and your friends will wonder if you got heatstroke
variations: First time I went to a night market, I realized nearly everything they sell there is, in fact, available for purchase.

items.sourceNote: 「情況就是這麼個情況，具體什麼情況還得看情況」廢話文學經典，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
問題就是這個問題，至於是什麼問題，

要等我們搞清楚問題之後才知道是什麼問題。

在那之前，問題還是個問題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開會被問「現在到底什麼狀況」時，可以照念，氣氛保證凝結
variations: 計畫是有的，至於計畫是什麼，等計畫出來你就知道了。

en.content:
The problem is the problem. As for what the problem actually is,

we'll only know what the problem is once we've figured out the problem.

Until then, the problem remains a problem.
en.editorNote: Recite this verbatim in a meeting when someone asks what the situation is — the room will freeze
variations: There is a plan. As for what the plan is, you'll find out once the plan is out.

items.sourceNote: 「人們說沒有事情是不可能的，但我每天都在無所事事」廢話文學風格，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
大家都說「天下無難事」，

可是我每天都在做沒有事做的事。

所以嚴格來說，我也算是把事情做完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被長輩問「最近在忙什麼」時的最佳回覆，既誠實又無懈可擊
variations: 別人說「只要肯努力就會成功」，而我每天都很努力地什麼都不做。

en.content:
Everyone says nothing is impossible,

yet I manage to do nothing every single day.

So technically, I've already accomplished the impossible.
en.editorNote: The ideal reply when a relative asks what you've been up to — honest and airtight
variations: They say success comes to those who try, and I try very hard to do absolutely nothing.

items.sourceNote: 「閉上眼睛就看不見」廢話文學風格，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我發現一件很神奇的事——

只要我一閉上眼睛，眼前的世界就會變成一片漆黑。

而且只要再睜開，它又回來了，從不缺席。
zh-tw.editorNote: 很適合在朋友炫耀什麼冷知識時，用更冷的回他
variations: 我研究很久才確定，原來人只要把耳朵摀起來，聽到的聲音就會變小。

en.content:
I discovered something remarkable —

the moment I close my eyes, the world in front of me goes completely dark.

And the moment I open them again, it returns, never once failing to show up.
en.editorNote: Great for out-cooling a friend who's bragging about some random fun fact
variations: After much research I can confirm: covering your ears makes the sounds you hear noticeably quieter.

items.sourceNote: 「世界上有三種人：會數數的和不會數數的」廢話文學風格，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
這世界上只有兩種人：

一種是看得懂這句話的人，

另一種，是看完還在等第三種的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 丟在群組裡，會有人認真往下滑找第三種，屢試不爽
variations: 人可以分成兩類：分得出自己是哪一類的，和正在懷疑自己是不是兩類都算的。

en.content:
There are only two kinds of people in this world:

those who understand this sentence,

and those still scrolling down, waiting for the third kind.
en.editorNote: Post it in a group chat and watch someone scroll, genuinely looking for the third kind
variations: People fall into two categories: those who can tell which category they're in, and those wondering if they count as both.

items.sourceNote: 「據我所知，我一無所知」廢話文學經典，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
就我所掌握的資訊來看，

我目前掌握的資訊非常有限。

至於有多有限，這我也不太清楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開會被問到不熟的議題時，照念一遍，沒人能挑出毛病
variations: 根據我多年的觀察，我觀察到的事情其實沒幾件。

en.content:
Based on everything I currently know,

what I currently know is extremely limited.

Exactly how limited, I'm afraid I'm not sure.
en.editorNote: Recite this when a meeting lands on a topic you know nothing about — nobody can argue with it
variations: After years of careful observation, I've observed that I've observed very little.

items.sourceNote: 「灰姑娘的鞋如果合腳，為什麼會掉」廢話文學風格，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
如果那雙鞋真的那麼合腳，

那它為什麼會在半路上掉下來？

所以結論是：合腳的鞋，有時候也沒那麼合腳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友講一個聽起來很有道理、其實毫無道理的話時接這句
variations: 如果雨傘真的能擋雨，那為什麼下大雨的時候我的鞋還是濕的？這值得深思。

en.content:
If that shoe really fit so perfectly,

then why did it slip off halfway home?

Conclusion: a perfectly fitting shoe sometimes doesn't fit perfectly after all.
en.editorNote: Perfect comeback when a friend says something that sounds logical but completely isn't
variations: If umbrellas really keep out the rain, why are my shoes still wet in a downpour? Something to ponder.

items.sourceNote: 「我知道你很急，但你先別急」廢話文學經典，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我知道你現在很急，

但這件事急也沒用，所以你先別急。

等到可以急的時候，我再通知你急。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友在群組裡狂催進度時，丟這句保證讓對方更急
variations: 你先冷靜一下，等冷靜完了我們再來討論為什麼你需要冷靜。

en.content:
I know you're in a hurry right now,

but hurrying won't help, so please don't hurry.

When it's actually time to hurry, I'll let you know to hurry.
en.editorNote: Drop this when someone is frantically chasing you for an update — guaranteed to make them more frantic
variations: Calm down first, and once you've calmed down we can discuss why you needed to calm down.

items.sourceNote: 「如果不成功，就有失敗的風險」套套邏輯名言，廢話文學風格重新創作

zh-tw.content:
專家提醒：如果這次沒有成功，

那麼這次就有很高的機率失敗。

所以只要不失敗，基本上就算成功了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合當作報告結尾的「總結」，聽起來很有道理但其實什麼都沒講
variations: 只要不放棄，你就還沒放棄。這是堅持下去最關鍵的一步。

en.content:
Experts warn: if this attempt does not succeed,

then there is a very high chance it will fail.

So as long as you don't fail, you've basically succeeded.
en.editorNote: Use it to wrap up a presentation — sounds like a solid conclusion while saying nothing at all
variations: As long as you don't give up, you haven't given up. That's the most crucial step to keeping going.

items.sourceNote: Yogi Berra「總是在你最後找的地方找到」廢話文學風格重新創作

zh-tw.content:
東西永遠都是在你最後找的那個地方找到的。

因為找到之後，你就不會再繼續找了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 幫人找東西找到的時候講這句，對方會愣三秒
variations: 你錢包最後一定會出現在某個地方，而那個地方就是它出現的地方。

en.content:
You always find it in the last place you look.

Because once you've found it, you stop looking.
en.editorNote: Say this right after helping someone find their keys — watch them freeze for three seconds
variations: Your wallet will eventually turn up somewhere, and that somewhere is exactly where it turns up.

items.sourceNote: 「我第一次去美國，沒見過那麼多美國人」廢話文學經典，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我第一次去日本的時候真的被震撼到，

我從來沒有在一個國家裡，看過那麼多日本人。

滿街都是，一個比一個還日本。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友分享出國旅遊照片時，認真地回這句，效果拔群
variations: 我去了一趟海邊，發現那裡的海水竟然全部都是海水，一滴都不馬虎。

en.content:
My first trip to Japan completely blew my mind.

I had never seen so many Japanese people in a single country before.

They were everywhere — each one more Japanese than the last.
en.editorNote: Reply with this, totally straight-faced, when a friend posts their vacation photos
variations: I went to the beach and discovered the water there was entirely made of seawater — not a single drop off-brand.

items.sourceNote: 「據我所知，我一無所知」蘇格拉底式廢話重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
就我所知道的範圍來說，

我知道的範圍裡，

剛好就是我所知道的那些。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被問到不懂的問題時拿來打太極，對方通常會放棄追問
variations: 我能告訴你的，就是我能告訴你的那些，剩下的我就不能告訴你了。

en.content:
As far as my knowledge goes,

the things I know

are precisely the things that I happen to know.
en.editorNote: Deploy this when someone asks you a question you can't answer — they usually stop asking
variations: Everything I can tell you is everything I can tell you. The rest, I cannot tell you.

items.sourceNote: 「如果不成功，我們就有失敗的風險」循環論證式廢話重新創作

zh-tw.content:
這次如果我們沒有成功，

那我們就有很大的機率，

會面臨沒有成功的局面。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合拿來模仿主管的開會總結，假裝很有深度其實什麼都沒講
variations: 只要我們不放棄，我們就還沒有放棄。

en.content:
If we don't succeed this time,

then there's a very high chance

that we'll be facing a situation where we did not succeed.
en.editorNote: Perfect for impersonating a manager wrapping up a meeting — sounds insightful, says nothing
variations: As long as we don't give up, we technically haven't given up yet.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學經典邏輯循環句改寫

zh-tw.content:
據我所知，我什麼都不知道。

而我之所以知道我什麼都不知道，

是因為我知道了這件事。

所以嚴格來說，我至少知道一件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開會被問到不會的問題時，可以在心裡默念，外表保持鎮定
variations: 我懂的東西不多，而我懂的不多這件事，我倒是懂得很清楚。
說我不懂的人，其實也不懂我到底懂不懂。

en.content:
As far as I know, I know nothing.

And the only reason I know I know nothing

is because I know that one thing.

So technically, I do know at least one thing.
en.editorNote: Repeat this internally when you're asked a question in a meeting you have no answer to — stay calm on the outside
variations: I don't know much, but the fact that I don't know much, I know very well.
People who say I don't get it don't actually know whether I get it or not.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「抛開內容不談」句式改寫

zh-tw.content:
撇開內容不談，

你講的其實還蠻有道理的。

畢竟內容才是重點，

而我們現在不談內容。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聽完一段完全聽不懂的簡報，需要回應又不想得罪人的時候
variations: 不考慮對錯的話，你說的完全正確。
如果不看結果，這個方案其實非常成功。

en.content:
Setting aside the content,

what you said actually makes a lot of sense.

Of course, the content is the whole point,

and right now we're not talking about the content.
en.editorNote: For when you just sat through a presentation you didn't understand and need to say something without offending anyone
variations: If we ignore whether it's right or wrong, you're completely correct.
If we don't look at the results, this plan was a huge success.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「明天的事後天就知道」句式改寫

zh-tw.content:
關於明天會發生什麼事，

你後天就會知道了。

如果後天還不知道，

那就再等一天。

總之到最後你一定會知道，只是時間問題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友焦慮地問你明天結果會怎樣的時候，這句話保證讓他更焦慮
variations: 未來的事現在都還沒發生，所以現在擔心也是白擔心。
結果出來之前你不會知道結果，結果出來之後你就不用問了。

en.content:
As for what happens tomorrow,

you'll find out the day after.

And if you still don't know by then,

just wait one more day.

Either way you'll definitely find out — it's only a matter of time.
en.editorNote: When a friend anxiously asks how tomorrow will turn out, this is guaranteed to make them more anxious
variations: Future things haven't happened yet, so worrying about them now is wasted worry.
You won't know the result before it's out, and once it's out you don't need to ask.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「沒對象應該還是單身」句式改寫

zh-tw.content:
據觀察，沒有對象的人，

目前應該還是單身。

而一旦脫單，

他就不再是沒有對象的人了。

這個規律，至今沒有出現過例外。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被長輩問「怎麼還沒對象」的時候，用這句回敬，氣氛保證很微妙
variations: 想脫單的第一步，就是先有一個對象。
單身的人之所以單身，是因為他現在沒有在交往。

en.content:
Studies show that people without a partner

are, at present, most likely single.

And the moment they get into a relationship,

they are no longer a person without a partner.

This rule has, to this day, never had an exception.
en.editorNote: Fire this back when a relative asks why you're still single — the vibe is guaranteed to get awkward
variations: The first step to not being single is to first have a partner.
Single people are single because they're currently not dating anyone.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「俗話說」句式重新創作

zh-tw.content:
俗話說得好，

而俗話之所以說得好，

是因為它要是說得不好，

就不會變成俗話。

所以你聽到的俗話，全部都說得很好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想引用一句名言但又懶得想內容時，可以先用這句墊場
variations: 古人的智慧之所以流傳到今天，是因為沒流傳下來的我們都沒看到。
經典之所以是經典，是因為它已經被叫做經典很久了。

en.content:
As the old saying goes,

and the reason the old saying goes so well

is that if it didn't go well,

it would never have become an old saying.

So every old saying you've heard goes great.
en.editorNote: Use this as filler when you want to quote some wisdom but can't be bothered to think of any
variations: Ancient wisdom survived to today because the wisdom that didn't survive, we never got to see.
A classic is a classic because it has been called a classic for a long time.

items.sourceNote: 密碼安全 shower thought 改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
網站要求你設一個越來越複雜的密碼，

複雜到連你自己都記不住。

等到你終於忘記密碼，

他就請你重設一個新的複雜密碼。

如此一來，你的帳號就非常安全，安全到連你都進不去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 每次卡在登入頁面重設密碼時，傳給同樣崩潰的朋友剛剛好
variations: 密碼設得越難記，代表你越常需要按「忘記密碼」。
最安全的帳號，就是連本人都登入不了的那一個。

en.content:
Websites make you set an ever more complicated password,

so complicated that even you can't remember it.

Then, once you finally forget it,

they kindly ask you to reset a brand new complicated password.

This way your account is extremely secure — so secure that even you can't get in.
en.editorNote: Perfect to send a fellow sufferer while you're both stuck on the reset-password page
variations: The harder your password is to remember, the more often you'll hit 'forgot password.'
The most secure account is the one even its owner can't log into.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「七日不見如隔一周」句式重新創作

zh-tw.content:
三天沒見，差不多就是隔了七十二小時。

而七十二小時，換算下來，剛好是三天。

所以我們已經三天沒見了，這件事我算了好幾遍，每次都一樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給很久沒聯絡的朋友，假裝很想念但其實什麼也沒說
variations: 一個禮拜沒見，換句話說，就是七天都沒碰到面。
我們上次見面是上次，這次見面是這次，中間隔的就是上次到這次。

en.content:
We haven't seen each other in three days,

which works out to roughly seventy-two hours.

And seventy-two hours, when you do the math,

comes out to exactly three days.

So it's been three days — I checked several times, and it's the same every time.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend you haven't talked to in ages, pretending to miss them while saying nothing at all
variations: Not seeing you for a week means, in other words, seven whole days of not running into you.
Last time we met was last time, this time is this time, and the gap in between is from last time to this time.

items.sourceNote: 「待辦清單」觀察改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
你寫了一張待辦清單，

上面列了所有要做的事。

寫清單本身不在清單上，

但你做了。

於是你完成了一件清單上沒有的事，

而清單上有的事，一件都還沒開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 規劃了一整個下午卻什麼都沒做的時候，這句最能精準命中
variations: 整理書桌是為了讀書，結果整理完書桌就累了，書還在原地。
把事情寫下來的那一刻，你就有一種已經做完的錯覺。

en.content:
You made a to-do list

with everything you need to get done.

Making the list wasn't on the list,

but you did it anyway.

So you've completed a task that wasn't on the list,

while every task that is on the list remains untouched.
en.editorNote: Lands perfectly on the day you spent the whole afternoon planning and did nothing
variations: You tidy your desk so you can study, but after tidying you're too tired, and the book hasn't moved.
The moment you write something down, you get the illusion you've already done it.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「據我所知我一無所知」句式重新創作

zh-tw.content:
據我所知，

我所不知道的事，我都不知道。

而我知道的事，

我之所以知道，是因為我已經知道了。

所以我知道的就是我知道的，不知道的就是我不知道的，這點我非常清楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被問到不會的問題時，用這句回答，對方會更困惑
variations: 我對這個領域的了解，僅限於我了解的那部分。
我能回答的問題，都是我會回答的問題。

en.content:
As far as I know,

everything I don't know, I don't know.

And the things I do know,

I know because I already know them.

So what I know is what I know, and what I don't know is what I don't know — on this I'm perfectly clear.
en.editorNote: Answer a question you have no clue about with this, and the asker will only get more confused
variations: My understanding of this field is limited to the part of it that I understand.
The questions I can answer are precisely the questions I'm able to answer.

items.sourceNote: 問答式廢話文學格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
「你今天要去哪裡？」
「去我等一下會到的地方。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友追問你行程又不想講細節時，丟這句保證對方瞬間放棄
variations: 「你晚餐想吃什麼？」「吃我吃下去之後就會飽的東西。」
「你在看什麼？」「看我眼睛現在正對著的那個。」

en.content:
"Where are you headed today?"
"To the place I'll have arrived at later."
en.editorNote: Perfect for when a friend grills you about your plans and you'd rather not explain — they'll give up instantly
variations: "What do you want for dinner?" "Whatever fills me up once I've eaten it."
"What are you watching?" "The thing my eyes are currently pointed at."

items.sourceNote: technically-true 風格參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
理財專家提醒：當你把錢花掉之後，那筆錢就不再是你的了。
目前學界尚未找到例外。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友亂買東西時一本正經地說出來，假裝給了很深的建議
variations: 存款的特性是：你存進去多少，帳戶裡就會多多少。這點科學家已反覆驗證。
錢包變薄通常代表裡面的東西變少了。

en.content:
Financial experts confirm that once you spend your money, that money is no longer yours.
No exception has been documented to date.
en.editorNote: Deliver this with a straight face when a friend is splurging — pretend you just gave priceless advice
variations: A key feature of savings: however much you put in, that's how much more your account holds. Repeatedly verified.
A thinner wallet usually means there's less inside it.

items.sourceNote: tautology / 同義反覆格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
只要你願意努力，你就是一個願意努力的人。
至於有沒有成果，那是另一個願意努力的問題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在勵志場合假裝給結論，講完讓全場安靜三秒再爆笑
variations: 做得到的事情，通常都是你做得到的；做不到的，那就先放著。
成功的人之所以成功，是因為他們最後成功了。

en.content:
As long as you're willing to try, you are a person who is willing to try.
Whether it works out is a separate question about being willing to try.
en.editorNote: Great for faking a profound conclusion in a motivational moment — pause, then watch the room crack up
variations: The things you can do are usually the ones you can do; the rest can wait.
Successful people are successful because they ended up succeeding.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學六大手法參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
氣象局表示，今天會下雨的地方都會下雨，不會下雨的地方則維持不下雨。
請民眾依照所在地實際情況自行判斷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 出門前看到下雨可以傳給朋友，假裝幫他做了專業氣象分析
variations: 預報指出，明天的溫度會落在熱和冷之間的某個位置。
今天太陽出來的時候會比較亮，太陽下山之後則會變暗。

en.content:
The weather bureau reports that everywhere it rains today will get rain, while everywhere it doesn't will stay dry.
Residents are advised to assess their own local conditions.
en.editorNote: Text this to a friend before heading out in the rain, pretending you ran a pro weather analysis for them
variations: Forecasters note that tomorrow's temperature will land somewhere between hot and cold.
It'll be brighter today while the sun is up, and darker once it sets.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 笑話風格參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
睡眠研究顯示，你只要躺著閉上眼睛睡著，就能順利進入睡眠狀態。
醒著的人則普遍處於沒睡著的狀態。
zh-tw.editorNote: 失眠的朋友傳訊息抱怨睡不著時，可以回這句假裝給專業建議
variations: 想要早起的關鍵，在於你前一天得先起得來才能再早起一次。
打哈欠通常是身體告訴你它剛剛打了一個哈欠。

en.content:
Sleep research shows that if you lie down, close your eyes, and fall asleep, you'll successfully enter a state of sleep.
People who are awake, meanwhile, are generally not asleep.
en.editorNote: When a sleepless friend texts to complain, reply with this and pretend it's expert guidance
variations: The key to waking up early is that you first have to wake up at all so you can do it again earlier.
A yawn is usually your body informing you that it just yawned.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「有道理」循環句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
你說的這句話我覺得很對，對就對在它本身其實沒什麼對的地方，
但因為你覺得對、我也覺得對，於是它就慢慢地變成對的了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友認真跟你討論一件事、你又懶得反駁時，丟這句假裝深表認同
variations: 你問的這個問題問得非常好，好就好在它根本沒什麼好回答的。
這個想法我支持，支持的原因是它不需要任何原因就能被支持。

en.content:
What you just said strikes me as completely right — and it's right precisely because there's nothing actually right about it,
but since you think it's right and I think it's right, it slowly becomes right.
en.editorNote: When a friend earnestly explains something and you can't be bothered to argue, drop this to feign deep agreement
variations: That's a great question — great in the sense that there's nothing about it worth answering.
I fully support this idea, and the reason I support it is that it needs no reason to be supported.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 風格參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
理財專家指出，只要你花的錢比賺的少，剩下的那部分就會自動變成你的存款。
如果你花得比賺的多，這個現象就不會發生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友抱怨存不到錢時，回這句假裝給你最頂級的理財建議
variations: 想要變有錢的第一步，是先確保你目前還沒有那麼有錢。
據統計，買得起的東西通常都在你的預算之內。

en.content:
Financial experts point out that as long as you spend less than you earn, whatever is left automatically becomes your savings.
If you spend more than you earn, this phenomenon does not occur.
en.editorNote: When a friend complains they can't save money, reply with this and pretend it's premium financial advice
variations: The first step to getting rich is making sure you aren't already that rich.
Studies show that things you can afford are usually within your budget.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「俗話說」自指句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
古人曾說過一句很有智慧的話，那句話的內容就是：古人曾說過一句很有智慧的話。
至於是哪句，至今仍是個謎。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想假裝引用名言但其實沒料時，這句最安全
variations: 俗話說得好，俗話說的就是會被人拿來說的那種話。
正所謂前人種樹，後人就會看到一棵被前人種好的樹。

en.content:
The ancients once spoke a deeply wise saying, and the saying went: the ancients once spoke a deeply wise saying.
Exactly which one remains a mystery to this day.
en.editorNote: Perfect for when you want to sound like you're quoting wisdom but have nothing in the tank
variations: As the old saying goes, the old saying is the kind of thing people say.
They say the early bird gets the worm — mostly because it was the one that showed up early.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 笑話風格參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
健身教練表示，只要你持續運動，身體就會處於正在運動的狀態。
一旦停下來，這個狀態便會立刻消失。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到朋友在群組立健身flag時，回這句假裝給專業指導
variations: 減重的關鍵在於你的體重要比現在還要再輕一點。
研究顯示，舉得起來的重量通常都在你舉得起來的範圍內。

en.content:
A personal trainer notes that as long as you keep exercising, your body will remain in a state of exercising.
The moment you stop, that state immediately disappears.
en.editorNote: When a friend posts a fitness resolution in the group chat, reply with this as if it's professional coaching
variations: The key to losing weight is for your weight to be a little lower than it currently is.
Research shows the weight you can lift is usually within the range of what you can lift.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學喝水長壽風格，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
醫學統計指出，凡是每天喝水的人，最後幾乎都離開了這個世界。
至今尚未發現例外。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友在群組分享養生文時，回這句假裝補充專業數據
variations: 數據顯示，吃早餐的人壽命有限，不吃的人也一樣。
規律睡覺的人，醒來的機率非常高。

en.content:
Medical statistics show that nearly everyone who drinks water every day eventually leaves this world.
No exception has been recorded so far.
en.editorNote: When a friend shares wellness tips in the chat, drop this as if adding expert data
variations: Data shows people who eat breakfast have a finite lifespan — and so do those who skip it.
People who sleep regularly have an extremely high chance of waking up.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 笑話風格參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
什麼東西又綠又會跳？
如果風夠大，那就是草。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想冷場時丟出來的萬用謎語，保證對話瞬間凝固
variations: 什麼東西是紅色又聞起來像紅油漆？答案是紅油漆。
為什麼叫小山？因為它是一座比較小的山。

en.content:
What's green and jumps?
Grass — if the wind is strong enough.
en.editorNote: A go-to riddle for killing the mood; guaranteed to freeze any conversation
variations: What's red and smells like red paint? Red paint.
Why do they call it a small mountain? Because it's a smaller mountain.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 占卜笑話風格，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我今天的星座運勢寫著：「將會有事情發生。」
到了晚上回頭看，它說得一點都沒錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友太迷信星座運勢時，傳這句溫柔吐槽
variations: 算命師說我未來會遇到一個人，結果我每天都遇到很多人，太準了。
預言說明年會過去，目前看來相當可信。

en.content:
My horoscope today read: "Something will happen."
Looking back tonight, it turned out to be completely accurate.
en.editorNote: Send this to gently roast a friend who takes their horoscope too seriously
variations: A fortune teller said I'd meet someone — and I met dozens of people that day. Spot on.
The prophecy says next year will pass. So far it's holding up remarkably well.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學自指句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
如果我沒有講錯的話，那這句話就是對的。
如果我講錯了，那這句話就不是這句話了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在群組裡丟出來，看大家認真思考三秒後決定不理你
variations: 據我所知，我其實不太知道。但我知道我不知道，這點我很確定。
這句話如果是真的，那它就是真的；如果是假的，那它就不是這句話。

en.content:
If I'm not mistaken, then this sentence is correct.
If I am mistaken, then this sentence is no longer this sentence.
en.editorNote: Perfect for dropping in a chat and watching everyone think hard for three seconds before deciding to ignore you
variations: As far as I know, I don't really know much. But I do know that I don't know — that part I'm sure of.
If this sentence is true, then it's true; if it's false, then it isn't this sentence.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學時間循環例句，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
只要把這個禮拜撐過去，下個禮拜就會自動到來。
而下個禮拜撐過去之後，再下個禮拜也會到。
人生就是這樣一個禮拜接一個禮拜過去的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 週一上班前傳給同事，給彼此一點虛無的力量
variations: 只要熬過今天，明天就到了；熬過明天，後天也會到。日子就是這樣一天天被熬過去的。
等到月底，這個月就結束了。這是經過長期觀察得出的結論。

en.content:
As long as you get through this week, next week will arrive on its own.
And once you get through next week, the week after will arrive too.
That's how life goes — one week after another.
en.editorNote: Send this to a coworker before Monday for a little dose of motivational nihilism
variations: Just survive today and tomorrow shows up; survive tomorrow and the next day shows up too. That's how the days get crossed off.
Wait until the end of the month and the month will be over. This conclusion is based on extensive observation.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 拼字梗，重新創作改寫

zh-tw.content:
「錯字」這兩個字唯一不會是錯字的時候，就是當它真的指一個錯字的時候。
其他時候它都對得不能再對。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給每次都要抓你錯字的那位朋友，以毒攻毒
variations: 把字打對，這件事本身永遠不會打錯，除非你把「對」打成「錯」。
「簡短」這兩個字其實不算短，這點有點諷刺。

en.content:
The only time the word "incorrectly" is spelled incorrectly is when it's actually spelled incorrectly.
Every other time, it's about as correct as a word can get.
en.editorNote: Send this to the friend who always corrects your typos — fight fire with fire
variations: The word "misspelled" is hardly ever misspelled, which is honestly its biggest flex.
The word "short" is, ironically, not that short to type out.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 一次性事實梗，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
你可以把水泥喝下去，只是這件事你一輩子只能做一次。
做完之後，你大概也不太需要再做第二次了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友說「這個應該可以吧」的時候冷冷補一句
variations: 每個人都能跳傘，差別只在於你想不想用第二次。
理論上你可以吃下任何東西，能不能吃第二口才是重點。

en.content:
You can drink cement — it's just something you only get to do once.
After that, you probably won't feel the need to do it again.
en.editorNote: Pull this out the moment a friend says "that should be fine, right?"
variations: Everyone can skydive. The only question is whether you'd want a second go.
Technically you can eat anything. Whether you get a second bite is the real question.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重複句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
你現在正在讀這句話。
讀完之後，你就讀完了這句話。
至於讀到了什麼，那是另一個問題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在貼文最上面，騙人看完整篇結果什麼都沒有
variations: 聽完這段話，你會發現你聽完了這段話。
看完這本書的人，通常都已經把這本書看完了。

en.content:
You are currently reading this sentence.
Once you finish, you will have finished reading this sentence.
What you got out of it is a separate matter.
en.editorNote: Great as the opening line of a post — lures people into reading the whole thing for nothing
variations: After hearing this, you'll realize you've heard this.
People who finish this book have usually, by then, finished the book.

items.sourceNote: 同義反覆笑話句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
廢話社的第一條規則，就是廢話社的第一條規則。
至於第二條，我們開會討論過了，結論是還沒討論。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在群組裡有人問「規則是什麼」的時候丟出去，保證對話直接陷入沉默
variations: 想加入廢話社，首先你要先想加入廢話社。
廢話社不對外公開規則，因為公開了就不叫不公開了。

en.content:
The first rule of the Nonsense Club is the first rule of the Nonsense Club.
As for the second rule, we held a meeting about it — and concluded we hadn't discussed it yet.
en.editorNote: Use this when someone asks 'what are the rules?' in a group chat — guaranteed to kill the conversation instantly
variations: To join the Nonsense Club, the first step is wanting to join the Nonsense Club.
The Nonsense Club keeps its rules private, because once they're public they're no longer private.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「出意外」句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
如果一切順利的話，那就是一切順利。
如果不順利的話，那大概就是出意外了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在工作群組報告進度時用，主管看了會很想揍你
variations: 計畫進行得很好，唯一的問題是還沒開始。
只要不出意外，就不會出意外，問題是意外通常不打招呼。

en.content:
If everything goes smoothly, then everything goes smoothly.
If it doesn't, then something unexpected has probably happened.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a status update in a work chat — your manager will want to throw something at you
variations: The plan is going great; the only issue is it hasn't started.
As long as nothing unexpected happens, nothing unexpected happens — the catch is that the unexpected rarely warns you first.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「開玩笑」反轉句型參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我爸有三棟房，我媽有兩台車，我哥有一間公司。
而我，有他們這麼厲害的家人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友炫耀家境時接話，把對話導向溫馨又廢的方向
variations: 我家開三間餐廳、兩家飯店、一座工廠，我負責去吃、去住、去參觀。
我們全家都很有才華，爸會做生意、媽會理財、我會欣賞他們。

en.content:
My dad owns three houses, my mom owns two cars, my brother owns a company.
And me — I own the privilege of being related to them.
en.editorNote: Use this to one-up a friend who's bragging about their family — steers the convo somewhere warm and pointless
variations: My family runs three restaurants, two hotels, and a factory; my job is to eat, stay over, and take the tour.
Everyone in my family is gifted — Dad does business, Mom handles money, and I appreciate them.

items.sourceNote: 「Wherever you go, there you are」同義反覆名句參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
無論你走到哪裡，你都在那裡。
這也是為什麼你永遠甩不掉自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在出去玩的限動配風景照，看起來很有意境，其實什麼都沒說
variations: 不管你飛多遠，下飛機的還是你。
換個城市生活，唯一沒換掉的就是自己。

en.content:
Wherever you go, there you are.
Which is also why you can never quite escape yourself.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a scenic photo on your travel story — looks deep, says nothing
variations: No matter how far you fly, the person getting off the plane is still you.
You can move to a new city, but the one thing you can't swap out is yourself.

items.sourceNote: tautology / lapalissade 句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
醫生說，等到不痛的時候，就會比較不痛了。
我聽完覺得很有道理，但好像哪裡怪怪的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友抱怨身體不舒服時，一本正經地安慰他
variations: 別擔心，傷口癒合之後就不會是傷口了。
撐過最累的時候，剩下的就不是最累的時候了。

en.content:
The doctor told me it'll feel better once it stops hurting.
I nodded, and only later realized something was off.
en.editorNote: Use it to 'comfort' a friend complaining about an ache — deliver it with a totally straight face
variations: Don't worry, once the wound heals it won't be a wound anymore.
Get through the hardest part and the rest won't be the hardest part.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學時間循環句型，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
經過研究發現，只要熬過了今天，明天就會到來。
而明天熬過去之後，又會變成今天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在加班到深夜或熬夜趕報告時，傳給一起苦的同事
variations: 再撐一下，因為再不撐一下就撐不下去了。
週一最難的地方，就是它總是接在週日後面。

en.content:
Studies show that if you just survive today, tomorrow will arrive.
And once you survive tomorrow, it becomes today again.
en.editorNote: Send it to a coworker grinding through a late night or an all-nighter deadline
variations: Just hang on a little longer, because if you don't, you won't be hanging on.
The hardest part about Monday is that it always comes right after Sunday.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義重複句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
聽完你講的這一席話，我的感想是：
就好像聽完了一席話一樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開會聽完冗長報告後，傳給隔壁同事的即時心得
variations: 讀完你寫的這篇文章，我整個人彷彿讀完了一篇文章。
看完這部電影，我得到的最大收穫，就是看完了這部電影。

en.content:
After hearing everything you just said,
my honest takeaway is that I have now heard you say something.
en.editorNote: Perfect for messaging the coworker next to you after a painfully long meeting wraps up
variations: Having read your entire article, I feel like a person who has read an article.
The biggest thing I gained from watching that movie was that I have now watched it.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學情況描述句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
現在的狀況呢，就是這麼一個狀況，
至於到底是什麼狀況，那還是得看實際狀況。
zh-tw.editorNote: 老闆問進度時的萬用回答，講完對方會以為你有在做事
variations: 事情的發展，目前正朝著它該發展的方向發展。
問題不大，但說大也不是不大，主要還是看你怎麼看。

en.content:
The situation right now is, well, exactly the kind of situation it is.
As for what kind of situation that actually is, that depends on the situation.
en.editorNote: An all-purpose reply when your boss asks for a status update — sounds like you're on top of it
variations: Things are currently developing in the direction they're developing toward.
It's not a big deal, but it's not not a big deal — really depends how you look at it.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學觀察陳述句型，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我第一次出國的時候真的嚇到，
沒想到在國外，居然到處都是外國人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在出遊群組分享旅行心得，當作一本正經的開場白
variations: 去了一趟夜市才發現，原來夜市裡賣的全都是夜市美食。
搬到海邊住了之後我才驚覺，海邊離海真的好近。

en.content:
The first time I traveled abroad I was genuinely shocked —
turns out a foreign country is absolutely packed with foreigners.
en.editorNote: A straight-faced opener for sharing 'travel insights' in your trip group chat
variations: I went to the night market and realized everything they sell there is night market food.
After moving to the coast, it hit me — the coast is shockingly close to the ocean.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學數量換算句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
據統計，一個人只要連續睡滿八小時，
那他這一晚差不多就睡掉了四百八十分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被問「你昨天睡多久」時，用認真的口吻回答嚇對方一跳
variations: 存夠十二個月的薪水，你大概就存到了一整年的薪水。
只要喝完一整杯水，你杯子裡的水基本上就沒了。

en.content:
Statistics show that if a person sleeps a full eight hours,
they will have used up roughly four hundred and eighty minutes that night.
en.editorNote: Answer 'how long did you sleep?' with this dead-serious math and watch their face
variations: Save twelve months of salary and you'll have saved about a year's worth of salary.
Once you finish a whole glass of water, the water in your glass is basically gone.

items.sourceNote: 經典套套邏輯「it is what it is」句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
事情會變成現在這樣，
是因為它沒有變成別的樣子。

換句話說，它就是它現在的樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友抱怨人生時，用一臉認真的表情給出這個「安慰」
variations: 你之所以還沒成功，是因為你目前的狀態還不算成功。
今天之所以是今天，是因為它既不是昨天，也還不是明天。

en.content:
Things turned out the way they did
because they didn't turn out any other way.

In other words, it is what it is.
en.editorNote: Offer this as heartfelt 'comfort' next time a friend vents about their life
variations: The reason you haven't succeeded yet is that your current situation does not yet count as success.
Today is today because it is neither yesterday nor tomorrow yet.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「明知故問」對答句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
「你在睡覺喔？」
「沒有，我只是閉著眼睛躺著，剛好失去意識而已。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 被家人明知故問時的最佳回擊，認真回答就輸了
variations: 「你在吃飯喔？」「沒有，我只是把食物放進嘴裡咀嚼後吞下去。」
「你在滑手機喔？」「沒有，我只是用手指在發光的螢幕上來回移動。」

en.content:
"Oh, are you sleeping?"
"No, I'm just lying here with my eyes closed and happen to be unconscious."
en.editorNote: The perfect comeback when a family member asks the obvious — answer seriously and you lose
variations: "Are you eating?" "No, I'm just putting food in my mouth, chewing, and swallowing."
"Are you on your phone?" "No, I'm just sliding my finger around on a glowing screen."

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「越聰明腦子越聰明」句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
研究顯示，越有錢的人，
通常銀行帳戶裡的數字就越大。

而沒錢的人，情況正好相反。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在財經群組裡假裝分享深奧的理財心得
variations: 越早起的人，通常起床的時間就越早。
話越多的人，講出來的字數通常也越多。

en.content:
Studies show that the richer a person is,
the bigger the number in their bank account tends to be.

For those without money, it's the other way around.
en.editorNote: Drop this in a finance group chat while pretending to share deep money wisdom
variations: The earlier you wake up, the earlier the time at which you got out of bed.
The more someone talks, the greater the number of words they typically produce.

items.sourceNote: 「聽君一席話如聽一席話」同義反覆梗，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
聽完你講的這番話，
我覺得就像聽完你講的這番話一樣。

收穫滿滿，等於沒收穫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在開完冗長的會議後傳給同事，精準總結一場毫無重點的會議
variations: 看完這部電影，我的心情就跟看完這部電影的人一樣複雜。
讀完這本書，我學到了讀完這本書才會學到的東西。

en.content:
After hearing everything you just said,
I feel exactly like someone who just heard everything you said.

Fully enriched, which is to say, not at all.
en.editorNote: Perfect to send a coworker after a long meeting — it nails the experience of a discussion with zero takeaways
variations: After watching that movie, my feelings are as complicated as anyone who watched that movie.
Having read this book, I learned exactly what one learns from reading this book.

items.sourceNote: 公共場所薄衛生紙 shower thought，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
公司想用比較薄的衛生紙來省錢，
結果發現大家只是會拉比較多張。

所以薄的衛生紙，
用起來跟厚的一樣多，
只是比較薄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在辦公室抱怨採購政策時引用，讓老闆無法反駁
variations: 把包裝做小一點，消費者就會買多一點，最後買的份量還是一樣多，只是包裝比較多。
把份量減少並不會讓人吃比較少，只會讓人多買一份。

en.content:
The company switched to thinner toilet paper to save money,
but everyone just started using more sheets.

So thin toilet paper
lasts about as long as thick toilet paper,
just thinner.
en.editorNote: Quote this when complaining about office cost-cutting — it leaves the boss with no comeback
variations: Shrink the packaging and people just buy more of it, so they end up with the same amount, just more boxes.
Reducing the portion doesn't make people eat less, it just makes them order a second one.

items.sourceNote: 右手碰右手肘會痛的觀察 shower thought，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
科學家研究發現，
你的右手從來沒有在不痛的情況下，
摸到自己的右手肘。

而會做到的人，
通常都有一隻很長的右手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到群組保證有人立刻試著彎手，效果拔群
variations: 人類目前還無法用舌頭舔到自己的手肘，這個結論在所有有手肘的人身上都成立。
你永遠看不到自己的後腦勺，除非你用了某種可以看到後腦勺的方法。

en.content:
Scientists have found that
your right hand has never once touched your right elbow
without it hurting.

And the people who manage it
usually just have a very long right arm.
en.editorNote: Drop this in a group chat and someone will immediately start bending their arm — works every time
variations: Humans still cannot lick their own elbow, a conclusion that holds true for everyone who has an elbow.
You can never see the back of your own head, unless you use some method that lets you see the back of your head.

items.sourceNote: 「technically true 的循環觀察」shower thought 風格，原創改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
你睡著的那一刻，
你其實是不知道的。

因為如果你知道自己睡著了，
那就代表你還醒著。

所以每天晚上，
你都是在不知不覺中失去意識，
然後隔天才發現自己睡過了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在失眠的深夜傳給同樣睡不著的朋友，越想越清醒
variations: 你永遠不會記得自己睡著的瞬間，因為記得的人都還沒睡著。
想知道自己幾點睡著是不可能的，因為知道的時候就還沒睡。

en.content:
The exact moment you fall asleep,
you never actually know about.

Because if you knew you'd fallen asleep,
it would mean you were still awake.

So every night
you lose consciousness without noticing,
and only realize the next day that you slept.
en.editorNote: Perfect to send a fellow insomniac at 3 a.m. — the more you think about it, the more awake you get
variations: You'll never remember the instant you fell asleep, because anyone who remembers it hasn't fallen asleep yet.
Knowing the exact time you fall asleep is impossible, since the moment you know it, you're still awake.

items.sourceNote: 「知道為什麼窮嗎，因為沒錢」因果循環廢話梗，重新創作為時間主題

zh-tw.content:
你知道為什麼時間總是不夠用嗎？

因為如果時間夠用，
你就不會覺得不夠用了。

而你會覺得不夠用，
就是因為它真的不夠用，
所以才不夠用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被主管追問進度時一臉認真地說出來，爭取三秒鐘的思考時間
variations: 事情之所以做不完，是因為它還沒做完，做完了就不會做不完了。
假日總是過很快，因為如果過很慢，那就不叫假日了，叫上班。

en.content:
You know why there's never enough time?

Because if there were enough time,
you wouldn't feel like there isn't.

And the reason you feel like there isn't
is that there genuinely isn't,
which is why there isn't.
en.editorNote: Say this with a straight face when your manager asks about your progress — buys you a solid three seconds
variations: The reason your work never gets finished is that it isn't finished yet; once it's finished, it won't be unfinished.
Weekends always go by fast, because if they went by slowly they wouldn't be weekends, they'd be work.

items.sourceNote: 「同一個東西因情境而改名」shower thought 觀察，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
一片麵包，
烤之前叫做麵包。

烤完之後，
還是麵包，
只是變成烤過的麵包。

如果烤太久，
它就會升級成炭。

所以吐司，
本質上就是被你嚇了一跳的麵包。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在早餐烤焦的時候自我安慰，順便假裝這是一道料理
variations: 冰塊就是放棄掙扎的水，等它想開了，又會變回水。
爆米花就是玉米受到驚嚇之後的樣子，受驚之前叫玉米，受驚之後叫點心。

en.content:
A slice of bread
is called bread before you toast it.

After you toast it,
it's still bread,
just toasted bread.

If you toast it too long,
it gets promoted to charcoal.

So toast
is basically bread that got startled.
en.editorNote: Comforting words for when you burn your breakfast — and you can pretend it was a recipe
variations: Ice is just water that gave up; once it cheers up, it goes right back to being water.
Popcorn is what corn looks like after a good scare — before the scare it's corn, after the scare it's a snack.

items.sourceNote: 「永遠是現在」時間悖論 shower thought，改寫為廢話文學

zh-tw.content:
不管你等多久，
時間永遠都是現在。

你期待的未來，
等它真的來了，
它就變成現在了。

而你想回去的過去，
當初也曾經是現在。

所以你這輩子，
從來沒有不在現在過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被催「快一點」的時候緩緩說出，讓對方瞬間懷疑人生
variations: 你永遠到不了明天，因為等你到的時候，它已經變成今天了。
「等一下」這件事永遠不會發生，因為等一下到了，它就變成現在了。

en.content:
No matter how long you wait,
the time is always now.

The future you look forward to,
the moment it actually arrives,
turns into now.

And the past you want to go back to
was once a now too.

So in your whole life
you have never not been in the present.
en.editorNote: Deliver this slowly when someone tells you to hurry up — watch them question their entire existence
variations: You can never reach tomorrow, because by the time you get there, it has already turned into today.
"In a minute" never actually happens, because once the minute arrives, it becomes now.

items.sourceNote: 「如果沒猜錯應該沒猜錯」自我指涉廢話梗，重新創作為工作主題

zh-tw.content:
這個會議的結論是，
我們之後還要再開一個會。

至於那個會要討論什麼，
就是討論這個會沒討論完的事。

而這個會之所以沒討論完，
是因為時間都拿來討論下次要開會了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在冗長會議結束時小聲說給隔壁同事聽，引發會心一笑
variations: 這封信主要是想通知你，等一下會再寄一封信，補充這封信沒講清楚的部分。
今天的待辦事項第一項，就是整理待辦事項，整理完之後就沒時間做了。

en.content:
The conclusion of this meeting is
that we need to schedule another meeting.

As for what that meeting will cover,
it's whatever this meeting didn't get to.

And the reason this meeting didn't get to it
is that we spent all the time scheduling the next meeting.
en.editorNote: Mutter this to your deskmate at the end of a marathon meeting — guaranteed knowing smile
variations: This email is mainly to let you know that another email is coming to clarify the parts this email didn't.
The first item on today's to-do list is organizing the to-do list, and once that's done there's no time left to do it.

items.sourceNote: 「越聰明的人腦子就越聰明」同義反覆梗，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
研究指出，跑得越快的人，移動的速度就越快。

而跑得慢的人，速度則相對比較慢。

這個結論在快的人和慢的人身上，都得到了一致的驗證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友認真分析事情時插一句，瞬間讓對話歸零
variations: 睡得越久的人，醒來的時候就越晚。這是經過反覆觀察得出的規律。
吃得越多的人，通常吃下去的東西也越多，目前沒有例外。

en.content:
Studies show that people who run faster move at a higher speed.

Meanwhile, people who run slower tend to be comparatively slower.

This finding has been consistently confirmed in both the fast and the slow.
en.editorNote: Drop this in while a friend is seriously analyzing something — instantly resets the conversation to zero
variations: The longer you sleep, the later you wake up. This pattern holds after repeated observation.
People who eat more usually end up having eaten more. No exceptions found so far.

items.sourceNote: 「七日不見，如隔一周」等量換算廢話梗，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
好久不見，算一算，
上次見面到現在，
剛好過了我們沒見面的這段時間。

一分不多，一分不少。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合久別重逢時當開場白，對方會愣一下才反應過來
variations: 我們認識到現在，剛好就是我們認識的這麼久。
從你出生到今天，正好是你目前的歲數，分毫不差。

en.content:
Long time no see! Let me do the math —
from the last time we met until now,
exactly the time we spent apart has passed.

Not a second more, not a second less.
en.editorNote: Perfect opener when reuniting with someone — they'll pause before realizing you said nothing
variations: We've known each other for exactly as long as we've known each other.
From the day you were born until today is precisely your current age, down to the second.

items.sourceNote: "It'll feel better when it stops hurting" 同義反覆英文梗，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
別擔心，等你不餓的時候，
你就會覺得吃飽了。

而等你吃飽了，
你自然就不會覺得餓了。

所以這兩件事，其實是同一件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友喊肚子餓的時候安慰他，安慰完他會更餓
variations: 天黑了之後天就會變暗，等天再次變亮，那就是天亮了。
感冒好了之後你就不會再咳嗽，而你不再咳嗽的時候，通常代表感冒好了。

en.content:
Don't worry — once you stop being hungry,
you'll feel full.

And once you feel full,
you naturally won't feel hungry anymore.

So really, those are the same thing.
en.editorNote: Use this to comfort a hungry friend — they'll be hungrier after the comfort
variations: Once it gets dark, the sky turns dim; and when it brightens again, that's daylight.
Once your cold is gone you'll stop coughing, and when you stop coughing it usually means the cold is gone.

items.sourceNote: "The first rule of Tautology club is the first rule of Tautology club" 自我指涉梗，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
這個群組唯一的規定，
就是要遵守這個群組唯一的規定。

至於那個規定是什麼，
請參考這個群組唯一的規定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合當群組公告或自我介紹開場，看誰會認真去問規定是什麼
variations: 這份說明書的第一頁寫著：詳情請見第一頁。
本店的退貨政策是：依照本店的退貨政策辦理。

en.content:
The only rule of this group
is that you must follow the only rule of this group.

As for what that rule is,
please refer to the only rule of this group.
en.editorNote: Great as a group announcement or intro — see who actually asks what the rule is
variations: Page one of this manual reads: for details, see page one.
Our store's return policy is: returns are handled according to our store's return policy.

items.sourceNote: "如果我沒說錯的話，那就是沒說錯的話" 自我肯定型廢話，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
如果我沒記錯的話，
那我應該就是記對了。

而如果我記對了，
那就代表我沒記錯。

所以請放心，我這次一定沒記錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在你其實忘記某件事、卻又想裝得很有自信的時候使用
variations: 如果我沒聽錯的話，我剛剛應該有聽到聲音。
只要我沒看錯，那我看到的就是我看到的東西。

en.content:
If I'm not misremembering,
then I must be remembering correctly.

And if I'm remembering correctly,
that means I'm not misremembering.

So rest assured, I definitely got it right this time.
en.editorNote: Perfect for when you've actually forgotten something but want to sound completely confident about it
variations: If I heard that correctly, then I did in fact hear something just now.
As long as I'm not seeing wrong, what I saw is exactly what I saw.

items.sourceNote: "知道為什麼我那麼窮嗎，因為沒錢" 因果廢話，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
你知道我為什麼一直存不到錢嗎？

因為我每次剩下的錢，
都比我想存的還要少。

專家指出，這通常是花掉造成的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合月底看到帳戶餘額時，發給同樣月光的朋友尋求共鳴
variations: 我之所以那麼累，是因為我還沒有休息夠。等我休息夠了，就不會這麼累了。
為什麼我總是遲到？因為我出門的時間，通常都太晚了。

en.content:
Do you know why I can never save any money?

Because the amount I have left over
is always less than the amount I wanted to save.

Experts suggest this is usually caused by spending it.
en.editorNote: Send this to a fellow paycheck-to-paycheck friend when you check your balance at the end of the month
variations: The reason I'm so tired is that I haven't rested enough yet. Once I've rested enough, I won't be this tired.
Why am I always late? Because the time I leave the house is usually too late.

items.sourceNote: "It'll feel better when it stops hurting" 同義反覆，重新創作為不同情境

zh-tw.content:
放心，等你睡飽了，
就不會想睡了。

而當你不想睡的時候，
通常就代表你已經睡飽了。

所以問題其實會自己解決。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友喊累喊想睡的時候，用來提供毫無幫助的安慰
variations: 別急，等這首歌播完，它自然就結束了。
等你把事情做完，你就沒有事情要做了。

en.content:
Relax — once you've had enough sleep,
you won't feel sleepy anymore.

And when you don't feel sleepy,
it usually means you've had enough sleep.

So really, the problem solves itself.
en.editorNote: Ideal for offering completely useless comfort when a friend complains about being tired
variations: Don't rush — once this song finishes playing, it'll naturally be over.
Once you finish your tasks, you'll have no more tasks to do.

items.sourceNote: "越聰明的人腦子就越聰明" 循環定義型廢話，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
研究發現，一個人越有錢，
他擁有的錢就越多。

而錢越多的人，
通常也就越有錢。

目前科學界對此尚未提出反例。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合當作偽科普開場，或在朋友討論理財時一本正經地插一句
variations: 越高的人，通常個子都比較高。
跑得越快的人，抵達終點的速度就越快，這點目前無人能反駁。

en.content:
Studies show that the wealthier a person is,
the more money they have.

And people with more money
tend to be wealthier.

So far, science has found no counterexample.
en.editorNote: Use it as a fake-science opener, or drop it with a straight face while friends discuss investing
variations: Taller people are usually of greater height.
The faster you run, the sooner you reach the finish line — a claim no one has yet disproven.

items.sourceNote: "It is what it is / Wherever you go, there you are" 自我指涉哲理句，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
無論你走到哪裡，
你都會在你所在的地方。

而你所在的地方，
剛好就是你走到的那裡。

這大概就是人生吧。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配風景照發限時動態，假裝自己頓悟了什麼人生道理
variations: 事情就是這樣，因為它本來就是這個樣子。
不管你選哪一個，你選到的就是你選的那一個。

en.content:
No matter where you go,
you'll be exactly where you are.

And where you are
happens to be the place you went to.

That, I suppose, is life.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a scenic photo on your story and pretend you've had a deep life realization
variations: It is the way it is, because that's simply how it is.
Whichever one you pick, the one you picked is the one you chose.

items.sourceNote: 「俗話說得好：俗話說得好」自我指涉句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
俗話說得好：
俗話說得好。

古人的智慧就是這麼樸實無華，
而且毫無內容。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友一本正經引用名言時，接這句把氣氛搞垮
variations: 老話一句：老話一句。
常言道，常言道得很有道理。

en.content:
As the old saying goes:
the old saying goes.

The wisdom of our ancestors
is truly this simple — and this empty.
en.editorNote: Perfect for cutting in right after a friend solemnly quotes some proverb
variations: Like they always say: they always say.
As the wise once told us, the wise once told us something.

items.sourceNote: 「七日不見，如隔一周」時間單位換算廢話，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
七天沒見到你，
感覺就像過了整整一個禮拜。

這份思念的長度，
經過精密換算，分毫不差。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給久沒見面的朋友，看起來很深情，其實只是在講廢話
variations: 三十天沒聯絡，恍如隔了一個月。
二十四小時沒吃飯，餓的程度大概就是一整天份。

en.content:
Seven days without seeing you
feels exactly like an entire week has passed.

The length of this longing,
after careful conversion, checks out perfectly.
en.editorNote: Text it to a friend you haven't seen in a while — looks heartfelt, is actually nonsense
variations: Thirty days out of touch feels like a whole month.
Twenty-four hours without food leaves me roughly one day's worth of hungry.

items.sourceNote: 「If we do not succeed, we run the risk of failure」Dan Quayle 式同義反覆，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
如果我們沒有成功，
那我們就有失敗的風險。

所以請記住：
不成功，便成不了功。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在勵志簡報最後一頁，讓全場陷入沉思（其實是困惑）
variations: 只要不放棄，你就還沒放棄。
堅持到最後的人，通常撐得比較久。

en.content:
If we do not succeed,
we run the risk of not succeeding.

So remember:
to not succeed is to fall short of success.
en.editorNote: Slap it on the final slide of a motivational deck and watch the room go quiet (from confusion)
variations: As long as you don't quit, you haven't quit yet.
Those who hold on until the end usually last the longest.

items.sourceNote: 「我前腳剛走，後腳就跟上了」身體部位同步廢話，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
我前腳才剛踏出門，
後腳馬上就跟了上來。

多年來，這兩隻腳的配合
始終如一，從未失手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 描述自己出門這件小事時用，瞬間提升敘事的史詩感
variations: 我左手一伸，右手也沒閒著。
我剛眨了一下眼，另一隻眼睛也跟著眨了。

en.content:
The moment my front foot stepped out the door,
my back foot immediately followed.

After all these years, these two feet
have never once let each other down.
en.editorNote: Use it to narrate the simple act of leaving the house, instantly epic
variations: I reached out my left hand, and my right hand was not idle either.
The instant I blinked one eye, the other one blinked right along.

items.sourceNote: 日本廢話語錄「與你一起的夏天比冬天更熱」季節廢話，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
和你一起度過的夏天，
比冬天還要熱一些。

不是因為你，
是因為那本來就是夏天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 假裝很浪漫地傳給曖昧對象，最後一句再讓對方清醒過來
variations: 跟你在一起的冬天，總是特別冷，因為那時候是冬天。
有你在的白天，天空特別亮，主要是因為太陽出來了。

en.content:
The summers I spend with you
are a little hotter than the winters.

Not because of you —
but because it was already summer.
en.editorNote: Send it to your crush as if it's romantic, then let the last line snap them back to reality
variations: The winters with you are always especially cold, because it happens to be winter.
The days you're around, the sky is so bright — mainly because the sun is out.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同語反覆「越過山就擁有越過山的能力」句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
當你爬完這座山，
你就擁有了爬完這座山的經驗。

這份經驗會陪伴你，
直到你去爬下一座山為止。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友完成任何小成就時傳給他，聽起來很勵志但其實什麼都沒說
variations: 當你讀完這句話，你就成功地讀完了這句話。
當你學會一件事，你就從不會那件事變成會了。

en.content:
Once you finish climbing this mountain,
you'll have the experience of finishing this mountain.

That experience will stay with you
right up until you climb the next one.
en.editorNote: Send it to a friend who just hit any small milestone — sounds inspiring, says nothing
variations: Once you finish reading this sentence, you'll have successfully finished reading this sentence.
Once you learn a thing, you go from not knowing it to knowing it.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「情況就是這個情況，具體看情況」句型，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
情況目前大概就是這樣，
至於實際上是怎樣，

還是要看情況。
情況變了，那就又是另一個情況了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 主管問進度卻還沒想好怎麼回時使用，完美填滿對話又不透露任何資訊
variations: 問題不大，如果變大了，那就是有點大。
這件事能不能成，主要取決於它到底能不能成。

en.content:
The situation is basically the situation right now.
As for how things actually stand,

that still depends on the situation.
If the situation changes, then it's a different situation.
en.editorNote: Use it when your boss asks for a status update and you haven't figured out an answer — fills the air, reveals nothing
variations: It's not a big problem, and if it becomes big, then it's a bit of a problem.
Whether this works out mainly comes down to whether it works out.

items.sourceNote: 英文同語反覆「wherever you go, there you are」重新創作

zh-tw.content:
無論你走到哪裡，
你人就在那裡。

這麼多年來，我從來沒有一次
成功地把自己留在別的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 旅行打卡照的文案，聽起來像頓悟，其實只是描述你人在現場
variations: 不管你搬到哪個城市，你都得住在那個城市裡。
你逃到天涯海角，天涯海角就會多出一個你。

en.content:
No matter where you go,
there you are.

After all these years, not once
have I managed to leave myself somewhere else.
en.editorNote: A caption for your travel check-in photo — sounds like an epiphany, just states that you're physically present
variations: Wherever you move, you have to live in the place you moved to.
You can run to the ends of the earth, and the ends of the earth will gain one more you.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「七日不見如隔一周」時間循環句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我們已經七天沒見了，
感覺就像過了整整一個禮拜。

下次再這樣，
大概又是另一個七天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 太久沒約的朋友揪聚會時傳這句，土味思念一次到位
variations: 三十天不見，如隔一個月。
自從上次分開後，我們就一直沒有再見面，直到下次見面為止。

en.content:
We haven't seen each other for seven days —
it feels like a whole week has gone by.

If it happens again next time,
it'll probably be another seven days.
en.editorNote: Send it when inviting a friend you haven't seen in ages — corny longing, delivered in one shot
variations: Thirty days apart feels just like a month.
Ever since we last parted, we haven't met again — right up until the next time we meet.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「俗話說得好」自我引用句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
俗話說得好：
「俗話說得好。」

這句話之所以流傳這麼久，
就是因為大家一直在講。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被人要求引用名言時丟這句，對方會安靜三秒鐘
variations: 古人有云，古人確實有云。
有一句話是這樣說的，而它剛剛就是被這樣說出來的。

en.content:
As the old saying goes:
"As the old saying goes."

The reason it's lasted so long
is that everyone keeps saying it.
en.editorNote: Whip this out when someone asks you to quote something wise — expect three seconds of silence
variations: The ancients once said, and yes, they did once say it.
There's a saying that goes like this — and it just went exactly like that.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「番茄有番茄味」同義反覆句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我咬了一口這顆番茄，
意外地，它有一股濃濃的番茄味。

果然是番茄，
沒有讓我失望。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友問餐廳食物好不好吃時的萬用回覆，講了等於沒講
variations: 這杯水喝起來，有一種水的味道。
我吃了一口白飯，發現它吃起來很像飯。

en.content:
I took a bite of this tomato,
and to my surprise, it tasted intensely of tomato.

Truly a tomato —
it did not let me down.
en.editorNote: The all-purpose reply when a friend asks how the restaurant food was — you've said everything and nothing
variations: This glass of water has a distinct flavor of water.
I took a bite of the rice and discovered it tastes remarkably like rice.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「我一無所知」自我否定句型，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
據我所知，
我其實一無所知。

而我唯一確定的，
就是這件事我也不太確定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被問到不會的問題時拿來墊檔，聽起來很有深度其實在裝傻
variations: 我什麼都懂，除了我不懂的那些。
經過深思熟慮，我決定不下任何結論。

en.content:
As far as I know,
I actually know nothing at all.

And the only thing I'm sure of
is that I'm not too sure about that either.
en.editorNote: A stalling line for questions you can't answer — sounds deep, but you're just playing dumb
variations: I understand everything, except the parts I don't understand.
After careful deliberation, I have decided to reach no conclusion whatsoever.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環邏輯格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
俗話說得好：
俗話說得好。

至於好在哪裡，
俗話沒說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 當有人問你「這句俗話什麼意思」時最佳回應，保證對方安靜三秒
variations: 老話一句：老話都這樣講。
古人有云，云的內容古人沒留下來。

en.content:
As the old saying goes:
as the old saying goes.

As for what it actually says,
the saying declined to comment.
en.editorNote: The perfect reply when someone asks what a proverb means — guarantees three seconds of silence
variations: Like they always say: they always say things.
The ancients once wrote, and then the ancients logged off.

items.sourceNote: 同齡悖論廢話梗，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
研究指出，
一個剛出生一天的寶寶，
他的媽媽當媽媽的資歷，
也剛好是一天。

科學家對此表示無法反駁。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在有新手爸媽的群組發，讓人思考三秒後決定不思考
variations: 你出生那天，你爸媽的爸媽資歷正式從零開始計算。
當一個人成為爸爸，他的孩子也剛好在同一天成為小孩。

en.content:
Studies confirm
that a baby who is one day old
has a mother whose experience as a mother
is also exactly one day old.

Scientists have been unable to disprove this.
en.editorNote: Great for a new-parents group chat — makes people think for three seconds, then decide not to
variations: On the day you were born, your parents' parenting résumé officially started at zero.
The moment a man becomes a dad, his kid becomes a kid on the exact same day.

items.sourceNote: 存活率歸零冷梗，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
統計顯示，
只要時間拉得夠長，
每個人的存活率都會穩定地
下降到零。

目前這項數據非常穩定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友焦慮未來時使用，安慰效果為零但很有記憶點
variations: 從長遠來看，我們每個人的計畫最後都會被時間解決。
好消息是問題總會過去，壞消息是你也是。

en.content:
Statistics show
that given a long enough timeline,
everyone's survival rate
settles steadily at zero.

So far this figure has been remarkably stable.
en.editorNote: For when a friend is anxious about the future — offers zero comfort but sticks in the memory
variations: In the long run, all of our plans get resolved by time itself.
The good news is your problems will pass. The bad news is so will you.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學時間遞進格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
只要撐過星期一，
接下來就會是星期二。

如果連星期二也撐過去了，
恭喜你，星期三已經在等你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 週一早上發到工作群組最對味，同事會又累又無法反駁
variations: 熬過今天，明天就會準時抵達，一天都不會少。
只要你不睡，這個禮拜遲早會結束。

en.content:
If you can just get through Monday,
Tuesday will follow shortly after.

And if you survive Tuesday too,
congratulations — Wednesday is already waiting.
en.editorNote: Post this to the work chat on a Monday morning — coworkers will be too tired to argue
variations: Make it through today and tomorrow arrives right on schedule, not a day short.
As long as you don't stop existing, this week will eventually end.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆手法，重新創作（金錢主題）

zh-tw.content:
理財專家提醒，
只要你把錢花出去，
那筆錢就會離開你的戶頭。

如果不花，它則會繼續留在原地。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合月底看帳單時傳給自己或朋友，殘酷但完全正確
variations: 存錢的關鍵在於不要把存的錢拿去花，這點很多人做不到。
薪水入帳那天最有錢，之後每一天都比前一天窮一點。

en.content:
Financial experts remind us
that once you spend your money,
it leaves your account.

If you don't spend it, it tends to stay where it is.
en.editorNote: Perfect to send yourself when the statement arrives at month's end — brutal but entirely accurate
variations: The secret to saving is not spending the money you saved. Surprisingly hard for many.
You're richest on payday, and every day after that you're a little poorer than the last.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件迴圈手法，重新創作（選擇主題）

zh-tw.content:
人生充滿選擇，
當你選了A，你就沒有選B。

而如果你選了B，那你選的就不是A。

這個道理，在所有選項上都成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合朋友猶豫要吃什麼、要買哪個時丟出來，幫倒忙但很中肯
variations: 不做決定其實也是一種決定，就是決定不做決定。
後悔的前提是你做了某個選擇，沒選的人通常沒得後悔。

en.content:
Life is full of choices.
When you pick A, you have not picked B.

And if you pick B, then what you picked is not A.

This principle holds true across all options.
en.editorNote: Great to drop when a friend can't decide what to eat or buy — unhelpful yet undeniably correct
variations: Not making a decision is itself a decision: the decision not to decide.
Regret requires having made a choice. People who never chose have nothing to regret.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 幽默格式，重新創作（飲食主題）

zh-tw.content:
營養師表示，
只要你把食物吃下去，
那份食物就會從盤子裡消失。

沒吃完的部分，則會原封不動地留在那裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聚餐收盤時說最好笑，尤其是還有人在猶豫最後一塊要不要吃
variations: 想變瘦的第一步是先不要變胖，這步很多人卡關。
吃飽的感覺，通常出現在你吃飽之後。

en.content:
Nutritionists confirm
that once you eat your food,
it disappears from your plate.

Whatever you don't eat remains exactly where it was.
en.editorNote: Funniest said as the table clears — especially when someone's still eyeing the last piece
variations: Step one to losing weight is not gaining weight. Many get stuck on this step.
The feeling of being full usually shows up right after you get full.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學自我指涉格式，重新創作（語言主題）

zh-tw.content:
有人問我廢話文學是什麼，
我想了很久，
最後得出的結論是：

你現在讀的這句話，
就是一個很好的例子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 當有人問你什麼是廢話文學時，這句是最完美的示範兼回答
variations: 這句話的重點，就是這句話本身沒有重點。
看完這段你會發現，你確實看完了這段。

en.content:
Someone asked me what absurd wisdom is.
I thought about it for a long time,
and finally reached this conclusion:

the sentence you're reading right now
is a pretty good example.
en.editorNote: When someone asks what this genre even is, this line is both the perfect demonstration and the answer
variations: The point of this sentence is that this sentence has no point.
After reading this, you'll realize you have indeed finished reading this.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學天氣主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
氣象局最新研究指出，
下雨的時候，外面通常會是濕的。

而只要雨停了，
地上遲早也會乾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 梅雨季群組報氣象時丟這句最應景，尤其在別人認真問要不要帶傘的時候
variations: 太陽出來的時候通常會比較亮，晚上則相對暗一點。
只要溫度夠低，你就會覺得冷；溫度夠高的話，情況則相反。

en.content:
The latest meteorological research confirms
that when it rains, things outside tend to get wet.

And once the rain stops,
the ground will eventually dry.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the group chat during rainy season — especially right after someone seriously asks whether they need an umbrella
variations: When the sun is out, it's usually brighter. At night, it tends to be darker.
If it's cold enough, you'll feel cold. If it's hot enough, the opposite occurs.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學睡眠主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
睡眠專家提醒，
熬夜熬得越晚，
你隔天就會起得越晚。

如果太晚起，
那基本上就等於沒睡早。
zh-tw.editorNote: 凌晨三點還在滑手機時傳給同樣沒睡的朋友，會有一種深深的共鳴
variations: 想早起的第一步，是先早點睡，很多人卡在這一步。
睡不著的時候通常是醒著的，睡著之後這個問題就自動消失了。

en.content:
Sleep experts remind us
that the later you stay up,
the later you'll wake up the next day.

And if you wake up too late,
that basically means you didn't wake up early.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend who's also awake at 3am — it hits with a strange, tired solidarity
variations: Step one to waking up early is going to sleep early. Many get stuck on this step.
When you can't sleep you're usually awake. Once you fall asleep, the problem solves itself.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學金錢主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
理財專家分析，
只要你把錢花出去，
那筆錢就不會在你的帳戶裡了。

而沒花掉的部分，
通常還會在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 月底看帳戶餘額時對自己說，殘酷但無比精準
variations: 存錢的關鍵在於不要花錢，這件事說起來簡單。
薪水入帳的那一刻是它離你最近的時候，之後就會漸行漸遠。

en.content:
Financial experts have determined
that once you spend your money,
it is no longer in your account.

Whatever you didn't spend
is usually still there.
en.editorNote: Say this to yourself while checking your balance at the end of the month — brutal, yet remarkably accurate
variations: The key to saving money is not spending it. Simple in theory.
The moment your paycheck lands is the closest it will ever be to you. After that, you drift apart.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學問答格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
「你從哪裡來？」
「我從我剛剛所在的地方來。」

「那你要去哪？」
「去一個我還沒到的地方。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 被問行程被問到煩時，用這套標準回答，對方就會放棄追問
variations: 「你在幹嘛？」「在做我正在做的事。」
「這是什麼？」「這就是你現在看到的這個。」

en.content:
"Where did you come from?"
"From the place I was just at."

"So where are you headed?"
"To a place I haven't reached yet."
en.editorNote: When you're tired of being grilled about your plans, deliver these standard answers and the questions will stop
variations: "What are you doing?" "The thing I'm currently doing."
"What is this?" "It's the thing you're looking at right now."

items.sourceNote: 窮小子哏廢話文學，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
今年的我，已經不是去年那個沒錢的我了。
我是今年這個沒錢的我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 跨年或生日發文用，展現這一年來扎實的成長軌跡
variations: 去年的存款花光了，還好今年又有一筆新的存款可以花光。
我的財富一直在增加，只是它增加之前得先減少。

en.content:
The me standing here today is no longer the broke person I was last year.
I'm this year's broke person.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a New Year's or birthday post that shows off a full year of personal growth
variations: Spent last year's savings, but the good news is there's a fresh batch of savings this year to spend.
My wealth keeps growing — it just has to shrink a little first before it does.

items.sourceNote: 據我所知我一無所知格式，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
就我所知，我知道的並不多。
而我不知道的部分，我也不太清楚到底有多少。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被問到不會的問題時，用這句話展現你既謙虛又誠實的一面
variations: 我對這件事的了解，僅限於我了解的那部分。
我懂的東西不多，但我不懂的東西我更是完全沒概念。

en.content:
As far as I know, I don't know much.
And exactly how much I don't know, I'm not entirely sure either.
en.editorNote: When someone asks you something you can't answer, use this to seem humble and honest at the same time
variations: My understanding of this topic is limited to the part I understand.
I don't know a lot, but the stuff I don't know, I have even less of a clue about.

items.sourceNote: 肚子餓吃東西廢話格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
肚子餓的時候，只要吃點東西，通常就會變得比較不餓。
這個方法在餓的人身上特別有效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給一直喊餓的朋友，附上這個經過反覆驗證的解決方案
variations: 吃飽之後你會發現，你已經不餓了。這就是吃飯的意義。
不想餓肚子，最好的辦法就是不要讓肚子餓。

en.content:
When you're hungry, eating something will usually make you less hungry.
This method works especially well on people who are hungry.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend who won't stop saying they're starving — a thoroughly tested solution
variations: After you finish eating, you'll notice you're no longer hungry. That's the whole point of eating.
The best way to avoid an empty stomach is to not let your stomach be empty.

items.sourceNote: 睡眠狀態廢話格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
只要睡著，你就會進入睡眠狀態。
如果還沒睡著，那就代表你目前還醒著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 失眠的夜裡傳給同樣睡不著的人，一起參透這個宇宙級的道理
variations: 想要不累，最好的方法就是睡飽。睡不飽的話，通常就會累。
閉上眼睛之後，你看到的就是眼皮的內側。

en.content:
The moment you fall asleep, you enter a state of sleep.
If you haven't fallen asleep yet, that means you're still awake.
en.editorNote: On a sleepless night, send this to someone else who's still up and contemplate the truth together
variations: The best way to not be tired is to get enough sleep. If you don't, you'll usually be tired.
Once you close your eyes, what you're looking at is the inside of your eyelids.

items.sourceNote: 週末收假廢話格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
週末最棒的地方，就在於它排在星期五的後面。
而等它結束之後，星期一就會準時出現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 星期天晚上發，替所有人的收假焦慮下一個精準的結論
variations: 放假的時候不用上班，要上班的時候就不算放假。
連假之所以叫連假，是因為它一放完，日子又要連著過。

en.content:
The best thing about the weekend is that it comes right after Friday.
And once it's over, Monday shows up right on schedule.
en.editorNote: Post this on Sunday night to put a precise conclusion on everyone's back-to-work dread
variations: On your day off you don't have to work, and when you have to work, it's not a day off.
A long weekend is called a break because the moment it ends, the days just keep going.

items.sourceNote: 手機充電主題廢話文學，原創

zh-tw.content:
手機在充電的時候，電量會慢慢變多。
如果你發現電量在變少，那就代表它其實沒在充。

這個規律，在有插電和沒插電的手機上都成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直抱怨手機沒電卻沒插好線的朋友，剛好
variations: 充飽電的手機通常可以用比較久，沒電的手機則需要充電。
行動電源之所以叫行動電源，是因為它有電的時候才有用。

en.content:
When your phone is charging, the battery slowly goes up.
If you notice it going down, that means it's not actually charging.

This holds true whether the phone is plugged in or not.
en.editorNote: Send this to the friend who keeps complaining about a dead phone but never plugged the cable in properly
variations: A fully charged phone usually lasts longer, while a dead one needs to be charged.
A power bank is called a power bank because it's only useful when it has power.

items.sourceNote: 照鏡子主題廢話文學，原創

zh-tw.content:
照鏡子的時候，鏡子裡的人會跟你長得一模一樣。
目前這個現象，只在你照鏡子的時候發生。

你不照的時候，沒有人知道裡面長什麼樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合早上起床照到自己時，發到限時動態配一張素顏照
variations: 鏡子裡的你舉左手，其實是你舉了右手。
你看得到鏡子裡的自己，但鏡子裡的自己看不到你，因為那就是你。

en.content:
When you look in a mirror, the person inside looks exactly like you.
So far, this only happens while you're actually looking.

When you're not looking, nobody knows what's in there.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a morning selfie story caption the second you catch your own reflection
variations: When the you in the mirror raises its left hand, what you actually raised was your right.
You can see yourself in the mirror, but the mirror-you can't see you — because that's just you.

items.sourceNote: 排隊主題廢話文學，原創

zh-tw.content:
排隊的時候，你前面的人都比你早到，你後面的人都比你晚到。
這就是為什麼你會站在中間。

如果你站在最前面，那代表沒有人比你更早到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 排隊排到懷疑人生的時候，傳到群組讓大家一起釋懷
variations: 隊伍前進的時候，你會往前走；隊伍不動的時候，你就站在原地。
輪到你的時候，前面就沒有人了，因為他們都已經輪過了。

en.content:
In a line, everyone in front of you got there earlier, and everyone behind got there later.
That's precisely why you're standing in the middle.

If you're at the very front, it means nobody arrived before you.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat when the queue is long enough to make you question your life choices
variations: When the line moves, you move forward; when the line stops, you stay put.
When it's finally your turn, there's no one ahead of you — because they've all had their turn already.

items.sourceNote: 紅綠燈主題廢話文學，原創

zh-tw.content:
紅燈的時候大家都會停下來，變成綠燈之後大家又會動起來。
所以綠燈的意思，其實就是紅燈已經結束了。

黃燈則是在提醒你，剛剛講的兩件事馬上要換一件。
zh-tw.editorNote: 塞在路口等紅燈時，傳給副駕的人一起無言
variations: 綠燈可以走，紅燈不能走，這就是為什麼你走的時候通常是綠燈。
等紅燈的時間，剛好等於紅燈亮著的時間。

en.content:
At a red light everyone stops, and when it turns green everyone moves again.
So green basically just means the red light is over.

Yellow is there to warn you that those two things are about to swap.
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever's in the passenger seat while you're both stuck waiting at the intersection
variations: Green means go and red means stop, which is exactly why you're usually moving on green.
The time you spend waiting at a red light is precisely equal to how long the red light is on.

items.sourceNote: 閱讀主題廢話文學，原創

zh-tw.content:
一本書只要你從第一頁看到最後一頁，就算看完了。
如果還沒看到最後一頁，那就是還沒看完。

看到一半放著的書，本質上就是一本你看了一半的書。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個買了一堆書但都只看前三頁的朋友
variations: 書架上沒看過的書，通常是你還沒開始看的那些。
看得懂的地方叫做讀懂了，看不懂的地方叫做這頁再看一次。

en.content:
A book counts as finished once you've read it from the first page to the last.
If you haven't reached the last page yet, then you haven't finished.

A book you left halfway through is, in essence, a book you're halfway through.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the friend who buys a stack of books but only ever reads the first three pages
variations: The unread books on your shelf are usually the ones you haven't started yet.
The parts you understand are called reading; the parts you don't are called reading that page again.

items.sourceNote: 喝水主題廢話文學，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
一杯水喝到一半的時候，你喝掉的那一半已經不在杯子裡了。
還留在杯子裡的，就是你還沒喝的那一半。

所以只要你一直喝，遲早會喝到只剩下空杯子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 口渴到開始盯著水杯發呆的時候，傳給一起喝下午茶的人
variations: 杯子是半滿還是半空，取決於你剛剛是在喝還是在倒。
把剩下的半杯喝完，杯子就變全空的了；再倒滿，它又變全滿的了。

en.content:
When you've drunk half a glass of water, the half you drank is no longer in the glass.
What's still in the glass is the half you haven't gotten to yet.

So as long as you keep sipping, sooner or later you'll be left with an empty glass.
en.editorNote: For when you're so thirsty you've started staring at the cup — send it to whoever's having tea with you
variations: Whether the glass is half full or half empty depends on whether you were just drinking from it or pouring into it.
Finish the last half and the glass is completely empty; fill it back up and it's completely full again.

items.sourceNote: 穿搭反轉邏輯廢話文學，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
衣服如果沒有塞進褲子裡，那就是褲子塞進衣服裡了。
總之一定有一個塞在另一個裡面。

除非你兩件都沒穿，那就沒有這個問題了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 早上照鏡子整理儀容時，拿來說服自己其實穿得很好
variations: 外套沒有拉起來，就是拉鍊還在下面等你。
襪子如果沒有蓋住褲管，就是褲管蓋住襪子了。

en.content:
If your shirt isn't tucked into your pants, then your pants are tucked into your shirt.
Either way, one of them is definitely inside the other.

Unless you're wearing neither, in which case the problem solves itself.
en.editorNote: Use it in front of the mirror in the morning to convince yourself you're dressed just fine
variations: If your jacket isn't zipped up, the zipper is just waiting for you down at the bottom.
If your socks don't cover your pant legs, then your pant legs cover your socks.

items.sourceNote: 人生時間主題廢話文學，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
大家都說人生很短，可是人生其實是你經歷過最長的一件事。
畢竟從你出生到現在，一直都是它。

所以人生短的意思是，跟你還沒經歷的那些比起來很短。
zh-tw.editorNote: 半夜emo又覺得時間不夠用的時候，傳給同樣睡不著的人
variations: 人生很短，但也剛好長到夠你把它過完。
你這輩子花最多時間做的事，就是活著。

en.content:
Everyone says life is short, but life is actually the longest thing you've ever experienced.
After all, from the day you were born until now, it's been the whole time.

So 'life is short' really just means short compared to all the stuff you haven't lived through yet.
en.editorNote: For those late-night spirals when time feels too short — send it to whoever else is still awake
variations: Life is short, but conveniently just long enough for you to live all the way through it.
The thing you'll spend the most time on in your entire life is being alive.

items.sourceNote: 烏龜主題廢話文學，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
烏龜永遠沒辦法去別人家過夜，因為牠不管睡在哪裡，都是睡在自己家裡。
背上那個就是家，跟著牠一起移動。

所以烏龜出門玩，其實整間房子都帶著走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到路邊的烏龜或養寵物的朋友，可以拿來閒聊冷知識
variations: 蝸牛也一樣，牠搬家的時候不用叫搬家公司。
烏龜迷路的時候至少不用擔心回不了家，因為家就在身上。

en.content:
A turtle can never sleep over at someone else's place, because no matter where it sleeps, it's sleeping at home.
The thing on its back is the house, and it travels along with it.

So when a turtle goes out for the day, it's actually bringing the whole building with it.
en.editorNote: Good for small talk next time you spot a turtle or chat with a friend who has pets
variations: Same goes for snails — they never have to hire movers.
When a turtle gets lost, at least it doesn't have to worry about getting home, since home is right there on its back.

items.sourceNote: 鏡子主題廢話文學，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
鏡子裡的你永遠都在做你正在做的事。
你舉手，牠也舉手；你不動，牠也不動。

想抓牠一個把柄都沒辦法，因為牠只會抄你剛剛做過的每一件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 刷牙洗臉盯著鏡子放空的時候，最適合冒出這種念頭
variations: 你想跟鏡子玩剪刀石頭布，永遠都會平手。
鏡子裡的人比你還了解你，因為牠一直在看著你。

en.content:
The you in the mirror is always doing exactly what you're doing.
You raise a hand, it raises a hand; you hold still, it holds still.

You can't even catch it slipping up, because all it ever does is copy whatever you just did.
en.editorNote: The kind of thought that shows up while you're brushing your teeth and zoning out at your reflection
variations: Try playing rock-paper-scissors with the mirror and you'll tie every single time.
The person in the mirror knows you better than you do, because they've been watching you the whole time.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學貧窮主題例句，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
你知道我為什麼存不到錢嗎？
經過縝密的研究之後，我得出一個結論：因為我沒錢。

這個答案雖然簡單，但目前找不到反例。
zh-tw.editorNote: 月底看到帳戶餘額時，最適合說給自己聽的一句話
variations: 想變有錢的第一步，就是要先有錢，這一步卡住的人特別多。
我不是不會理財，是我沒有財可以理。

en.content:
You want to know why I can't save money?
After careful research, I reached a conclusion: it's because I have no money.

The answer is simple, but so far nobody's found a counterexample.
en.editorNote: The line to mutter to yourself when you check your balance at the end of the month
variations: Step one to getting rich is already having money — a lot of people get stuck right there.
It's not that I'm bad with money. It's that I have no money to be bad with.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學聰明主題例句，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
根據我多年的觀察，越聰明的人，腦子就越聰明。
而腦子越聰明的人，通常也越聰明。

這是一個環環相扣、無法反駁的道理。
zh-tw.editorNote: 同事講了一句很有道理的廢話時，可以用這句無縫接上
variations: 會思考的人通常都很有想法，因為沒想法的人根本不會思考。
腦筋動得快的人，反應通常都不會太慢。

en.content:
Based on years of observation, the smarter a person is, the smarter their brain tends to be.
And people with smarter brains are, generally, smarter.

It's an airtight, self-reinforcing truth you simply cannot argue with.
en.editorNote: The perfect follow-up when a coworker says something that sounds profound but means nothing
variations: People who think a lot usually have a lot of ideas, because people with no ideas don't bother thinking.
Quick thinkers rarely react slowly.

items.sourceNote: 日本廢話語錄季節主題，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
跟你在一起的夏天，比冬天還要熱。
這一點也不奇怪，因為夏天本來就比冬天熱。

無論你在不在，這個規律都成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想對喜歡的人講情話，又想搞笑破壞氣氛時的萬用句
variations: 冬天的時候只要多穿一點，通常就不會那麼冷。
夏天之所以熱，是因為它不是冬天。

en.content:
Summers with you are hotter than winters.
This is not surprising at all, because summer is naturally hotter than winter.

The rule holds whether you're here or not.
en.editorNote: For when you want to say something sweet to your crush and then immediately ruin the moment
variations: In winter, if you just wear a bit more, you usually won't feel as cold.
The reason summer is hot is that it isn't winter.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學時間主題例句，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
七天沒見，感覺就像過了一個禮拜。
仔細算一算，其實還真的就是一個禮拜。

時間有時候就是這麼精準，讓人不得不佩服。
zh-tw.editorNote: 許久沒聯絡的朋友突然敲你時，回這句最能延續尷尬又好笑的氣氛
variations: 放假七天過得特別快，快到剛好只有七天。
等了一年，終於又過了三百六十五天。

en.content:
Haven't seen you in seven days — feels like a whole week.
And if you do the math, it turns out it really has been exactly one week.

Sometimes time is just that precise, and you have to respect it.
en.editorNote: The ideal reply when a friend you haven't talked to in ages suddenly messages you
variations: A seven-day vacation flies by so fast it lasts exactly seven days.
After waiting a whole year, another 365 days have finally passed.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學金錢消費主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
所謂打八折，就是原價的八成你還是得付。
那省下來的兩成，其實是你本來就不用花的錢。

所以打折的意思是，你花了錢，卻覺得自己賺到了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友炫耀特價戰利品時傳這句，能讓對方的購物慾提早冷靜下來
