variations: 買一送一，就是你買了兩個，付了其中一個的錢，然後家裡多了兩個。
限時特價的重點在於，過了那個時間，它就不特價了。

en.content:
A 20-percent-off deal means you still pay 80 percent of the price.
And the 20 percent you 'saved' was money you were never going to spend anyway.

So a discount is when you spend money and somehow feel richer.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend bragging about their sale haul and watch the buyer's remorse arrive early
variations: Buy one get one free means you bought two, paid for one of the two, and now own two.
A limited-time offer is special right up until the time runs out, at which point it stops being special.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學科技日常主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
手機連上 wifi 之後，網路才會變快。
如果沒連上，那速度就跟沒連上的時候一樣。

所以想讓網路變快，第一步就是先讓它連上網路。
zh-tw.editorNote: 有人抱怨網路很慢的時候丟這句，幫不上忙但非常有道理
variations: 密碼輸入正確就會連上，輸入錯誤就是還沒連上。
訊號滿格的時候通常收訊很好，沒有格數的時候情況正好相反。

en.content:
Your phone gets faster internet once it connects to the wifi.
If it doesn't connect, the speed stays exactly the same as not being connected.

So the first step to faster internet is getting it connected to the internet.
en.editorNote: Drop this when someone complains their wifi is slow — zero help, fully correct
variations: Enter the password correctly and it connects; enter it wrong and it's still not connected.
Full signal bars usually mean good reception, and no bars mean the exact opposite.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學科技客服主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
電腦壞掉的時候，重開機通常會好。
如果重開機還是不會好，那就代表它還沒好。

所有工程師的智慧，就濃縮在這一個動作裡：先關掉，再打開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 當免費客服的救命金句，適合傳給任何電子產品出狀況的親戚
variations: 關機再開機，就是把它關掉之後，再把它打開。
如果重開一次沒用，那就再重開一次，直到它有用，或直到你放棄。

en.content:
When your computer breaks, restarting it usually fixes it.
If restarting doesn't fix it, that just means it isn't fixed yet.

All of tech support wisdom fits into one move: turn it off, then turn it on.
en.editorNote: The lifesaving line of every help desk — forward it to any relative whose gadget is acting up
variations: Turning it off and on again means switching it off, and then switching it on.
If restarting once doesn't work, restart again, until it works or until you give up.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學生日年紀主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
過完生日的隔天，你就比生日前大了一歲。
不過就算你不過生日，時間也不會因此停下來等你。

所以慶生的重點，不是你變老了，而是你剛好記得這件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友哀嚎又老一歲的時候傳這句，安慰效果為零但誠意十足
variations: 每年生日你都會長一歲，這是目前還無法取消的訂閱制。
不慶祝生日的人一樣會變老，只是少吃了一塊蛋糕。

en.content:
The day after your birthday, you're one year older than you were before it.
But even if you skip your birthday, time won't stop to wait for you.

So a birthday party isn't about getting older — it's about happening to remember that you did.
en.editorNote: Send this when a friend groans about turning another year older — zero comfort, maximum sincerity
variations: Every birthday you gain a year — a subscription you currently cannot cancel.
People who don't celebrate birthdays still get older; they just miss out on the cake.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學日常物件主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
戴上耳機之後，你就聽得到耳機裡的聲音。
只戴一邊的話，就只有那一邊聽得到。

這個現象，在左耳和右耳都各自得到了驗證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 跟朋友分耳機聽同一首歌時傳這句，非常適合破壞當下的氣氛
variations: 把音量調大，聲音就會變大；調小，聲音就會變小。這是耳機的基本共識。
沒插上的耳機通常不會有聲音，插上之後情況就反過來了。

en.content:
Once you put on headphones, you can hear whatever's playing in them.
Wear just one side, and only that one side can hear it.

This effect has been independently confirmed in both the left ear and the right ear.
en.editorNote: Text this while sharing an earbud with a friend — perfectly calibrated to ruin the moment
variations: Turn the volume up and it gets louder; turn it down and it gets quieter. This is the basic consensus of headphones.
Unplugged headphones usually make no sound, and once plugged in the situation reverses.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學自我指涉名言主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
古人有云，而且古人真的很愛云。
至於他們到底云了什麼，這個問題就要去問古人了。

可惜的是，古人現在已經不太方便回答。
zh-tw.editorNote: 引用名言想裝有學問、結果忘記後半句時最好用，一秒把場面圓回來
variations: 俗話說得好，好在哪裡俗話沒有說，但它就是說得很好。
老話一句：老話通常都只有一句，多的那些其實是新話。

en.content:
As the ancients used to say — and the ancients really did love to say things.
As for what exactly they said, you'd have to ask the ancients.

Unfortunately, the ancients are not currently available for questions.
en.editorNote: Perfect for when you quote something wise to sound smart and then forget the second half
variations: As the old saying goes: there is an old saying, and it goes.
Wise people say wise things — that's largely how we know they're wise people.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學能力習得主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
當你通過了考試，你就從沒通過的人，變成了通過的人。
而在你通過之前，你都還是沒通過的那個人。

這個身分的轉換，會在你通過的那一刻正式生效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友考完試在等成績時傳這句，安慰不到位但保證讓對方笑出來
variations: 當你學會了游泳，你就擁有了會游泳這項技能；在那之前你只擁有不會游泳這件事。
考過駕照的人都會開車，這件事在沒考過的人身上剛好不成立。

en.content:
The moment you pass the exam, you go from being someone who hasn't passed to being someone who has.
Until then, you remain the person who hasn't.

This change of status takes effect precisely at the moment you pass.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend sweating over exam results — useless as comfort, guaranteed to get a laugh
variations: Once you learn to swim, you gain the skill of swimming; before that, you only have the skill of not swimming.
Everyone who passed their driving test can drive — a fact that conveniently fails for everyone who didn't.

items.sourceNote: 幹話語錄身分自嘲主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
我早就不是三年前那個存不到錢的人了。
我是今年這個存不到錢的人。

人是會成長的，只是存款不一定會跟上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 過年被親戚問今年存了多少時，用這句自我介紹最能穩住陣腳
variations: 我已經走出上一段低潮了，然後平順地走進了下一段。
我跟去年的自己完全不一樣了，我變成了老一歲又更窮的自己。

en.content:
I'm no longer the guy who couldn't save money three years ago.
I'm this year's guy who can't save money.

People grow — the bank balance just doesn't always keep up.
en.editorNote: The ideal self-introduction when a relative asks how much you've saved this year
variations: I've officially moved on from my last rough patch, straight into the next one.
I'm nothing like the person I was last year — I'm a year older and somehow broker.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學付出與機會主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
只要你願意多花一點時間了解我，
你就會發現，你多花了一點時間。

至於了解到什麼，那就是另一段時間的事了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 自我介紹或告白想裝深情時丟這句，深情值瞬間歸零但笑點滿分
variations: 只要你肯給我一次機會，你就會用掉一次機會。
多認識我一天，你就會多認識我一天，這是很划算的投資。

en.content:
If you're willing to spend a little more time getting to know me,
you'll discover that you've spent a little more time.

What you actually learn is a matter for some other stretch of time.
en.editorNote: Drop this mid-confession when you're trying to sound deep — sincerity hits zero, laughs hit max
variations: Just give me one chance, and you'll have used up one chance.
Get to know me for one more day and you'll know me for one more day — a truly worthwhile investment.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學研究調查格式，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
最新研究指出，每天早上有喝水的人，
比沒喝水的人，多喝了一杯水。

研究團隊表示，這個結果目前非常穩定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合早上在群組裡轉發，讓大家醒來第一件事就是懷疑人生
variations: 調查發現，每天走路上班的人，通常都有走路。
數據顯示，早睡的人比晚睡的人，更早睡。

en.content:
A new study finds that people who drink water each morning
drink one more glass of water than people who don't.

Researchers say the finding has proven remarkably stable.
en.editorNote: Forward it to a group chat at dawn so everyone's first act of the day is questioning reality
variations: Surveys reveal that people who walk to work tend to do so on foot.
The data shows that early sleepers go to bed earlier than late sleepers.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
只要你還沒放棄，你就是還沒放棄的那個人。
一旦放棄了，你就會變成放棄了的人。

所以要不要放棄，其實看你要當哪一種人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友想放棄某件事來討拍時傳這句，拍不到但保證讓他愣三秒
variations: 堅持下去的人，最後都堅持了下去。
只要你活著，你就還沒有死，這件事情非常重要。

en.content:
As long as you haven't quit, you are the person who hasn't quit.
The moment you quit, you become the person who has.

So whether to quit really comes down to which person you'd rather be.
en.editorNote: Send this when a friend is fishing for sympathy about giving up — no sympathy delivered, three seconds of stunned silence guaranteed
variations: Everyone who kept going ended up having kept going.
As long as you're alive, you have not yet died — and this is deeply important.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學金錢主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
有錢人之所以有錢，是因為他們有錢。
沒錢的人剛好相反，他們沒錢。

這中間的差距，主要就在錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到理財文章講一堆大道理時，用這句總結最一針見血又最沒用
variations: 省錢最快的方法，就是不要花錢。
會賺錢的人通常都有在賺錢，這是他們的共同點。

en.content:
Rich people are rich because they have money.
Poor people are the opposite: they don't.

The gap between them comes down, mainly, to money.
en.editorNote: The perfect summary for any finance article full of grand advice — devastatingly accurate and completely useless
variations: The fastest way to save money is to not spend it.
People who make money usually make money — that's the one thing they have in common.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學時間流逝主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
轉眼間，這個週末就要開始了，
再一轉眼，它就要結束了。

中間發生了什麼，通常我們都不太記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 週日晚上發限動配這句，完美詮釋收假前的空虛感
variations: 假期最可怕的地方，就是它總有結束的一天，而且通常很快。
還沒開始放假，就已經在倒數放假結束了。

en.content:
In the blink of an eye, the weekend is about to begin,
and in another blink, it's about to end.

What happened in between, we usually can't quite recall.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a Sunday-night story post to perfectly capture that pre-Monday emptiness
variations: The scariest thing about a vacation is that it always ends — and usually fast.
The vacation hadn't even started, and I was already counting down to its end.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學讚美外貌主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
你今天長得真好看，
兩隻眼睛剛好長在臉的上半部，
一個鼻子不偏不倚，就在正中間。

這種對稱，不是每個人都做得到的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想稱讚對方又不想太肉麻時的最佳選擇，土味情話與廢話文學的完美結合
variations: 你笑起來的時候，嘴角會往上，這種細節真的很少見。
你最迷人的地方，就是你有一張臉，而且五官都在上面。

en.content:
You look really good today —
both eyes sitting neatly on the upper half of your face,
one nose, perfectly centered, not a millimeter off.

That kind of symmetry isn't something everyone can pull off.
en.editorNote: The ideal pick when you want to compliment someone without getting too mushy — cheesy pickup line meets absurd wisdom
variations: When you smile, the corners of your mouth go up — such a rare little detail.
The most captivating thing about you is that you have a face, with all your features on it.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學長話短說主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
這件事我長話短說，
但它說來話長。

所以我還是從頭講好了，反正你也沒別的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友催你講重點的時候用，保證他更想聽你把話講完
variations: 我簡單講一下，講完之後你就會發現其實一點都不簡單。
重點只有一個，就是這件事其實沒有重點。

en.content:
Let me keep this short —
it's a long story.

So I'll just start from the beginning, since you've got nothing better to do anyway.
en.editorNote: Use it when a friend tells you to get to the point — guaranteed to make them regret asking
variations: I'll make this quick, and by the end you'll realize it was never quick at all.
There's just one main point here, which is that there really isn't one.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學香蕉例句，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
把香蕉的皮剝掉之後，
你就會得到一根沒有皮的香蕉。

這個步驟，剝之前跟剝之後的差別非常明顯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 吃香蕉配這句一起發限動，朋友會開始懷疑自己的人生
variations: 橘子撥開之後裡面就是一瓣一瓣的，這點跟沒撥開的時候完全不同。
水煮蛋剝殼之後，你會發現裡面竟然是一顆蛋。

en.content:
Once you peel a banana,
you're left with a banana that has no peel.

The difference between before and after peeling is remarkably clear.
en.editorNote: Post this with your banana snack and watch your friends start questioning their whole existence
variations: Peel an orange and you'll find it's divided into segments inside — totally unlike when it's unpeeled.
Peel a boiled egg and, surprisingly, you'll discover there's an egg inside.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學聰明主題，重新改寫

zh-tw.content:
研究指出，越聰明的人，
腦子通常也越聰明。

而腦子越聰明的人，想事情的時候也越聰明。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拿去稱讚同事，他會不確定你是在誇他還是在酸他
variations: 會讀書的人，考試的時候通常都比較會寫。
跑得快的人，只要一跑起來，速度就會比較快。

en.content:
Studies show that the smarter a person is,
the smarter their brain usually is.

And the smarter the brain, the smarter they tend to think.
en.editorNote: Say it to a coworker and they won't be sure whether you're praising or roasting them
variations: People who are good at studying usually do better when they take the test.
People who run fast tend to move faster the moment they start running.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學閱讀當下主題，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
當你看到這行字的時候，
就代表你正在看這行字。

而當你看完之後，你就看完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼在文章開頭當免責聲明，讀者會忍不住讀第二次確認自己有沒有讀懂
variations: 只要你把這句話讀完，你就會知道這句話已經被你讀完了。
看不懂沒關係，因為看得懂的人也不一定看得懂。

en.content:
The moment you read this line,
it means you are currently reading this line.

And once you've finished, you're finished.
en.editorNote: Stick it at the top of a post as a disclaimer — readers will re-read it just to check they understood
variations: As soon as you finish reading this sentence, you'll know this sentence has been read by you.
It's fine if you don't get it, because the people who get it don't necessarily get it either.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
導航系統說明：如果你走錯路，它就會重新規劃路線。
如果你沒走錯，它就不需要重新規劃。

至於那句「請在前方迴轉」，
意思是你剛剛已經錯過了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在車上被導航碎念的時候唸出來，可以有效緩和駕駛的情緒
variations: 導航說再開三百公尺就到，代表你現在還沒到。
只要你照著導航走，你就是在照著導航走。

en.content:
Your GPS explains: if you take a wrong turn, it will recalculate the route.
If you don't, there's nothing to recalculate.

As for "make a U-turn ahead" —
that means you already missed it.
en.editorNote: Read it out loud when the GPS is nagging the driver; defuses the mood better than backseat directions
variations: When the GPS says "arriving in 300 meters," it means you have not arrived.
As long as you follow the GPS, you are following the GPS.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學公告體格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
售票網站公告：搶到票的人會有票，沒搶到的人則不會有票。

至於候補名單，
它的功能是讓你在沒有票的狀態下，
繼續等待一張票。
zh-tw.editorNote: 搶票失敗的隔天貼限時動態，比單純抱怨系統更能引起共鳴
variations: 系統顯示「已售完」，意思是票已經賣完了。
手速快的人，通常比手速慢的人快。

en.content:
Ticketing site notice: people who got tickets have tickets. People who didn't, don't.

As for the waitlist,
its function is to let you keep waiting for a ticket
while not having one.
en.editorNote: Post it the morning after a failed ticket rush — lands better than yelling at the queue system
variations: "Sold out" means the tickets have been sold out.
People with fast fingers are typically faster than people with slow ones.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學幽默手法分析參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
健檢報告指出：有紅字的項目是有問題的，
沒有紅字的項目則暫時沒有問題。

醫生建議多運動、少熬夜、飲食均衡。
這三件事，剛好就是你做不到的那三件。
zh-tw.editorNote: 收到健檢報告後傳給同樣在逃避的朋友，比互相加油實用
variations: 醫生說要多休息，但沒說要怎麼在有工作的情況下多休息。
檢查出來沒問題，代表這次沒有檢查出問題。

en.content:
Your health report notes: the items flagged in red are the problems.
The ones not flagged are fine for now.

The doctor recommends more exercise, less staying up late, and a balanced diet.
Those happen to be exactly the three things you can't do.
en.editorNote: Forward it to the friend who's also avoiding their results — more honest than mutual encouragement
variations: The doctor says to rest more, but not how to rest more while still having a job.
Nothing showed up on the scan, meaning nothing showed up this time.

items.sourceNote: 幹話語錄格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
停車場的規則很簡單：有空位的時候你可以停，沒空位的時候你不能停。

而根據長期觀察，
你到的時候通常是後者。

等你繞完第三圈，前面那台車才會走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在繞停車場繞到快發火的駕駛，讓他知道這是普遍現象
variations: 找不到車位的原因，是車位都已經被找到了。
你停得越遠，就會走得越久。

en.content:
Parking lots run on a simple rule: if there's a space, you can park. If there isn't, you can't.

Long-term observation shows
you usually arrive during the second scenario.

The car ahead of you only pulls out after your third lap.
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever is circling level B3 for the fourth time — solidarity beats advice here
variations: The reason you can't find a spot is that all the spots have already been found.
The farther you park, the longer you walk.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 幽默格式參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
廠商表示：保固期內壞掉的，屬於保固範圍。
保固期外壞掉的，就不屬於。

至於為什麼東西總是在保固結束後第三天壞掉，
這個問題也不在保固範圍內。
zh-tw.editorNote: 家電剛過保就陣亡的時候發文用，比直接開罵更有殺傷力
variations: 保固卡最主要的用途，是讓你知道保固什麼時候結束。
還沒壞的東西，通常都還沒壞。

en.content:
The manufacturer clarifies: anything that breaks during the warranty period is covered.
Anything that breaks after it is not.

As for why everything breaks three days after the warranty ends,
that question is also not covered.
en.editorNote: For the post you write when the appliance dies the week coverage expires — drier and sharper than a rant
variations: The main purpose of a warranty card is to tell you when the warranty ends.
Things that haven't broken yet typically haven't broken yet.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學自我指涉手法參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
字典裡收錄了所有的字。
所以當你查一個字的時候，那個字通常就在字典裡。

查不到的字，代表它還沒被收錄。
至於為什麼你要查的那個剛好沒被收錄，
字典裡也查不到答案。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合回給那種「這個字到底怎麼寫」問到一半自己放棄的朋友
variations: 不會的字查字典就好，前提是你要先知道它長什麼樣子。
字典最厚的地方，通常是中間。

en.content:
A dictionary contains every word.
So when you look one up, the word is usually already in there.

If you can't find it, that means it hasn't been added yet.
As for why the exact word you need is the one that's missing,
the dictionary has no entry for that either.
en.editorNote: For the friend who gives up halfway through spelling a word out loud
variations: To look up a word you don't know, you first have to know what it looks like.
The thickest part of a dictionary is usually somewhere in the middle.

items.sourceNote: technically-true「只能做一次」笑點參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
人生中有些事，你這輩子只能做一次。
例如：第一次。

做完第一次之後，剩下的就都是第二次以後了。
這個規律，在你活著的每一天都成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友在做某件「人生第一次」的事，想說點什麼又不想太肉麻，就傳這個
variations: 水泥你可以喝，但只能喝一次。
凡是只能做一次的事，做完之後就不能再做了。

en.content:
Some things in life you can only do once.
For example: the first time.

After the first time, everything after that is the second time or later.
This rule holds every single day you're alive.
en.editorNote: For when a friend does something 'for the first time' and you want to mark it without being sappy
variations: You can drink cement, but only once.
Anything you can only do once cannot be done again afterward.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 日常物件笑點參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
電梯的按鈕，按一下就會亮。
再按十下，它還是那一下的狀態。

研究顯示，按得越用力，電梯來的速度並不會變快。
它會在它要來的時候來。
在那之前，它不會來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那種等電梯狂戳按鈕的人，戳完他還是會繼續戳
variations: 電梯關門鍵最主要的功能，是讓你覺得你有在做事。
電梯現在停在幾樓，取決於它現在停在幾樓。

en.content:
An elevator button lights up when you press it once.
Press it ten more times and it stays in that same one-press state.

Studies show that pressing harder does not make the elevator arrive faster.
It arrives when it's going to arrive.
Until then, it does not.
en.editorNote: Send it to the person mashing the call button — they'll keep mashing it anyway
variations: The close-door button mainly exists to make you feel like you're doing something.
Which floor the elevator is on depends on which floor it's currently on.

items.sourceNote: 選擇困難日常觀察，廢話文學格式重新創作

zh-tw.content:
打開電視最花時間的部分，是決定要看什麼。

研究指出，找片的時間，經常比你真正看片的時間還長。
等你終於選好，也差不多該睡了。

所以嚴格來說，你今天看的，是選片。
zh-tw.editorNote: 週五晚上跟另一半在沙發上滑了兩小時還沒按播放的時候，特別有共鳴
variations: 片單越長，你越不知道要看什麼。
那些你收藏的「之後再看」，通常之後都不會看。

en.content:
The most time-consuming part of turning on the TV is deciding what to watch.

Studies indicate the time spent browsing often exceeds the time spent actually watching.
By the time you finally pick something, it's basically bedtime.

So strictly speaking, what you watched today was the menu.
en.editorNote: Peak relatability for the Friday night spent scrolling for two hours without hitting play
variations: The longer your watchlist, the less you know what to watch.
The things you save for 'later' usually stay in 'later' forever.

items.sourceNote: technically-true 交通觀察，廢話文學格式重新創作

zh-tw.content:
塞車的時候，車子開得比較慢。
不塞的時候，就開得比較快。

交通專家長期觀察後發現：
你趕時間的那一天，通常屬於前者。

至於為什麼你不趕的時候路都很順，
這也是塞車的一部分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 上班快遲到又卡在車陣裡的時候發限動用，配一張前面一排紅色煞車燈剛好
variations: 前面的車不動，你的車通常也動不了。
你切過去的那條車道，會在你切過去之後開始塞。

en.content:
In a traffic jam, cars move slowly.
When there's no jam, they move faster.

After years of observation, traffic experts have concluded:
the day you're in a hurry usually belongs to the first category.

As for why the roads are always clear when you're not in a rush,
that too is part of the jam.
en.editorNote: Post it to your story while stuck in traffic and nearly late — pairs well with a shot of red brake lights ahead
variations: When the car ahead of you isn't moving, your car usually isn't either.
The lane you switch into starts backing up right after you switch.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重覆敘述法，原創微波爐主題

zh-tw.content:
微波爐的原理其實很簡單：
把冷掉的食物放進去，加熱之後，它就變熱了。

如果拿出來還是冷的，
那就代表你剛剛忘了按開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給在廚房對著微波爐發呆、還在等它自己動起來的室友
variations: 微波之後如果外面燙、裡面冰，那就代表它熱了一半，也還有一半沒熱。
食物加熱到冒煙就是熱了，加熱到爆炸就是熱過頭了。

en.content:
The microwave works on a very simple principle:
put cold food in, heat it, and it comes out warm.

If it comes out cold,
that means you forgot to press start.
en.editorNote: Send this to the roommate blankly staring into the microwave, waiting for it to start on its own
variations: If it's scalding on the outside and frozen in the middle, that means it's half heated and half still not.
When it starts steaming, it's warm. When it starts exploding, it's a little too warm.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學無邏輯串聯法，原創下載進度條主題

zh-tw.content:
下載進度條跑到 100% 的時候，
就代表它已經下載完了。

如果卡在 99% 不動，
那剩下的那 1%，
就是它決定讓你等最久的那 1%。
zh-tw.editorNote: 深夜盯著檔案下載、進度條卡住不動的時候發限動最有共鳴
variations: 進度條跑得越快，通常代表快好了；跑得越慢，代表它想再陪你久一點。
剩下三秒的意思是，它其實也不知道還要多久。

en.content:
When the download bar reaches 100%,
that means it has finished downloading.

If it's stuck at 99%,
that last 1% is simply the 1% it has decided to make you wait the longest for.
en.editorNote: Peak relatability while watching a download bar freeze at 2am
variations: The faster the bar moves, the closer it is to done. The slower it moves, the more it wants to spend time with you.
"3 seconds remaining" means it honestly has no idea how long it'll take.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重覆敘述法，原創排隊叫號主題

zh-tw.content:
抽號碼牌的規則其實很公平：
你前面的號碼都會比你早被叫到，
你後面的號碼都會比你晚。

所以只要你一直等，
總有一刻，會輪到你。

除非你在那之前就先走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在銀行、醫院、監理站排隊叫號時，傳給同樣在乾等的朋友
variations: 叫號的速度你控制不了，你唯一能控制的，是要不要繼續坐在那裡等。
你前面還有幾號，取決於你前面還有幾個人。

en.content:
The ticket system is perfectly fair:
every number ahead of you gets called before you,
and every number behind you gets called after.

So as long as you keep waiting,
your turn will eventually come.

Unless you leave before it does.
en.editorNote: For anyone clutching a paper ticket at the bank, clinic, or DMV
variations: You can't control how fast they call the numbers. The only thing you control is whether you keep sitting there.
How many numbers are ahead of you depends entirely on how many people are ahead of you.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創廣告倒數主題

zh-tw.content:
影片播到一半跳出的廣告，通常會寫著「五秒後可略過」。
於是你認真等了五秒，
它就真的可以略過了。

如果按鈕還沒亮，
那代表五秒還沒到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看 YouTube 被廣告打斷時，傳給一起等倒數的朋友
variations: 廣告最珍貴的就是那五秒，因為過了那五秒，你就不用再看它了。
略過鍵之所以叫略過鍵，是因為按下去，你就把它略過了。

en.content:
The ad that cuts into your video usually says "Skip in 5 seconds."
So you wait, patiently, for five seconds,
and then you can skip it.

If the button hasn't lit up yet,
that just means five seconds haven't passed.
en.editorNote: Send this to a friend while you're both waiting out a YouTube pre-roll
variations: The most precious part of any ad is those five seconds, because once they're over, you never have to see it again.
The skip button is called the skip button because pressing it skips the ad.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重覆敘述法，原創發票對獎主題

zh-tw.content:
發票對獎的規則其實很單純：
號碼對得上就是中獎，
號碼對不上就是沒中。

這個月沒中的人，
通常是因為手上那幾張，號碼都沒對上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 每逢單月 25 日對統一發票落空時，傳給一起摃龜的朋友
variations: 中獎的發票會讓你有錢領，沒中的發票則不會。
你之所以每期都沒中，最主要的原因是你的號碼跟中獎號碼不一樣。

en.content:
The receipt lottery works on a simple rule:
if your numbers match, you win,
and if they don't, you don't.

The people who didn't win this month
mostly had receipts whose numbers didn't match.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just checked their lottery numbers and came up empty again
variations: A winning ticket gets you money. A losing ticket does not.
The main reason you never win is that your numbers keep being different from the winning ones.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創手扶梯主題

zh-tw.content:
站上手扶梯之後，就算你完全不動，
它也會慢慢把你送到另一層樓。

如果你站著沒動，卻一直到不了下一層，
那你踩的很可能是一般的樓梯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在捷運站或百貨公司站手扶梯放空時，傳給也在放空的朋友
variations: 手扶梯最貼心的地方，就是你不走，它替你走。
手扶梯往上的時候會把你載上去，往下的時候會把你載下來。

en.content:
Once you step onto an escalator, even if you don't move a muscle,
it will slowly carry you to the next floor.

If you stand perfectly still and never reach the next floor,
there's a good chance you're standing on ordinary stairs.
en.editorNote: For zoning out on the escalator at the mall or the metro station
variations: The nicest thing about an escalator is that when you don't walk, it walks for you.
An up escalator carries you up, and a down escalator carries you down.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創回音主題

zh-tw.content:
對著山谷大喊，山谷會把你剛剛喊的那句話，
原封不動地還給你。

你喊什麼，它就回你什麼。
所以如果你聽到的答案不太滿意，
可以檢查一下你剛剛喊了什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 爬山到觀景台喊回音時，傳給同行的朋友討論人生
variations: 回音的內容，取決於你原本喊了什麼。
山不會亂回話，你喊「你好」，它絕對不會回你「再見」。

en.content:
Shout into a valley, and the valley will hand you back
the exact words you just shouted.

Whatever you yell, it yells right back.
So if you're not happy with the answer,
you might want to check what you shouted.
en.editorNote: For that moment at the lookout when someone tests the echo
variations: What the echo says depends entirely on what you said first.
A mountain never improvises. Shout "hello" and it will never answer "goodbye."

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創冰塊融化主題

zh-tw.content:
把冰塊放在室溫下夠久，
它就會變成一灘水。

如果放了半天還沒融化，
那代表現在還不夠久。

請繼續等，它遲早會融的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天飲料冰塊化光時，傳給一起等冰塊融化的朋友
variations: 冰塊之所以還是冰塊，是因為它還沒變成水。
融化後的冰塊，喝起來會比較不冰。

en.content:
Leave an ice cube out at room temperature long enough,
and it turns into a little puddle of water.

If it hasn't melted after a while,
that just means it hasn't been long enough.

Keep waiting. It'll melt eventually.
en.editorNote: For that summer moment when the ice in your drink is halfway gone
variations: The reason an ice cube is still an ice cube is that it hasn't become water yet.
A melted ice cube tastes noticeably less cold.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創颱風假主題（2026 米克拉颱風季）

zh-tw.content:
颱風假到底放不放，其實判斷方式很明確：
有宣布停班停課，就是放；
沒有宣布，就是照常上班。

所以你今天之所以還坐在辦公室，
最主要的原因是你們縣市沒有出現在那份名單上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 颱風逼近、全公司狂重整停班停課公告時，丟進公司群組
variations: 有放颱風假的縣市會放假，沒放的縣市則不會。
颱風假最難預測的地方，在於它公布之前沒有人知道。

en.content:
Whether you get a typhoon day comes down to one clear rule:
if they announce the closure, you're off;
if they don't, you're working.

So the main reason you're still at your desk today
is that your city wasn't on the list.
en.editorNote: For the office chat where everyone is refreshing the closure announcements
variations: Cities that call off work get the day off. Cities that don't, don't.
The hardest part about a typhoon day is that nobody knows until it's announced.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重覆敘述法，原創夏夜蚊子主題

zh-tw.content:
夏天晚上睡不好的原因，經過長期觀察，
通常是因為有蚊子。

被咬到的地方會癢，沒被咬到的地方不會癢，
所以你半夜抓的位置，就是牠去過的位置。

至於牠現在在哪，牠不會告訴你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 半夜開燈找蚊子找不到時，傳給同樣在打仗的朋友
variations: 你聽得到牠的時候，牠通常不在你打得到的地方。
打不到蚊子的主要原因，是牠咬完就飛走了。

en.content:
After extensive research, the reason you sleep badly in summer
is usually that there is a mosquito.

The spots it bit you itch. The spots it didn't bite you don't.
So wherever you're scratching at 3am is exactly where it's been.

Where it is right now, it isn't saying.
en.editorNote: For the moment you flip the light on at 3am and it has completely vanished
variations: You can hear it when it's nowhere near your hand, and not hear it when it is.
The main reason you can't swat it is that it leaves right after biting you.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創防曬與曬痕主題

zh-tw.content:
防曬乳的效果其實非常誠實：
擦到的地方不會黑，沒擦到的地方會黑。

所以夏天結束的時候，
你身上那條界線會清楚地告訴大家，
當初你的手伸到哪裡就停了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 海邊玩回來發現曬痕超明顯時，傳給一起去的朋友
variations: 曬痕就是你當初擦防曬的施工紀錄。
穿著背心去曬太陽的人，回來通常會多一件永遠脫不掉的背心。

en.content:
Sunscreen is brutally honest about its results:
the parts you covered don't tan, the parts you missed do.

So by the end of summer, the line across your shoulder
tells everyone exactly how far your hand reached
before you decided that was probably enough.
en.editorNote: For the group chat after a beach day, once the tan lines show up
variations: A tan line is just a permanent record of where you stopped applying.
Wear a tank top in the sun long enough and you'll own one you can never take off.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學嚴謹敘述法，原創追垃圾車主題

zh-tw.content:
垃圾車的運作邏輯其實很單純：
它來的時候你在，你就丟得到；
它來的時候你不在，你就丟不到。

這禮拜垃圾堆到滿出來的人，
多半是那幾天剛好都不在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 追垃圾車追到一半、聽著音樂越來越遠時，傳給同一棟的鄰居
variations: 垃圾車不會等你，主要是因為它要走了。
聽得到音樂，不代表追得到車。

en.content:
The garbage truck runs on a very simple principle:
if you're there when it comes, your trash goes;
if you're not there, it stays.

Anyone whose bin is overflowing this week
was mostly just somewhere else at the time.
en.editorNote: For the neighbor who also heard the truck's jingle fading into the distance
variations: The truck doesn't wait for you, mainly because it's leaving.
Hearing the music is not the same as catching the truck.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學重覆敘述法，原創挑西瓜主題

zh-tw.content:
挑西瓜的方法眾說紛紜，但結果只有兩種：
切開是紅的，就是甜的那種；
切開不夠紅，就是不夠甜的那種。

在切開之前，你手上拿的是一顆還沒切開的西瓜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天買西瓜準備開獎前，傳給正在敲西瓜的家人
variations: 拍起來聲音很好聽的西瓜，代表它拍起來聲音很好聽。
西瓜甜不甜要切開才知道，因為沒切開就是不知道。

en.content:
Everyone has a trick for picking a watermelon, but there are only two outcomes:
you cut it open and it's red and sweet,
or you cut it open and it isn't.

Until then, what you're holding is an unopened watermelon.
en.editorNote: For the family member thumping every melon at the market in peak summer
variations: A melon that sounds great when you knock it is a melon that sounds great when you knock it.
You can only find out how sweet it is by cutting it, because before that you can't.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件句法，原創免費試用/訂閱主題

zh-tw.content:
「免費試用 30 天」的意思其實講得很清楚：
前 30 天是免費的，第 31 天開始就不是了。

所以只要你在第 31 天之前記得取消，你就會在第 31 天之前取消。
問題是，會記得的人本來就會記得，不會記得的人就是不會記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個手機裡養著八個「早該取消」訂閱的朋友
variations: 訂閱制的邏輯很單純：你付錢的時候就會扣款，你沒發現的時候它也照樣扣款。
免費的東西之所以免費，是因為它在免費的期間內是免費的。

en.content:
"Free 30-day trial" is actually stated very clearly:
the first 30 days are free, and starting day 31, they aren't.

So as long as you remember to cancel before day 31, you'll cancel before day 31.
The catch is, the people who remember were always going to remember, and the people who forget just forget.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose phone is quietly feeding eight subscriptions they meant to cancel
variations: The logic of a subscription is simple: it charges you when you pay attention, and it charges you when you don't.
The reason the free trial is free is that it's free for as long as it's free.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學機率同義反覆法，原創降雨機率主題

zh-tw.content:
氣象預報說今天降雨機率 50%，
意思是有一半的可能會下雨，另一半的可能不會下雨。

所以真的下雨了，你就屬於會下雨的那一半；
沒下雨，你就屬於不會下雨的那一半。
你帶不帶傘，都改變不了這個機率。
zh-tw.editorNote: 早上盯著天氣 App 猶豫要不要帶傘時，傳給一起糾結的同事
variations: 降雨機率 100% 的意思是它會下雨，0% 的意思是它不會下雨，中間那些數字的意思是它可能會、也可能不會。
會下雨的那天就是有下雨的日子，不下雨的那天就是沒下雨的日子。

en.content:
The forecast says a 50% chance of rain today,
meaning there's half a chance it rains and half a chance it doesn't.

So if it rains, you're in the half where it rained;
if it doesn't, you're in the half where it didn't.
Whether you bring an umbrella changes nothing about the percentage.
en.editorNote: For the coworker staring at the weather app deciding whether to grab an umbrella
variations: A 100% chance of rain means it will rain, a 0% chance means it won't, and everything in between means it might, or might not.
The rainy day is the day it rained, and the dry day is the day it didn't.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件句法，原創集點卡主題

zh-tw.content:
集點卡的規則其實很仁慈：
集滿十點就能換一杯，集不滿十點就換不了。

而你會不會集滿，取決於你有沒有集滿。
通常在你集到第九點、離換購只差一步的那天，卡就會不見。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在錢包深處翻出一張過期集點卡時，配這句自嘲
variations: 集點的意義在於，你集了的點就是你集到的點，你沒集的點就是你沒集到的點。
差一點就能兌換的意思，就是還沒能兌換。

en.content:
Loyalty stamp cards have a very kind rule:
fill all ten stamps and you get a free cup; fall short of ten and you don't.

Whether you fill it depends on whether you fill it.
And usually, the day you hit stamp nine and you're one step from the free one, the card vanishes.
en.editorNote: For when you dig an expired stamp card out of the depths of your wallet
variations: The whole point of collecting stamps is that the stamps you collected are the ones you got, and the ones you didn't are the ones you didn't.
Being one stamp away from a free drink means you don't have the free drink yet.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆法，原創保存期限主題

zh-tw.content:
食物的保存期限標示得很誠實：
在期限之前，它還在期限內；過了期限，它就過期了。

至於過期的東西到底還能不能吃，答案也很明確——
能吃的就能吃，不能吃的就不能吃。
zh-tw.editorNote: 站在冰箱前對著一盒可疑優格猶豫時，傳給同住的人一起做決定
variations: 保存期限的意思就是，在它壞掉之前它還沒壞，壞掉之後它就壞了。
越接近有效期的食物，離過期就越近。

en.content:
Expiration dates are refreshingly honest:
before the date, it hasn't expired; after the date, it has.

As for whether expired food is still safe to eat, the answer is equally clear —
the safe ones are safe, and the unsafe ones aren't.
en.editorNote: For standing at the fridge debating a suspicious tub of yogurt with your roommate
variations: An expiration date just means that before it goes bad it hasn't gone bad, and after it goes bad it has.
The closer a food is to its use-by date, the closer it is to expiring.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創驗證碼主題

zh-tw.content:
網站要你輸入驗證碼，來證明「你不是機器人」。
而證明的方式其實很簡單：輸入對了，你就通過了；輸入錯了，你就再試一次。

至於那串扭曲到看不懂的文字——
看得懂的人看得懂，看不懂的人看不懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第三次被驗證碼判定為機器人、氣到想砸鍵盤時傳出去
variations: 驗證碼的意義在於，通過的人證明了自己會通過，沒通過的人證明了自己沒通過。
點選「所有紅綠燈」的測驗，你點對就是對，點錯就是錯。

en.content:
A website makes you type a code to prove "you're not a robot."
The proof is actually very simple: get it right and you pass; get it wrong and you try again.

As for those warped, unreadable letters —
the people who can read them can read them, and the people who can't, can't.
en.editorNote: For the moment a captcha calls you a robot for the third time and you're ready to throw the keyboard
variations: The point of a captcha is that the people who pass have proven they'll pass, and the people who fail have proven they'll fail.
On the 'click all the traffic lights' test, clicking the right ones is right and clicking the wrong ones is wrong.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創手機充電主題

zh-tw.content:
手機充電的原理其實很單純：插著的時候，電量會慢慢往上升；拔掉之後，就開始往下掉。
至於充到 100% 之後會怎樣——它就不會再往上升了，因為已經沒有更上面了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個手機永遠只剩 1% 卻死不充電的朋友
variations: 行動電源的意思是，它有電的時候可以幫你充，沒電的時候就換它等你充。
充電線接對的那一端會充電，接錯的那一端不會。

en.content:
Charging your phone works like this: plug it in and the battery slowly climbs; unplug it and it starts dropping.
And once it hits 100%? It stops climbing — because there's nowhere higher left to go.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose phone lives at 1% and still refuses to plug it in
variations: A power bank means: when it has charge it charges you, and when it's out of charge it waits for you to charge it.
The end of the cable that's plugged in correctly charges; the end that isn't, doesn't.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創鬧鐘貪睡主題

zh-tw.content:
鬧鐘的貪睡功能其實很體貼：按一下，它就會過幾分鐘再響一次；再按一下，它又會過幾分鐘再響一次。
就這樣一路按到你來不及為止。而來不及的意思是，時間已經不夠了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 星期一早上七點，傳給同樣在跟鬧鐘搏鬥的同事
variations: 設了五個鬧鐘的人，通常會被五個鬧鐘吵醒；只設一個的人，就只有一次機會。
鬧鐘響的時候你會醒，不響的時候你就繼續睡——這一點它從來沒騙過你。

en.content:
The snooze button is honestly quite thoughtful: press it once and the alarm returns in a few minutes; press it again and it returns in a few more.
You keep pressing until you're late. And 'late' means there is no longer enough time.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker also losing a fight with their alarm at 7am on a Monday
variations: People who set five alarms usually get woken by five alarms; people who set one get exactly one shot.
When the alarm rings you wake up, and when it doesn't you keep sleeping — on this the alarm has never once lied.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創訂閱制主題

zh-tw.content:
訂閱制的規則其實寫得很清楚：只要你不取消，它就會一直幫你續下去；一旦你取消了，它就不會再幫你續了。
至於你到底有沒有在用——這個問題完全不影響它繼續扣款。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對帳單發現三個忘了取消的訂閱時，傳給自己反省用
variations: 免費試用結束後開始收費，這件事在你點下訂閱的那一刻，它其實就講過了。
自動續約的意思是，你不動手，它就自動幫你動手。

en.content:
Subscriptions spell the rules out quite clearly: as long as you don't cancel, it keeps renewing you; the moment you cancel, it stops.
As for whether you actually use it — that question has no bearing whatsoever on the charge going through.
en.editorNote: For when you scan your statement and find three subscriptions you forgot to cancel
variations: That it starts charging once the free trial ends was, in fact, stated the instant you tapped subscribe.
Auto-renew means that if you don't lift a finger, it lifts one for you.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創忘記密碼主題

zh-tw.content:
忘記密碼的時候，網站會請你重設一組新的。而新密碼的規定通常是：不能跟舊的一樣。
這點對你來說毫無難度，因為你本來就不記得舊的是什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第 N 次點「忘記密碼」時，傳給也在跟登入頁面奮鬥的家人
variations: 設定密碼的規則是：你設得出來的它嫌太簡單，你記得住的它嫌太短。
系統說「這組密碼曾經使用過」，可是我連現在這組是什麼都不知道。

en.content:
When you forget your password, the site kindly asks you to reset it. And the new one usually can't be the same as the old one.
This poses no difficulty at all, seeing as you didn't remember the old one to begin with.
en.editorNote: For the Nth time you hit 'forgot password' — send to the family member also wrestling with the login screen
variations: The rule for passwords: the ones you can think up are too simple, and the ones you can remember are too short.
The system says 'you've used this password before' — but I don't even know what the current one is.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證法，原創體重計主題

zh-tw.content:
體重計是一台很誠實的機器：站上去的時候，它顯示的就是你的體重；站下來之後，它就不顯示了。
至於數字為什麼比上次多——它只負責告訴你多少，不負責解釋為什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 連假後站上體重計，需要一點心理建設時服用
variations: 少穿一件再量，數字確實會少一點，少的正好是那件衣服的重量。
體重計不會說謊，它只是把你不想面對的事，用數字講出來而已。

en.content:
A bathroom scale is an honest machine: step on it and it shows your weight; step off and it shows nothing.
As for why the number is higher than last time — it only reports the how-much, not the why.
en.editorNote: Take before stepping on the scale after the holidays, when you need to brace yourself first
variations: Weigh yourself with one less layer on and the number does drop — by exactly the weight of that layer.
A scale never lies; it just says out loud, in numbers, the thing you'd rather not face.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證，原創印表機主題

zh-tw.content:
印表機平常都很正常，只有在你趕時間的時候才會卡紙。
所以只要你不趕時間，它就不會卡紙——問題是你不趕時間的時候，也不會用到它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 會議前五分鐘印表機開始閃紅燈時，傳給同樣在崩潰的同事
variations: 印表機的墨水永遠是在你最需要的那一刻用完的，這證明它其實很懂你。
它印一百張都沒事，偏偏在第一百零一張、也就是你要交出去的那張，決定卡住。

en.content:
The printer works perfectly fine — it only jams when you're in a hurry.
So as long as you're not in a hurry, it won't jam. The catch is that when you're not in a hurry, you don't need it either.
en.editorNote: For when the printer starts blinking red five minutes before the meeting — send to the coworker also losing it
variations: The ink always runs out at the exact moment you need it most, which proves the printer understands you deeply.
It printed a hundred pages fine, then decided to jam on page one hundred and one — the one you actually had to hand in.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆，原創自動更新主題

zh-tw.content:
軟體更新的說明通常會寫：修復了已知問題。
至於那些還不知道的問題，要等下次更新的時候，你才會知道它們原來已經被這次更新製造出來了。
zh-tw.editorNote: APP 更新完反而更難用時，傳到群組表達不滿
variations: 更新前一切正常，更新後一切照舊，只是位置全都換了地方。
系統說「本次更新提升了穩定性」，翻譯過來就是：上次那個其實沒有很穩。

en.content:
Software update notes usually say: fixed known issues.
As for the unknown issues, you'll only find out about them next update — when you learn this update was the one that created them.
en.editorNote: For when an app gets worse after updating — drop it in the group chat to vent
variations: Before the update everything worked; after the update everything still works, just in a different place now.
The system says 'this update improves stability,' which translates to: the last one wasn't actually that stable.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學觀察論證，原創手機截圖主題

zh-tw.content:
你截圖是為了以後記得，可是你以後不會再打開它。
所以截圖真正的功能，是把你怕忘記的東西，安全地放到一個你永遠不會再看的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 手機跳出「儲存空間不足」，翻到一整排看不懂為什麼要留的截圖時服用
variations: 相簿裡九成是截圖，剩下一成是你截圖前不小心拍到的自己。
儲存空間滿了，代表你成功保存了很多你再也不會看的重要畫面。

en.content:
You take a screenshot so you'll remember it later, but later you never open it again.
So the real function of a screenshot is to move the thing you're afraid of forgetting somewhere you'll never look again.
en.editorNote: Take when your phone says 'storage full' and you scroll through a wall of screenshots you can't explain saving
variations: Ninety percent of your photo library is screenshots; the other ten percent is you, caught by accident right before the screenshot.
Storage full means you've successfully preserved a great many important images you will never look at again.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學因果倒置，原創電風扇主題

zh-tw.content:
電風扇讓你涼快的方法，是把原本就很熱的空氣，吹到你身上。
所以它其實沒有讓房間變涼，它只是讓熱空氣動起來，假裝有在幫忙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 大熱天只有電扇沒有冷氣時，傳給一起流汗的家人
variations: 把電扇關掉，空氣就不動了，你就會想起來剛剛其實也沒有比較涼。
電扇轉得再快，吹出來的還是這個房間的溫度，它很努力，但它無能為力。

en.content:
The way a fan cools you down is by blowing the already-hot air onto you.
So it doesn't actually cool the room — it just gets the hot air moving and pretends to help.
en.editorNote: For a scorching day with only a fan and no AC — send to the family member sweating alongside you
variations: Turn the fan off and the air stops moving, and you remember it wasn't actually any cooler a moment ago.
No matter how fast it spins, it can only blow this room's temperature at you — it's trying hard, but it's powerless.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環論證，原創折扣主題

zh-tw.content:
打折的意思是：你花錢，然後省下你本來就不用花的那部分錢。
所以買越多省越多——省下的錢，剛好等於你多花的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到「滿千送百」差點手滑下單前，傳給自己冷靜一下
variations: 特價的定義是：把價格先標高，再降回原本的價錢，然後說這是為你省的。
為了湊免運多買一件，運費是省下了，只是換成那件用不到的東西的錢。

en.content:
A discount means: you spend money, and then save the part of the money you were never going to spend anyway.
So the more you buy, the more you save — and what you save comes out to exactly what you overspent.
en.editorNote: Send to yourself to cool down right before your finger slips on a 'spend $1000 get $100 back' deal
variations: A sale price is defined as: mark it up first, drop it back to the original price, then call the difference your savings.
You add one more item to hit free shipping — you saved the shipping, just swapped it for the cost of a thing you'll never use.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季電價與夏月電費話題參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
夏天的電費帳單其實非常誠實：
你用了多少電，它就跟你收多少錢。

所以帳單變厚的那個月，
通常是你冷氣開得比較久的那個月。

至於為什麼今年比去年貴——
因為今年比較熱，而你比較怕熱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 收到夏季電費帳單、在群組哀號的時候，拿來自我安慰用
variations: 省電最有效的方法就是不要用電，可惜這個方法通常也最不涼。
電費之所以會漲，是因為那些電確實被你用掉了。

en.content:
Your summer electricity bill is brutally honest:
you use a certain amount of power, and it charges you for that amount of power.

So the month the bill gets fat
is usually the month you ran the AC longer.

As for why it's higher than last year —
it's hotter this year, and you like being cold.
en.editorNote: For the group chat where everyone is posting screenshots of their summer bill
variations: The most effective way to save power is to not use any, which is also the least cool option available.
Your bill went up because that electricity went somewhere, and that somewhere was you.

items.sourceNote: 2026 夏季高溫與體感溫度討論參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
氣象預報說今天氣溫 36 度、體感溫度 42 度。
意思是溫度計覺得是 36 度，你覺得是 42 度。

兩邊都沒有說謊，
只是被曬的那個是你，不是溫度計。
zh-tw.editorNote: 中午要走出辦公室覓食之前，先傳給同樣要出門的同事
variations: 體感溫度的意思是，實際上沒有那麼熱，但你的身體不接受這個說法。
站在太陽底下會比站在陰影下熱，這一點目前還沒有出現例外。

en.content:
The forecast says 96 degrees, feels like 108.
That means the thermometer thinks it's 96, and you think it's 108.

Neither of you is lying.
It's just that you're the one standing in the sun, and the thermometer isn't.
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever is about to walk out for lunch with you
variations: "Feels like" means it isn't actually that hot, but your body has declined to accept that.
Standing in the sun is hotter than standing in the shade. No exceptions have been reported.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學格式參考，結合手搖飲甜度冰塊日常，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
手搖飲的甜度其實標示得很清楚：
全糖就是全部的糖，半糖就是一半的糖，
無糖就是沒有糖。

所以覺得不夠甜的人，
通常是點了比較不甜的那一種。
zh-tw.editorNote: 同事在糾結甜度冰塊、遲遲不下單的時候，貼進群組
variations: 去冰的意思是把冰去掉，所以你會拿到一杯裝了比較多飲料的飲料。
微糖跟半糖差在哪？差在一個叫微糖，一個叫半糖。

en.content:
Bubble tea sweetness levels are labeled very clearly:
full sugar is all of the sugar, half sugar is half of the sugar,
and no sugar is none of the sugar.

So if your drink isn't sweet enough,
you probably ordered one of the less sweet ones.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the chat while everyone agonizes over the group order form
variations: "No ice" means the ice is removed, so you receive a cup containing more drink.
The difference between 30% sugar and 50% sugar is that one is 30% and the other is 50%.

items.sourceNote: 2026 台北 3C 家電展 AI 智慧家電話題參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
掃地機器人的效果非常明確：
它經過的地方會變乾淨，它沒經過的地方不會。

所以如果客廳掃好了、房間還是很髒，
那代表它剛剛沒有進去。

至於它為什麼卡在椅腳中間——
因為它開得進去，然後開不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 回家發現它又卡在同一個角落的時候，拍照配這段
variations: 智慧家電最智慧的地方，是它會挑你不在家的時候展現極限。
它掃不到的地方還是得你自己掃，這部分它從來沒有答應過你。

en.content:
A robot vacuum's results are perfectly clear:
the places it drove over get clean, and the places it didn't don't.

So if the living room is spotless and the bedroom isn't,
it simply never went in there.

As for why it's wedged under a chair leg —
it drove in, and then it couldn't drive out.
en.editorNote: Caption for the photo of it stuck in the same corner for the third time this week
variations: The smartest thing about smart appliances is that they reveal their limits while you're out of the house.
The spots it can't reach are still your job. It never claimed otherwise.

items.sourceNote: 2026 職場迷因與補班日話題參考，重新創作

zh-tw.content:
補班日的規則其實講得很清楚：
前面多放的那一天，要在後面補回來。

所以你這個星期六之所以要上班，
是因為你上個星期五沒有上班。

這中間並沒有多出任何一天，
它只是換了個位置放。
zh-tw.editorNote: 補班日早上七點在通勤路上，傳給同樣在路上的同事
variations: 連假之所以連得起來，是因為有一天被搬走了，而那一天就在補班日等你。
假期的天數不會憑空變多，它只會換個地方出現。

en.content:
The make-up workday rule is stated very plainly:
the extra day off up front gets paid back later.

So the reason you're working this Saturday
is that you weren't working last Friday.

No day was ever added.
It was only moved.
en.editorNote: For the 7am commute on a make-up workday, sent to whoever is on the same train
variations: A long weekend holds together because a day got borrowed, and that day is waiting for you on the make-up Saturday.
Days off don't multiply. They relocate.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學手法整理，原創共享單車站點主題

zh-tw.content:
共享單車的規則其實很清楚：
站上有車，你才借得到；
站上有空位，你才還得到。

問題是這兩件事，
通常不會發生在同一個站。

所以你多騎的那一段路，
是為了去一個你本來不用去的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在滿柱的站點前面，決定要不要再騎五分鐘去下一站時服用
variations: 借車那站沒車，還車那站沒位，中間那段路就是你今天的運動量。
站點顯示還有一台車，意思是在你走到那裡之前，它還在。

en.content:
Bike share works on a very clear rule:
you can borrow only where there's a bike,
and return only where there's an empty dock.

The trouble is that those two things
are rarely the same station.

So the extra distance you ride
is the distance to a place you never needed to go.
en.editorNote: For standing in front of a full dock, deciding whether to ride five more minutes to the next one
variations: No bike at the start, no dock at the end, and the stretch in between is your workout for the day.
The app says one bike left, which means it's still there right up until you arrive.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學句式整理，原創交通票卡加值主題

zh-tw.content:
交通卡的邏輯非常單純：
餘額夠，閘門就開；
餘額不夠，閘門就不開。

所以那一聲比較大聲的嗶，
並不是壞掉，
是它替你向後面整排人宣布了你的財務狀況。

加值完就會開了。
至於為什麼加值機前面永遠有一個人在慢慢投硬幣，
這個部分卡片不負責。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被閘門擋下來、後面還排了十個人的那個早上，傳給也遲到的人
variations: 卡片不會判斷你有沒有錢，它只會讓所有人都知道。
餘額不足的意思是，你剩下的錢比你要去的地方便宜。

en.content:
A transit card runs on very simple logic:
enough balance, the gate opens;
not enough, it doesn't.

So that louder beep isn't a malfunction.
It's the card announcing your finances
to the entire line behind you.

Top it up and the gate opens.
As for why there's always someone ahead of you
feeding coins into the machine one at a time,
the card takes no responsibility for that.
en.editorNote: For the morning the gate stops you with ten people waiting, sent to whoever else is late
variations: The card doesn't judge whether you have money. It just makes sure everyone knows.
Insufficient balance means what you have left costs less than where you're going.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學與反雞湯整理，原創除濕機主題

zh-tw.content:
除濕機的工作內容，是把空氣裡的水收進水箱。

水箱滿了，它就停下來。
你把水倒進水槽，它就繼續收。

所以你買的不是一台除濕機，
是一份把房間裡的水，用手搬到水槽的長期工作。

至於水為什麼永遠收不完——
因為你住在一座島上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第三次倒水箱、開始懷疑水是不是自己長出來的時候服用
variations: 水箱滿了代表它有在工作，水箱一直滿代表它工作得太好了。
除濕機沒有把水變不見，它只是換了一個容器讓你負責。

en.content:
A dehumidifier's job is to move water out of the air and into a tank.

When the tank fills, it stops.
You pour the water down the sink, and it starts again.

So what you bought isn't a machine.
It's a long-term position carrying water
from your bedroom to your sink by hand.

As for why the water never runs out,
you live on an island.
en.editorNote: For the third tank of the day, when you start suspecting the water is growing on its own
variations: A full tank means it's working. A permanently full tank means it's working too well.
The dehumidifier doesn't make water disappear. It just picks a container you're responsible for.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆句式參考，原創水槽洗碗主題

zh-tw.content:
水槽裡的碗會變多，是因為有人把碗放進去。
水槽裡的碗會變少，是因為有人把碗洗掉。

這兩件事通常不是同一個人做的，
但在你一個人住的情況下，
它們是同一個人做的。

所以你不是在跟室友對抗，
你是在跟三小時前的自己對抗。
zh-tw.editorNote: 站在水槽前面、正在決定今天到底要不要洗的時候，傳給同樣有一座碗山的朋友
variations: 「等一下再洗」的意思是，等一下會有一個人要洗，而那個人是你。
泡水的碗不會變乾淨，它只會變成一個泡過水的髒碗。

en.content:
Dishes in the sink increase because someone puts them there.
Dishes in the sink decrease because someone washes them.

Usually those are two different people.
When you live alone, they are the same person.

So you're not in a standoff with your roommate.
You're in a standoff with yourself from three hours ago.
en.editorNote: For standing at the sink deciding whether today is a washing day, sent to whoever else has a pile
variations: "I'll do them later" means someone will do them later, and that someone is you.
Soaking a dish doesn't make it clean. It makes it a dirty dish that has been soaked.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學與反雞湯手法整理，原創夏季跳電主題

zh-tw.content:
跳電的原因其實查得出來：
你同時開了冷氣、電磁爐和烘衣機，
然後電就不夠了。

處理方式也很單純，
去把總開關推回去，電就回來了。

比較麻煩的是，
你要在漆黑的走廊裡找手電筒，
而手電筒在你手機裡，
手機正在充電，
那個插座剛剛跳掉了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 今年夏天第三次跳電、你已經背下總開關位置的時候，傳給同住的人
variations: 家裡的電器可以同時開很多台，但只能開到電夠用為止。
跳電不是電不見了，是電在提醒你它一直都有上限。

en.content:
You can usually work out why the power tripped:
you ran the AC, the cooktop and the dryer at the same time,
and then there wasn't enough of it.

The fix is simple too.
Push the breaker back up and the power returns.

The awkward part is the dark hallway,
where you go looking for a flashlight
that lives inside your phone,
which is charging,
in the outlet that just went out.
en.editorNote: For the third outage of the summer, when you've memorized where the breaker box is
variations: You can run as many appliances as you want, right up until you can't.
A tripped breaker isn't the power vanishing. It's the power reminding you it always had a ceiling.

items.sourceNote: 廢話語錄討論串語感參考，原創餐廳候位主題

zh-tw.content:
店員問你幾位，你說兩位，
她就在紙上寫下一個二。

然後她說：「大概等二十分鐘喔。」

這句話的意思是，
在二十分鐘到之前，你不會有位子；
二十分鐘到了之後，你也不一定會有。

因為裡面那桌吃完才會空出來，
而他們吃完的時間，
沒有寫在你那張紙上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 站在店門口第十八分鐘、開始偷看裡面那桌吃到哪裡的時候
variations: 排在你前面的人會比你先有位子，這也是他們排在前面的原因。
「快好了」是店家用來描述時間的單位，長度不固定。

en.content:
The host asks how many, you say two,
and she writes a 2 on the list.

Then she says, "About twenty minutes."

What that means is:
before twenty minutes are up, you have no table;
after twenty minutes are up, you might still not.

A table opens when the people at it finish,
and the time they finish
is not written anywhere on that list.
en.editorNote: For minute eighteen outside the door, when you start tracking how far along the table by the window is
variations: The people ahead of you get seated before you. That is what being ahead of you means.
"Almost ready" is a unit of time used by restaurants. Its length is not fixed.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學六大幽默手法整理，原創電鍋主題

zh-tw.content:
電鍋的用法，長輩已經講過很多次：
外鍋一杯水，開關按下去，跳起來就是好了。

問題是那一杯水到底是多大的杯，
從來沒有人說得清楚。

而且跳起來只代表水乾了，
不代表裡面的東西熟了。

所以電鍋量的其實不是時間，
是你對「一杯水」這件事的理解程度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第一次自己用電鍋蒸東西、盯著開關等它跳起來的時候
variations: 外鍋的水越多，它就蒸得越久；水少的時候，它會提早結束這段關係。
電鍋不會判斷食物熟了沒，它只判斷水還在不在。

en.content:
Everyone's family explains the steamer the same way:
one cup of water in the outer pot, press the switch, it's done when it pops up.

The problem is that nobody has ever agreed
on how big the cup is.

And popping up only means the water is gone,
not that the food is cooked.

So what the pot is actually measuring
is your personal understanding of "one cup."
en.editorNote: For the first time you steam something yourself, staring at the switch waiting for it to click
variations: More water means a longer cook. Less water means it ends the relationship early.
The pot can't tell whether the food is done. It can only tell whether the water is still there.

items.sourceNote: 幹話語錄討論串語感參考，原創夏季曬衣與午後雷陣雨主題

zh-tw.content:
衣服要乾，需要太陽。
有太陽的時候，衣服就會乾。

所以夏天晾衣服的判斷方式很簡單：
早上出太陽，你就把衣服拿出去；
下午打雷，你就把衣服拿回來。

拿回來的衣服比拿出去的時候還濕，
但這不算失敗，
這是曬衣服的完整流程。
zh-tw.editorNote: 下午三點聽到第一聲雷、從辦公室傳訊息叫家人去收衣服的那個瞬間
variations: 陽台上的衣服會不會乾，取決於天氣，不取決於你有多需要那一件。
你明天要穿的那件，永遠是最厚的，也永遠是最後乾的。

en.content:
Clothes need sun to dry.
When there is sun, they dry.

So hanging laundry in summer is simple:
sun in the morning, you put the clothes out;
thunder at three, you bring them back in.

What comes back in is wetter than what went out,
but that isn't a failed attempt at drying laundry.
That is the full laundry process.
en.editorNote: For the first clap of thunder at three, when you text home to get the laundry off the balcony
variations: Whether the balcony dries your clothes depends on the weather, not on how badly you need that shirt.
The one you need tomorrow is always the thickest, and always the last to dry.

items.sourceNote: 2026 中元普渡日期與公司普渡箱採購資訊參考，內容原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
公司普渡的採買原則，前輩其實都講得很清楚：
要買看起來夠豐盛的，也要買大家願意吃的。

因為好兄弟收的是心意，
箱子裡的東西，最後是同事在收。

所以拜完隔天零食少了一大半，
不代表儀式特別靈驗，
代表隔壁部門昨天比較晚下班。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月底公司門口擺出供桌、香還沒燒完就有人在打量那箱洋芋片的時候
variations: 普渡買的是零食，拜的是心意，吃的是留下來加班的那幾個。
供品要準備多少，取決於部門有多少人，這個數字跟好兄弟沒有關係。

en.content:
Everyone gives the same advice about buying offerings for the office altar:
get something that looks generous, and get something people will actually eat.

The spirits receive the gesture.
The contents of the box get received by your coworkers.

So if half the snacks are gone the next morning,
that isn't proof the ritual worked.
It means the team next door stayed late.
en.editorNote: For late August, when the incense is still burning and someone is already eyeing the box of chips
variations: You buy the snacks, you offer the intention, and the people working late do the eating.
How much you prepare depends on how many people are in the department, a number the spirits had no part in setting.

items.sourceNote: 2026 學年開學日期參考（8/31 開學），內容原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
暑假為什麼會結束，原因其實寫在行事曆上：
因為八月三十一號要開學。

所以暑假不是被誰偷走的，
它從一開始就只印到那一天。

至於暑假作業，規則也很單純：
你寫或不寫，八月三十一號都會到。
差別只在於那天早上你是在睡覺，還是在寫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月最後一週，全家都在假裝沒看到那本作業簿的時候
variations: 暑假作業真正的完成時間，跟暑假有多長無關，只跟開學日的前一天有關。
放假的日子過得比較快，這件事會在收假的前一晚得到最強烈的驗證。

en.content:
Why summer break ends is printed right there on the calendar:
school starts on the thirty-first.

So nobody stole your summer.
It only ever ran up to that day.

As for the homework, the rule is just as plain:
whether you do it or not, the thirty-first arrives.
The only difference is whether you spend that morning asleep or writing.
en.editorNote: For the last week of August, when the whole family is pretending not to see the workbook
variations: When the homework actually gets done has nothing to do with how long the break was, only with the day before school.
Days off go by faster, a fact that gets its strongest confirmation the night before they end.

items.sourceNote: 幹話語錄板語感參考，原創雲端相簿儲存空間主題

zh-tw.content:
手機跳出通知說儲存空間已滿。
解決方式只有兩種：刪掉一些照片，或者付錢。

你點進相簿準備刪，
結果每一張都刪不下去，
因為當初就是覺得值得留，你才拍的。

所以你最後選了付錢。
你付的不是空間的錢，
是不用做決定的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 每個月被扣一筆小錢、卻始終沒真的進去整理過相簿的時候
variations: 照片會一直變多，是因為你一直在拍；不會變少，是因為你從來沒刪。
空間滿了有兩條路：整理，或者付錢。多數人選了比較不花時間的那條。

en.content:
Your phone says the storage is full.
There are exactly two ways out: delete some photos, or pay.

You open the album ready to delete,
and find you can't part with a single one,
because you only took them thinking they were worth keeping.

So you pay.
What you're buying isn't storage.
It's not having to decide.
en.editorNote: For the small monthly charge you keep paying without ever opening the album to sort it
variations: The photos keep piling up because you keep taking them, and never thin out because you never delete any.
Full storage leaves you two options: sort it, or pay for more. Most people pick the one that takes less time.

items.sourceNote: 台灣早餐店日常對話語感參考，內容原創

zh-tw.content:
早餐店的稱呼系統其實非常穩定：
你走進去，你就是帥哥或美女。

這個判斷不需要你抬頭，
也不需要你今天有洗頭。

至於「老樣子」這三個字，
只有天天來的人講得出來。
你三個月才出現一次，
老樣子就會變成一個問句。
zh-tw.editorNote: 早上七點半，被喊了一聲帥哥、但還沒清醒到能決定要吃什麼的時候
variations: 早餐店的美女不是一種評價，是一種招呼。
你點什麼決定你等多久，你等多久決定你幾點到公司。

en.content:
The greeting system at a breakfast shop is remarkably stable:
you walk in, and you are handsome or gorgeous.

That call gets made without you looking up,
and without you having washed your hair.

As for saying "the usual" —
only people who come in every day can pull it off.
Show up once every three months
and "the usual" turns into a question.
en.editorNote: For 7:30 a.m., when you get greeted like a celebrity and still can't decide what to order
variations: Being called gorgeous at a breakfast counter isn't a review. It's a greeting.
What you order decides how long you wait, and how long you wait decides when you get to work.

items.sourceNote: 2026 全年情人節日期整理（七夕 8/19）參考，內容原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
有人認真統計過，一年總共有十四個情人節。

這個數字的意思其實很單純：
如果你有伴，你一年要過十四次。
如果你沒有，你一年要被提醒十四次。

所以節日本身沒有立場，
它只是把你原本的狀態，
用比較大的字印出來而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月中七夕檔期的廣告開始鋪天蓋地、而你只是想安靜把這個月過完的時候
variations: 情人節會不會過，取決於你有沒有對象；情人節會不會來，跟這個完全沒有關係。
節日的數量是固定的，感受的濃度是你自己調的。

en.content:
Someone actually counted, and there are fourteen Valentine's Days in a year.

The math is straightforward:
if you're seeing someone, you celebrate fourteen times.
If you're not, you get reminded fourteen times.

The holiday doesn't take a side.
It just prints your existing situation
in a slightly larger font.
en.editorNote: For mid-August, when the ads start rolling in and you only wanted to get through the month quietly
variations: Whether you celebrate depends on whether you're with someone. Whether it arrives does not.
The number of holidays is fixed. The intensity is something you set yourself.

items.sourceNote: 中央氣象署八月氣溫統計與節氣日期參考，內容原創

zh-tw.content:
節氣表上寫著立秋，
意思是秋天從今天開始。

然後你走出門，三十六度。

這中間其實沒有矛盾：
節氣負責宣布，天氣負責發生，
這兩件事從來不需要先對過稿。

所以秋天確實已經來了，
它只是還沒通知太陽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月初日曆上冒出「立秋」兩個字、但冷氣完全不敢關的那幾天
variations: 立秋是一個日期，不是一個溫度。
節氣說到了，體感說還沒。兩邊都是對的，只是負責的部門不同。

en.content:
The almanac says autumn starts today.

Then you step outside into ninety-seven degrees.

There's no contradiction here.
The calendar announces, the weather happens,
and the two have never had to agree beforehand.

So autumn really has arrived.
It just hasn't told the sun yet.
en.editorNote: For the early-August days when the word autumn shows up on the calendar and the AC still can't be turned off
variations: The start of autumn is a date, not a temperature.
The calendar says it's here and your skin says it isn't. Both are right; they just work in different departments.

items.sourceNote: 暑假旺季訂房討論語感參考，內容原創

zh-tw.content:
業者說，暑假房價比較貴，是因為需求比較高。

需求為什麼高？因為大家都放假。
大家為什麼都放假？因為現在是暑假。

所以想同時避開人潮跟房價，
方法只有一個：
不要在放假的時候出去玩。

這個方法非常有效，
代價是你沒有假可以放。
zh-tw.editorNote: 訂房頁面顯示「僅剩一間」、價格是平日的兩倍、而你還是按下去的那三秒
variations: 淡季房價便宜，是因為那段時間你要上班。
所有人都想在同一段時間休息，這就是那段時間變貴的全部原因。

en.content:
Hotels will tell you summer rates are higher because demand is higher.

Why is demand higher? Everyone is on vacation.
Why is everyone on vacation? Because it's summer.

So there is exactly one way to dodge both the crowds and the prices:
don't travel when you have time off.

It works perfectly.
The cost is that you don't get a trip.
en.editorNote: For the three seconds after the booking page says only one room left, at twice the usual rate, and you click anyway
variations: The off-season is cheap because that's when you're at work.
Everyone wanting to rest at the same time is the entire reason that time costs more.

items.sourceNote: 台灣「車一洗就下雨」俗說語感參考，內容原創

zh-tw.content:
長輩說，車一洗就會下雨。

實際情況是這樣的：
你今年洗了十次車，其中兩次隔天下雨。
那兩次你到現在還記得，
另外八次你完全沒有印象。

所以洗車不會招雨，
只是被記住的，永遠是剛洗完的那幾台。
zh-tw.editorNote: 剛把車開出洗車場、擋風玻璃就開始出現水痕的那五分鐘
variations: 會不會下雨取決於雲，你會不會生氣取決於你剛剛花了多少錢。
沒下雨的那幾次也是真的發生過，只是沒有人會特地拿出來講。

en.content:
People swear it always rains right after you wash the car.

Here's what actually happened:
you washed it ten times this year, and twice it rained the next day.
You remember those two.
The other eight left no impression at all.

Washing the car doesn't summon rain.
Clean cars are just the ones you notice it landing on.
en.editorNote: For the five minutes between pulling out of the car wash and the first drops on the windshield
variations: Whether it rains is up to the clouds. Whether you're annoyed is up to how much you just spent.
The times it didn't rain also happened. Nobody ever brings those up.

items.sourceNote: 台灣八八父親節家庭對話語感參考，內容原創

zh-tw.content:
問爸爸父親節想要什麼，他一律回答不用。

這句「不用」的意思，通常不是真的不用，
是他懶得想。

所以你買了，他會念你亂花錢，
然後用很久。
你沒買，他什麼都不會說，
然後也記很久。

結論是：他的需求一直都在，
只是從來不出現在他的回答裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月八號前一週、家庭群組裡沒有人願意先開口說要訂位的時候
variations: 說不用的人，最後通常還是會用。
他要的其實不是禮物，是有人記得今天是幾號。

en.content:
Ask your dad what he wants for Father's Day and he'll say nothing.

Nothing, in this case, rarely means nothing.
It means he'd rather not think about it.

So if you buy something, he'll ask why you wasted the money,
and then use it for years.
If you don't, he won't say a word,
and will remember it for just as long.

The need was there the whole time.
It simply never shows up in the answer.
en.editorNote: For the week before Father's Day, when nobody in the family group chat has volunteered to book a table
variations: People who insist they don't need anything generally end up using it.
What he wants isn't the gift. It's someone remembering the date.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆句法參考，原創扭蛋抽獎主題

zh-tw.content:
扭蛋機轉出來的，一定是裡面本來就有的其中一顆。

你想要的那隻沒轉到，
是因為你轉到的是別隻。

再轉一次，機率還是一樣，
因為機率不會因為你很想要就變好。

所以那些說「下一顆一定中」的人，
講的是下一顆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友在扭蛋機前面第五次投幣的時候傳給他，比勸他省錢有效
variations: 一直轉到重複的人，就是重複轉到同一款的那個人。
保底的意思是，在保底之前你都不會保底。

en.content:
Whatever comes out of the capsule machine was already inside the capsule machine.

You didn't get the one you wanted
because you got a different one.

Try again and the odds are exactly the same,
since odds do not improve based on how badly you want something.

So when someone says the next one is guaranteed,
they are talking about the next one.
en.editorNote: For the friend feeding a fifth coin into the machine — lands better than telling them to save their money
variations: Anyone who keeps pulling duplicates is a person who keeps pulling the same one.
A pity timer means you get nothing until the pity timer.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學數字重述句型參考，原創語音訊息主題

zh-tw.content:
一段三十秒的語音訊息，需要花三十秒才聽得完。

用一點五倍速聽可以縮短到二十秒，
但那二十秒還是得聽。

最省時間的做法是直接打字，
不過會打字的人本來就不會傳語音。
zh-tw.editorNote: 群組裡有人一口氣傳七則語音的時候，貼這個比已讀不回禮貌
variations: 沒點開的語音不會自己聽完，聽完的語音也不會自己重來。
傳語音的人省下來的時間，都存到收語音的人那邊去了。

en.content:
A thirty-second voice message takes thirty seconds to hear.

Play it at 1.5x and it takes twenty,
but you still have to sit through those twenty.

The fastest option is typing it out,
though people who type were never going to send a voice note anyway.
en.editorNote: For when someone drops seven voice notes in the group chat — more polite than leaving them on read
variations: An unplayed voice note will not play itself, and a played one will not unplay itself.
The time the sender saved was simply moved over to the listener.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件重述句法參考，原創診所候診主題

zh-tw.content:
診所的叫號規則其實很好懂：
輪到你的時候就會叫你，還沒輪到就不會。

螢幕顯示你前面還有五號，
代表你是第六個。

每看完一個人，數字就少一號，
這件事目前只能靠時間解決。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在候診椅上滑手機滑到懷疑人生的時候，傳給也在等的家人
variations: 掛到最後一號的人，就是那天最晚看到醫生的那個人。
早到的人不會比較早輪到，只會比較早開始等。

en.content:
Clinic queues follow a very simple rule:
you get called when it's your turn, and not before.

If the screen says five people are ahead of you,
you are the sixth person.

Every patient who finishes drops the number by one,
and the only known way to speed this up is waiting.
en.editorNote: For the moment in the waiting room when you've scrolled your phone into an existential crisis
variations: Whoever holds the last number of the day sees the doctor last that day.
Showing up early doesn't move your turn up. It just starts your waiting sooner.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學二分法句型參考，原創二手拍賣主題

zh-tw.content:
二手拍賣的原理相當直接：
賣掉的東西就不在你家了，
沒賣掉的還在。

而根據長期統計，
你家現在的東西，全部屬於後者。

拍好照、寫好說明、標好價錢，
然後放到連你自己都忘記還在賣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 房間堆滿「總有一天要賣掉」的箱子時，傳給同樣在拖的室友
variations: 賣不掉的原因，通常是沒有人買。
你捨不得降價的東西，別人也剛好捨不得買。

en.content:
Reselling works in a very straightforward way:
whatever sells is no longer in your home,
and whatever doesn't sell still is.

According to long-term data,
everything currently in your home falls into the second group.

You photograph it, describe it, price it,
and then leave it up until you forget it was ever listed.
en.editorNote: For when your room is full of boxes labeled "selling this someday" — send it to the roommate stalling just as hard
variations: The reason an item doesn't sell is that nobody bought it.
The price you refuse to drop is the price nobody wants to pay.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學「重述既定前提」句型參考，原創演唱會安可主題

zh-tw.content:
安可的流程其實非常固定：
最後一首唱完，大家開始喊安可，
然後歌手就會走回台上，再唱幾首。

那幾首本來就寫在歌單上，
音響沒關，樂團也還沒走。

所以真正的驚喜是：
就算你不喊，他們大概還是會唱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 散場走出場館、朋友還在說「今天安可超感動」的時候傳這個
variations: 安可喊得再大聲，歌手回來的時間也差不多。
全場的燈亮起來，意思就是沒有下一首了。

en.content:
Encores follow a very reliable script:
the last song ends, the crowd starts shouting,
and the artist walks back out to play a few more.

Those songs were on the setlist the whole time.
The sound system was never off. The band never left.

So the real surprise is this:
if nobody shouted, they'd probably still play them.
en.editorNote: For the walk out of the arena, while your friend is still saying the encore gave them chills
variations: Shouting louder doesn't bring them back sooner. It brings them back on schedule.
When the house lights come up, that's the venue announcing there is no next song.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學因果重述句型參考，原創颱風囤貨主題

zh-tw.content:
颱風要來之前，超市的泡麵會先賣完。
原因很單純：大家都去買了。

真的颳風下雨那天，
你其實沒有特別想吃泡麵，
只是能不能叫到外送要看店家。

颱風走了之後，泡麵還在櫃子裡。
它會一直待在那裡，
直到下一個颱風提醒你家裡有泡麵。
zh-tw.editorNote: 海上警報一發布、群組開始討論要不要衝一趟賣場的時候貼
variations: 囤了三箱泡麵的人，颱風過後家裡就有三箱泡麵。
架上會空，是因為東西被拿走了；隔天會滿，是因為有人補上去了。

en.content:
Before a typhoon lands, the instant noodles sell out first.
The reason is simple: everyone went and bought them.

On the day the wind actually hits,
you don't especially want instant noodles.
Whether delivery shows up is a separate question.

After the storm passes, the noodles are still in the cupboard.
They stay there
until the next typhoon reminds you that you own instant noodles.
en.editorNote: For the moment a storm warning drops and the group chat starts debating a supermarket run
variations: Whoever stockpiles three boxes of noodles owns three boxes of noodles after the storm.
The shelf goes empty because people took things off it, and refills because someone put things back.

items.sourceNote: 2026 鬼門開（8/13）與鬼門關（9/10）日期查證，廢話文學句型原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
農曆七月的禁忌整理起來其實很好懂：
不要半夜曬衣服、不要下水、不要在暗處喊別人的名字。

換句話說，這個月不能做的事，
你在其他十一個月都可以做。

而這個月能做的事，
就是等這個月過完。

今年鬼門八月十三開，九月十號關。
中間那段日子，不管你信不信，
都會用一樣的速度過去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 鬼門開前一週，長輩開始在家族群組轉發禁忌長圖的時候回這個
variations: 你今年沒去海邊，可能是因為禁忌，也可能是因為你根本沒放到假。
禁忌守得再徹底，農曆七月還是農曆七月。

en.content:
The taboo list for Ghost Month is actually pretty clear:
don't hang laundry overnight, don't swim, don't call out a name in the dark.

In other words, everything you can't do this month
is something you're free to do in the other eleven.

And the one thing you can do this month
is wait for it to be over.

This year the gates open August 13 and close September 10.
The stretch in between passes at the usual speed,
believer or not.
en.editorNote: For the week before Ghost Month, when relatives start forwarding taboo lists to the family chat
variations: You skipped the beach this year. Could be the taboos, could be that you never got the days off.
Follow every rule perfectly and the seventh lunar month is still the seventh lunar month.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件重述句法參考，原創超商取貨主題

zh-tw.content:
超商取貨的規則一點都不複雜：
包裹到店之後，它就會在櫃台後面等你。

你去領，它就是你的；
你不去領，它時間到了會自己回去。

回去之後你還是想要，就得再寄一次，
而再寄一次之後，它又會到店裡等你。

所以那則「請於期限內領取」的簡訊，
講的其實就是字面上的意思。
zh-tw.editorNote: 桌上那張取貨通知快過期時，傳給同樣有包裹在店裡養老的朋友
variations: 退回的包裹不會消失，它只是回到你買它之前的地方。
店員說「這個放很久了」，意思是它放在那裡很久了。

en.content:
Convenience store pickup is not a complicated system:
once the parcel arrives, it waits behind the counter for you.

Collect it and it's yours.
Don't, and when the clock runs out it goes back on its own.

If you still want it after that, you ship it again,
and then it waits behind the counter for you again.

So the text that says "please collect before the deadline"
means exactly what it says.
en.editorNote: For when the pickup slip on your desk is about to expire — send it to the friend whose parcel is also retiring at the counter
variations: A returned parcel doesn't vanish. It goes back to where it was before you bought it.
When the clerk says it's been sitting there a while, they mean it has been sitting there a while.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆句型參考，原創暑假日記補寫主題

zh-tw.content:
暑假日記這項作業有個特點：
你每天都可以寫，但通常會留到最後幾天寫。

麻煩的是天氣欄。
整個暑假六十天的天氣，
現在得由你自己想辦法。

於是你從頭到尾都填晴天。
畢竟是暑假，這個猜法的準確率不會太低。

老師也不會發現，
因為那六十天的天氣，
他同樣沒有全部記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一週，看到姪子在餐桌上狂補日記的時候傳給家人
variations: 暑假作業的頁數，在暑假期間不會自己變少。
補了六十天的日記，實際上花了三十分鐘。

en.content:
Summer diary homework has one defining feature:
you may write it on any day, and you will write it on the last few.

The trouble is the weather column.
Sixty days of summer weather
now has to come from somewhere, and that somewhere is you.

So you write "sunny" all the way down.
It's summer, so the hit rate holds up fine.

Your teacher won't catch it either,
because nobody remembers sixty days of weather,
including the person grading it.
en.editorNote: For the week before school starts, when a kid at your dinner table is speed-running a month of diary entries
variations: The page count of your summer homework does not go down during summer.
Sixty days of catching up takes about half an hour to write.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆句型參考，原創中秋烤肉分工主題

zh-tw.content:
中秋節烤肉的分工，每年都會自己長出來：
有人負責顧火，有人負責吃。

顧火的那個人整晚站在煙裡，
吃的那些人整晚站在他旁邊，等肉熟。

因為肉要熟了才能吃，
所以在肉熟之前，大家都在等肉熟。

而等到所有人都吃飽了，
那個火才會燒得最漂亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 中秋前一週丟進烤肉群組，順便提醒大家今年還沒有人認領顧火的位置
variations: 烤肉的煙一定會往人多的地方飄，因為人多的地方就是烤肉的地方。
買了一大盒五花肉，烤完之後就會變成比較少的五花肉。

en.content:
Every Mid-Autumn barbecue sorts itself into two jobs:
someone tends the grill, and everyone else eats.

The person tending the grill stands in the smoke all night.
The people eating stand next to that person all night, waiting.

Meat has to be cooked before you can eat it,
so until the meat is cooked, everyone is waiting for the meat to cook.

And the moment everybody is finally full,
the fire starts burning beautifully.
en.editorNote: For the group chat the week before the barbecue, when nobody has volunteered to run the grill yet
variations: Smoke always drifts toward the crowd, because the crowd is standing where the grill is.
A big tray of pork belly, once grilled, becomes a smaller amount of pork belly.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環邏輯句型參考，原創推薦演算法主題

zh-tw.content:
影音平台的首頁上寫著「為你推薦」。
它推薦的，是你看過的那類東西。

你看完之後，它會更確定你喜歡那類東西，
於是推薦更多那類東西。

想看點不一樣的，你得先自己去找點不一樣的；
看完之後，它就會開始推薦不一樣的那類東西。

所以它確實很懂你。
它懂的是上一個你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 滑了四十分鐘首頁還是選不出要看什麼的晚上，傳給一起卡在選片的人
variations: 「你可能也喜歡」的意思是：你可能也喜歡，也可能不喜歡。
關掉個人化推薦，你會看到大家都在看的東西；打開，你會看到你已經在看的東西。

en.content:
The streaming app's home screen says "recommended for you."
What it recommends is more of what you already watched.

Once you watch that, it becomes more certain you like that kind of thing,
so it recommends more of that kind of thing.

To see something different, you first have to go find something different yourself.
After you watch it, the app starts recommending that kind of thing instead.

So yes, it knows you well.
It knows the previous you.
en.editorNote: For the night you scroll the home screen for forty minutes and still can't pick anything, sent to whoever is picking with you
variations: "You might also like this" means you might like it, and you might not.
Turn personalization off and you see what everyone is watching. Turn it on and you see what you are already watching.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件重述句型參考，原創喜宴紅包行情主題

zh-tw.content:
包紅包其實有個公認的算法：
看你跟對方多熟，再看你有沒有要去吃。

要去吃的包多一點，因為你會吃掉一份。
不去吃的可以包少一點，因為你沒有吃。

至於那些包了錢又沒出現的人，
他們付了一份，桌上少了一個人，
不好意思的反而變成主人家。

所以算法再怎麼算，
收到喜帖的人最後都會包。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友群組為了同一場喜宴的金額吵了三天的時候丟出來，能讓話題原地繞一圈
variations: 紅包袋上印的字都很吉利，裡面的金額才是大家在讀的部分。
去了要包，沒去也要包，差別只在有沒有吃到。

en.content:
There is a widely accepted formula for wedding cash gifts:
how close you are to the couple, times whether you are showing up to eat.

If you're going, you give more, because you will eat a seat's worth of food.
If you're not going, you can give less, because you won't.

As for the people who send money and don't come,
they paid for a seat, the table is one person short,
and somehow the hosts are the ones who feel bad about it.

Run the formula however you like:
anyone who got an invitation ends up giving.
en.editorNote: For the group chat that has spent three days debating the right number for one specific wedding
variations: The envelope has lucky words printed on the outside. The number inside is the part everyone reads.
Go and you give. Skip it and you still give. The only difference is whether you ate.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學未知數重述句型參考，原創家中蟑螂主題

zh-tw.content:
家裡出現一隻蟑螂，代表家裡有一隻蟑螂。

有人說，看到一隻就代表還有很多隻。
這句話的意思是，你沒看到的那些，你看不到。

你把牠解決掉之後，牠就不會再出現；
至於其他你沒看到的，還是沒看到。

所以這場戰役結束之後，家裡的蟑螂數量，
會從一個你不知道的數字，
變成那個你不知道的數字減一。
zh-tw.editorNote: 半夜在客廳打完一場硬仗之後，傳到家庭群組宣布戰果
variations: 蟑螂會飛這件事，你都是在牠飛起來的那一刻才知道的。
放了蟑螂藥之後，你會有一段時間看不到蟑螂，那段時間你會過得非常安心。

en.content:
Seeing a cockroach in your apartment means there is a cockroach in your apartment.

People say that if you see one, there are many more.
What that means is that the ones you didn't see are the ones you didn't see.

After you deal with this one, this one will not be back.
The ones you never saw are still ones you never saw.

So once the battle is over, the roach population of your home goes
from a number you don't know
to that same number minus one.
en.editorNote: Send it to the family group chat after winning a fight in the living room at 2 a.m.
variations: You find out a cockroach can fly at the exact moment it flies.
After you put out bait you go a while without seeing any, and that while is a wonderful time.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學狀態重述句型參考，原創月老廟求紅線主題

zh-tw.content:
七夕前的月老廟，隊伍會比平常長。
變長的原因很單純：想到要來的人，比平常多。

輪到你的時候，你會報上姓名、住的地方，
然後求一條紅線。
求到了，你身上就多了一條紅線。

紅線據說會把你和某個人連起來。
在那之前，它會先跟你的包包內袋連起來。

所以拜完之後，狀態確實有變：
你從一個沒有紅線的單身，
變成一個有紅線的單身。
zh-tw.editorNote: 陪朋友排完月老廟、兩個人走回捷運站的那段路上傳給她
variations: 今年才知道七夕原本是七娘媽生、是乞巧的日子，也就是說我前面那幾年過的，是一個我自己以為的節日。
紅線收在抽屜裡的人，和沒有紅線的人，從外面看起來是一樣的。

en.content:
Matchmaker temples get longer lines in the week before Qixi.
The lines are longer because more people thought of coming.

When your turn arrives, you give your name and where you live,
and you ask for a red string.
If you get one, you now have a red string.

The string is supposed to connect you to someone.
Until then, it connects to the inside pocket of your bag.

So the visit does change your situation.
You were single without a red string.
Now you are single with one.
en.editorNote: Send it on the walk back to the station after waiting in line with the friend who dragged you there
variations: Qixi wasn't originally a couples' holiday, so for several years I was celebrating a holiday I invented by mistake.
A red string in a drawer and no red string in a drawer look the same from outside the drawer.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學分類重述句型參考，原創記帳 app 報表主題

zh-tw.content:
記帳 app 的分類做得很完整：飲食、交通、娛樂、醫療，
最後還有一個「其他」。

前面那幾類，是你願意講清楚的部分。
「其他」，是你當下不想分類的部分。

月底打開圓餅圖，
最大的那一塊，通常不是飲食。

所以這個 app 確實幫你看見了錢的去向：
它告訴你，有一大筆錢，
花在你不想寫下來的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 月底打開記帳 app、看著圓餅圖沉默三秒的那個晚上
variations: 連續記帳三十天的成就，證明的是你連續三十天都有花錢。
有些支出你會記成「其他」，有些你會乾脆不記。後者不會出現在圓餅圖上，但會出現在餘額裡。

en.content:
Expense apps ship with tidy categories: food, transit, entertainment, health.
And then one more, called Other.

The named ones are the spending you're willing to describe.
Other is the spending you'd rather not describe, at least not tonight.

Open the pie chart at the end of the month
and the biggest slice is usually not food.

So the app really does show you where the money went.
It shows you that a large amount of it went
somewhere you didn't feel like typing out.
en.editorNote: For the night you open the app, look at the chart, and go quiet for three seconds
variations: A thirty-day logging streak proves you spent money thirty days in a row.
Some purchases get filed under Other and some never get typed in at all. The second kind stays out of the chart and shows up in the balance.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學未知數重述句型參考，原創自助餐報價主題

zh-tw.content:
自助餐的價錢，是老闆看你一眼決定的。

他掃過你的餐盤，停半秒，報一個數字。
那個數字怎麼算出來的，只有他知道；
你能做的，是把它付掉。

夾多夾少當然有差，
但差多少，沒有人說得出來。

所以自助餐真正公平的地方在於：
每個人都不知道自己為什麼付這麼多，
而且每個人都付了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 跟同事走出自助餐店、兩個人對完金額還是算不出來的中午
variations: 同一盤菜給兩個不同的老闆報，你會得到兩個數字，而且兩個聽起來都很合理。
問了「為什麼今天比較貴」，你會得到一個解釋，然後付一樣的錢。

en.content:
Cafeteria-style lunch counters price your tray by looking at it.
The owner scans the plate, pauses half a second, and says a number.

Where the number came from is between the owner and the plate.
Your part is to pay it.

Taking more food costs more, obviously.
How much more, nobody can tell you.

That is the fairness of the place:
nobody understands why they paid what they paid,
and everybody pays.
en.editorNote: For the walk back to the office when you and a coworker still can't reconstruct the math
variations: Hand the same tray to two different owners and you get two numbers, both of them reasonable.
Ask why today costs more, receive an explanation, pay the same amount anyway.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環邏輯句型參考，原創回收前先洗乾淨主題

zh-tw.content:
回收的規則裡有一條：容器要洗乾淨才能回收。

所以你會站在水槽前面，
把一個等一下就要丟掉的東西洗乾淨。

洗它要用水，而用水的目的，
是讓這個垃圾看起來不那麼像垃圾。

洗好之後丟進回收桶，它是裡面最乾淨的那一個。
然後它跟其他沒洗的一起被載走。

你洗了三分鐘的那個罐子，
和沒有人洗的那個罐子，
上的是同一台車。
差別在於，你洗過了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 洗完第五個鋁箔包、覺得自己很偉大又有點荒謬的週日晚上
variations: 「洗乾淨才能回收」這句話的意思是：沒洗乾淨的話，它就只是垃圾。
回收桶滿了之後，你會先把東西放在回收桶旁邊。那個位置的名字叫「等一下」。

en.content:
Recycling rules include one line: rinse the container first.

So you stand at the sink washing something you are about to throw away.
Rinsing it uses water, and the purpose of the water
is to make the trash look less like trash.

Into the bin it goes, where it is the cleanest object present,
and then it leaves on the same truck as everything else.

The can you rinsed for three minutes
and the can nobody rinsed
ride together.
The difference is that you rinsed yours.
en.editorNote: For the Sunday night you finish rinsing the fifth juice carton and feel both virtuous and ridiculous
variations: "Rinse before recycling" means that an unrinsed one is simply garbage.
Once the bin is full you start setting things next to the bin. That spot is named later.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件重述句型參考，原創夏天機車坐墊高溫主題

zh-tw.content:
停在太陽底下的機車，坐墊會燙。
停在陰影底下的，就不會。

所以中午回去牽車的時候，你會先用手碰一下。
碰完那一下，你就知道等一下要用什麼姿勢坐下去。

處理方式其實只有兩種：等它涼，或者不等。
不等的人，會在路口的第一個紅燈重新考慮這個決定。

至於為什麼你每次都停在同一格——
因為早上八點的時候，那一格是陰影。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月中午走到停車格前、伸手試溫度那三秒鐘，傳給同樣通勤的朋友
variations: 坐墊套的功能，是讓你在坐下去之前，多一層心理準備。
把坐墊掀起來散熱，散掉的是熱，不是時間。你還是得站在旁邊等。

en.content:
A scooter parked in the sun has a hot seat.
One parked in the shade does not.

So at noon you touch it first, with one finger.
That single touch tells you what posture you will be using for the next few minutes.

There are only two ways to handle it: wait for it to cool, or don't.
People who don't reconsider the decision at the first red light.

As for why you park in the same spot every day —
at eight in the morning, that spot was shade.
en.editorNote: For the three seconds you spend testing the seat before an August lunch run
variations: A seat cover exists to give you one extra layer of psychological preparation.
Flipping the seat up releases heat, not time. You still have to stand there.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件重述句型參考，原創辦公室冷氣遙控器主題

zh-tw.content:
辦公室冷氣的溫度，不是投票決定的。
是最後一個走過去按遙控器的人決定的。

怕熱的人把它調到二十四，怕冷的人再調回二十七。
中間那個溫度沒有人設過，因為沒有人想要中間。

所以你早上覺得冷、下午覺得熱，
不是天氣變了，
是有人趁你去倒水的時候經過了那面牆。

至於遙控器為什麼永遠不在架子上——
它在最後一個按的人手邊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 披著外套坐在出風口正下方、又不好意思開口的那個下午
variations: 辦公室裡最有權力的人，是座位離遙控器最近的那一個。
冷氣溫度的共識，通常在所有人都下班之後才會達成。

en.content:
Office AC temperature is not decided by a vote.
It is decided by whoever walked over to the remote most recently.

The people who run hot set it to 24. The people who run cold set it back to 27.
