Nobody has ever set the number in between, because nobody wants the number in between.

So if you were cold this morning and hot this afternoon,
the weather did not change.
Someone passed that wall while you were refilling your bottle.

As for why the remote is never on its hook —
it is next to the last person who used it.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you sit under the vent in a jacket and still say nothing
variations: The most powerful person in an office is whoever sits closest to the remote.
Consensus on the thermostat is usually reached after everyone has gone home.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環邏輯句型參考，原創大學選課系統開放主題（2026 學年九月初開學）

zh-tw.content:
選課系統開放的時間，是全校都知道的那一秒。
所以全校都會在那一秒登入。

系統會當，就是因為大家都登入了。
如果只有你一個人登入，它不會當。
但如果只有你一個人登入，那門課本來也選得到。

等它恢復之後，熱門的課已經滿了。
滿的意思是，選到的人選到了。

所以搶課比的不是手速，
是你家的網路和學校的伺服器，誰先放棄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一週、四個人開四台筆電圍在桌前等整點的那個晚上
variations: 系統當掉的那幾分鐘，全校的公平是一致的：大家都選不到。
加簽的意思是，你要去跟一個有權力讓你上課的人，說明你為什麼沒選到。

en.content:
Course registration opens at a second the whole campus knows.
So the whole campus logs in at that second.

The system crashes because everyone logged in.
If only you had logged in, it would not crash.
But if only you had logged in, you would have gotten the class anyway.

By the time it comes back, the popular courses are full.
Full means the people who got in got in.

So registration is not a test of reflexes.
It is a test of whether your home Wi-Fi or the school's server gives up first.
en.editorNote: For the night before registration, four laptops open around one table, watching the clock
variations: During the minutes the system is down, everyone on campus is perfectly equal: nobody can register.
Adding a class late means explaining to a person with authority why you did not get it on time.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學狀態重述句型參考，原創夏末蟬鳴主題

zh-tw.content:
夏天很吵，是因為蟬在叫。
蟬不叫的時候，夏天就沒那麼吵。

那個聲音是公蟬發出來的，目的是把母蟬叫過來。
叫到了，牠就不用再叫；沒叫到，牠就繼續叫。

牠在土裡待了好幾年，才爬上這棵樹。
你在樹下站了三十秒，覺得有點吵。
這兩件事同時是真的。

八月底聲音會慢慢變小。
不是因為牠們安靜了，
是因為牠們講完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月傍晚走過行道樹下、忽然發現聲音比上週小了的時候
variations: 你嫌吵的那段聲音，是牠這輩子唯一一次自我介紹。
蟬停下來的方式只有兩種：牠找到了，或者牠結束了。

en.content:
Summer is loud because the cicadas are calling.
When they stop, summer is less loud.

The sound comes from the males, and the point of it is to bring a female over.
If one comes, he stops. If none comes, he keeps going.

He spent years underground to get up this tree.
You stood under it for thirty seconds and found it a bit much.
Both of those are true at the same time.

The noise thins out in late August.
Not because they got quiet,
but because they finished.
en.editorNote: For the August evening you notice the street trees are quieter than they were last week
variations: The noise you are complaining about is the only introduction he will ever make.
A cicada stops calling for one of two reasons: he found her, or he's done.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學同義反覆句型參考，原創日拋隱形眼鏡主題

zh-tw.content:
日拋這個名字，其實已經把用法寫完了：
它是給你戴一天的。

戴第二天當然也戴得下去，
畢竟它不會在隔天早上自己不見。
它只是從來沒說過第二天算數。

一盒三十片，就是三十天。
你想撐成四十天，
那就是這四十天裡有十天，
你戴的是昨天。

眼睛不會當場抗議，
它只是會挑一天再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合早上站在洗手台前，正在考慮昨天那副還能不能再撐一天的時候
variations: 省下來的那一片，它會用別的方式跟你收。
日拋能不能戴兩天，取決於你打算問誰。

en.content:
Daily contacts come with the instructions built into the name:
they are for one day.

You can absolutely wear them a second day.
They don't dissolve overnight.
They just never said day two counted.

A box of thirty is thirty days.
Stretch it to forty and what you've got
is ten days of wearing yesterday.

Your eyes won't argue on the spot.
They'll pick a day later on.
en.editorNote: For the morning you're at the sink deciding whether yesterday's pair has one more day in it
variations: The lens you saved gets billed to you in a different currency.
Whether a daily lasts two days depends entirely on who you ask.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學循環句型參考，原創洗牙回診主題

zh-tw.content:
牙醫說，洗牙半年可以洗一次。
所以你半年洗一次，而且真的等滿半年才去。

躺上去之後，他會說結石有點多。
那些結石是這半年長出來的，
而這半年，剛好就是你沒來的那半年。

洗完他會給你一支牙線，
交代回去要記得用。
你會帶回家，放進抽屜，
下次來的時候它還在，只是沒拆過。

至於下次是什麼時候——
也是半年後。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合掛完牙醫預約電話、突然想起上次也是這樣的那三秒
variations: 牙結石不會憑空出現，它只是照著你的作息長。
你跟牙醫的關係非常穩定：一年見兩次，每次講一樣的話。

en.content:
The dentist says a cleaning every six months is fine.
So you go every six months, and you use up all six.

You lie back and he mentions there's a fair amount of buildup.
That buildup grew over the last six months,
which happen to be the six months you weren't here.

On the way out he hands you floss
and tells you to use it.
You take it home, put it in a drawer,
and next visit it's still there, unopened.

As for the next visit —
also six months.
en.editorNote: For the three seconds after you book the appointment and realize last time went exactly like this
variations: Plaque doesn't appear from nowhere. It just grows on your schedule.
You and your dentist have a very stable relationship: twice a year, same conversation.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學反雞湯手法參考，原創履歷自傳主題

zh-tw.content:
履歷上最難寫的一欄，是自傳。

因為前面那幾欄都有標準答案：
哪一年畢業、在哪裡上過班、會用哪幾套軟體。
這些你查一下就填得出來。

自傳沒有標準答案。
它要你用五百字說明你是誰，
而你平常根本不需要說明你是誰——
你就是你，這件事從來不用附理由。

所以你寫了三行、刪掉兩行，
最後留下一句「個性積極、樂於學習」。
這句話你自己看了都不確定是不是在講你，
但它至少是一句話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合深夜第八次打開履歷檔案、游標停在自傳那一格不動的時候
variations: 自傳難寫，不是因為你不了解自己，是因為要寫成別人想看的樣子。
每個人的自傳都寫積極、學得快，所以這兩件事看起來像人人都有。

en.content:
The hardest field on a résumé is the personal statement.

Everything above it has a correct answer:
when you graduated, where you worked, which tools you know.
You can look those up and type them in.

The statement has no correct answer.
It asks you to explain who you are in five hundred words,
and you never have to explain who you are —
you just are, and that has never needed a reason.

So you write three lines, delete two,
and keep the one that says you're proactive and a fast learner.
You read it back and can't tell if it's about you,
but it is, at minimum, a sentence.
en.editorNote: For the eighth time tonight you opened the file and the cursor is still sitting in that one box
variations: The statement is hard not because you don't know yourself, but because it has to be readable by a stranger.
Everyone writes proactive and fast learner, which makes both sound like standard equipment.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學條件句手法參考，原創開學前買制服主題

zh-tw.content:
買制服的時候，媽媽會請老闆拿大一號的。

理由講得很清楚：你還會長高。
這句話是對的，你確實還會長高。

所以開學那天，袖子蓋到手指，
褲管要折兩折。
折起來的那一截，是留給明年的你。

到了明年，褲管放下來剛剛好。
剛剛好的那段時間通常不長，
因為你還在長。

等它真的不夠長的那天，
你也差不多要畢業了。
這件衣服從頭到尾，
只有中間那幾個月是合身的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前陪小孩去買制服，或自己想起那條折了兩折的褲管的時候
variations: 制服大一號，是提前跟明年的你借的。
一件衣服穿三年，真正合身的只有中間那一段。

en.content:
When you buy a school uniform, your mom asks for one size up.

The reason is stated plainly: you're still growing.
And that's true. You are still growing.

So on the first day the sleeves cover your fingers
and the pants get cuffed twice.
The part that's folded up belongs to next year's you.

Next year the cuffs come down and it fits.
That stretch usually doesn't last long,
because you're still growing.

By the time it's genuinely too short,
you're about to graduate anyway.
Out of the whole run of that uniform,
only the middle few months actually fit.
en.editorNote: For the pre-semester uniform shop trip, or for remembering your own double-cuffed pants
variations: A size up is just borrowing from next year's you.
Three years in one uniform, and it only fits for one stretch in the middle.

items.sourceNote: 外國網友分享台灣家庭室內拖鞋分區習慣引發共鳴，原創改寫為分區拖鞋主題，不寫當事人情節

zh-tw.content:
家裡的拖鞋，是照區域分配的。

浴室一雙、客廳一雙、廚房一雙，
上樓還有另外一雙。
它們長得差不多，但不能互相代班。

浴室那雙一天走不到三步，
可是它有它的立場：
它只負責那三步。

規矩沒有人寫下來，
也沒有人問過為什麼，
但每個人都換得很自然。

所以嚴格說起來，
家裡有四雙拖鞋，
腳只有一雙。
換來換去的，一直是同一雙腳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合玄關擺了一排拖鞋，或朋友第一次來你家、站在門口不知道該換哪一雙的時候
variations: 每個區域都配一雙專屬拖鞋，而它們排隊等的是同一雙腳。
浴室拖鞋一天只走三步，但那三步別雙不能走。

en.content:
Four pairs of slippers. One pair of feet.

Bathroom pair, living room pair, kitchen pair,
and a separate pair for upstairs.
They look nearly identical and they do not cover for each other.

The bathroom pair walks maybe three steps a day.
It still has a position on this:
those three steps are its job.

Nobody wrote the rule down.
Nobody has asked why.
Everyone switches without thinking about it.

So strictly speaking,
the household owns four pairs,
and what keeps moving between them
has been the same two feet all along.
en.editorNote: For the row of slippers by the front door, or a guest frozen in the entryway deciding which pair is theirs
variations: Every zone gets its own pair, and every pair is waiting on the same set of feet.
Three steps a day, and no other pair is allowed to take them.

items.sourceNote: 八月全台活動整理提到台東熱氣球活動，原創改寫為繫留體驗主題

zh-tw.content:
熱氣球的繫留體驗，流程講得很清楚：
球升上去，繩子還綁在地上，
時間到了，再把你放下來。

所以你會回到出發的那個點。
不是差不多的那個點，
是同一個點。

中間那幾分鐘，你確實離開過地面。
離開的高度大概是幾層樓，
再上去就沒有繩子了。

有人說這樣不算飛。
但你上去的時候風是真的，
下來的時候腿也是真的軟。

繫留的意思本來就寫在名字裡：
它保證你上得去，
也保證你回得來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合排了兩小時、飛了五分鐘、下來還在傻笑的那種行程，也適合朋友嫌你「這樣哪算飛」的時候
variations: 繫留的重點不是飛多高，是那條繩子從頭到尾都知道你會回來。
你買的不是距離，是離地的那幾分鐘。

en.content:
Five minutes up. Same patch of grass down.

A tethered balloon ride states its terms in advance:
the balloon rises, the rope stays bolted to the ground,
and when the time is up they bring you back.

You return to your starting point.
Not roughly the same point.
The same one.

For those few minutes you were genuinely off the ground,
about as high as a few floors,
which is where the rope runs out.

Some people say that doesn't count as flying.
The wind up there was real, though,
and so were your legs on the way down.

Tethered is doing all the work in that name:
it promises you'll go up,
and it promises you'll come back.
en.editorNote: For anyone who queued two hours, flew five minutes, and came down grinning, or who got told that doesn't count
variations: The rope knew the whole time that you were coming back.
You didn't pay for distance. You paid for a few minutes of not touching the ground.

items.sourceNote: 農曆七月職場與日常用語習俗整理，原創改寫為「講話變客氣」觀察式主題，不寫指導語氣、不寫嚇人情節

zh-tw.content:
農曆七月一到，大家講話會忽然變客氣。

不是變有禮貌，是變小心。
某些字自動換成別的字，
某些話講到一半就留在心裡。
連稱呼都換成一個比較親切的版本。

換完之後，講的還是同一件事。
你知道，我知道，聽的人也知道。

但整個月下來，
辦公室的用詞真的比較溫和，
群組裡的玩笑真的比較收斂。

所以這個月最明顯的改變，
不是外面多了什麼，
是大家的嘴巴變好了一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開會時聽到有人硬是繞過某個字、全場都懂卻沒人點破的那一秒
variations: 這個月用詞比較溫和，內容其實一個字都沒少。
換一個稱呼，事情不會換，但大家心裡舒服一點——這樣就夠了。

en.content:
Words get swapped. The meaning stays put.

Come the seventh lunar month, everyone's speech turns careful.
Not more courteous — more careful.
Certain words are traded for other words.
Certain sentences stop halfway and stay inside.
Even the usual name for this month's guests
switches to a warmer one.

After the swap it is still the same subject.
You know it, I know it, whoever is listening knows it.

Still, across the whole month
the office really does sound gentler
and the group chat really does hold back.

So the clearest change this month
isn't anything outside.
It's that everybody's mouth got a little nicer.
en.editorNote: For the meeting where someone visibly routes around a word and the whole room lets it pass
variations: The vocabulary softened. The subject did not.
Swapping the word changes nothing about the thing, and everyone feels better anyway.

items.sourceNote: 夏季沙雕展活動頁，原創改寫為沙雕展期倒數主題，不提任何授權角色

zh-tw.content:
沙雕展的作品，材料是沙跟水。
師傅堆好之後會噴一層膠，
讓它撐到展期結束。

撐到展期結束，就是它的目標。
沒有人打算把它搬回家，
家裡也沒有地方放。

所以你看的不是一座雕像，
是一座正在倒數的雕像。
它現在還在，是因為現在還沒到那天。

拍照的人特別多，這很合理：
照片會留下來，
沙不會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在沙雕展現場排隊拍照，或看到「展期最後一天」公告的時候
variations: 沙雕是少數完工當天就開始倒數的作品。
你拍的不是沙，是那天沙還在的證據。

en.content:
Sand and water. That's the entire materials list.
Sculptors build the piece, then spray a coat of fixative
so it holds until the exhibition closes.

Holding until closing day is the whole goal.
Nobody plans to take one home.
There is nowhere to put it.

So what you came to see isn't a sculpture.
It's a sculpture on a countdown.
It's still standing because the day hasn't arrived yet.

Everyone photographs it, which tracks:
the photo lasts.
The sand doesn't.
en.editorNote: For the photo line at a sand sculpture show, or the sign announcing the final day
variations: A sand sculpture starts its countdown the day it's finished.
The photo isn't of the sand. It's proof the sand was there that day.

items.sourceNote: 新機發表會相關報導，原創改寫為「新機讓舊機誕生」的廢話邏輯，不提任何品牌與型號

zh-tw.content:
新機發表會真正宣布的，不是那支新的手機。
是你口袋裡這支，從今天起有了一個新的名字：舊的。

它昨天很好用，今天也還是很好用。
差別只在於，世界上多了一支比它新的。

所以你不是變得需要換手機，
你只是知道了有得換。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看完新品發表會、或朋友問你要不要跟著換機的時候丟出來
variations: 舊手機不是變慢了，是旁邊多了一支比較快的。
規格表最誠實的一欄，是它沒有列你現在這支。

en.content:
What a launch event actually announces isn't the new phone.
It's that the one in your pocket now has a new name: the old one.

It worked fine yesterday. It still works fine.
The only change is that a newer one exists somewhere.

So you didn't start needing an upgrade.
You just found out one was available.
en.editorNote: For right after a product keynote, or when a friend asks if you're upgrading too
variations: Your phone didn't get slower. Something faster showed up next to it.
The most honest line on a spec sheet is the one that doesn't mention the phone you own.

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度開學日行事曆整理，原創改寫為開學採買清單的廢話邏輯

zh-tw.content:
開學前的採買清單，每年都長得差不多：
鉛筆盒一個、墊板一片、書套若干、名條一包。

這張清單的邏輯非常單純：
買到的會被打勾，
沒買到的還留在紙上。

而每年一定會有一樣東西，
你買回家才發現去年那個還在，
而且沒用過。

它明年還會出現在同一張清單上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前陪小孩逛文具行，或整理抽屜挖出去年同款文具的時候
variations: 清單的功能不是提醒你要買什麼，是提醒你忘了自己有什麼。
文具行最暢銷的商品，是你家裡已經有的那一款。

en.content:
The back-to-school list looks the same every year:
one pencil case, one desk mat, a stack of book covers, a pack of name labels.

The logic is simple.
What you buy gets a checkmark.
What you don't stays on the paper.

And every year there's one item
you only discover you already own
after you've bought a second one.

It will be on the same list next year.
en.editorNote: For the school supply aisle in August, or the drawer where last year's spares turn up
variations: A shopping list doesn't remind you what to buy. It reminds you what you forgot you had.
The best-selling item at the stationery shop is the one already in your drawer.

items.sourceNote: 颱風影響離島航線停航的天氣新聞，原創改寫為售票口對話，不指名任何航線或業者

zh-tw.content:
颱風要來，船就停開。公告上只寫兩個字：停航。

你在售票口問：「那什麼時候會開？」
櫃檯說：「風小一點就開。」
你再問：「那風什麼時候會小？」
櫃檯說：「這個要問風。」

所以你手上那張票沒有作廢，
它只是在等一件不歸你決定的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合航班或船班被天氣卡住時，傳給同行的人苦中作樂
variations: 停航的意思不是不開，是還沒開。
你能決定幾點到碼頭，不能決定幾點離開碼頭。

en.content:
A typhoon comes, the boats stop. The notice says one word: cancelled.

You ask at the counter, "So when does it sail?"
"When the wind dies down."
"And when does the wind die down?"
"That one's up to the wind."

Your ticket isn't void.
It's just waiting on something that was never yours to decide.
en.editorNote: For a weather-stranded ferry terminal or airport gate, to send to whoever is stuck with you
variations: Cancelled doesn't mean never. It means not yet.
You get to pick what time you reach the pier. Not what time you leave it.

items.sourceNote: 夏季用水用電相關生活新聞，原創改寫為缺水與暴雨的廢話對照

zh-tw.content:
水不夠的時候，大家希望下雨。
雨太大的時候，大家希望停。

所以我們要的一直不是雨，
是剛剛好的雨。

問題是天上沒有這個選項，
它只有下跟不下。

剛剛好那種，是下完之後我們自己認定的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合颱風過後看水庫蓄水率新聞，或聊到天氣總是不合人意的時候
variations: 雨沒有錯，是我們每次要的量都不一樣。
所謂好天氣，是事後回頭才決定的。

en.content:
When the reservoirs run low, everyone wants rain.
When it pours, everyone wants it to stop.

So what we want has never been rain.
It's the right amount of rain.

The sky doesn't offer that setting.
It only has raining and not raining.

The right amount is something we decide afterward.
en.editorNote: For reservoir-level headlines after a storm, or any conversation about weather never cooperating
variations: The rain isn't wrong. We just ask for a different amount every time.
Good weather is a verdict we hand down after the fact.

items.sourceNote: 2026 節日行事曆：七夕為 8/19（農曆七月初七），作為節日日期背景

zh-tw.content:
一年見一次，等於另外三百六十四天不見。

七夕不是重逢的日子，是不用等的那天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七夕當天發限動，或朋友問你晚上要幹嘛時可以用。
variations: 他們一年見一次，你一年被問一次今年有沒有人陪。
節日沒有把日子變少，它只是把等的那部分標起來。

en.content:
Meeting once a year means not meeting the other 364 days.

Qixi isn't the reunion. It's the one day nobody is waiting.
en.editorNote: Good for a Qixi story caption, or when someone asks what you're doing that night.
variations: They meet once a year. You get asked once a year whether you've got someone.
The holiday didn't shorten the year. It just marked the waiting part.

items.sourceNote: 2026 中元節為 8/27，普渡習俗與租屋族擺設限制的一般背景介紹

zh-tw.content:
租來的房子沒有神明廳，所以今天那張書桌是供桌。

收一收之後，它明天還是書桌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 小套房準備拜拜、東西擺不太下時的自嘲。
variations: 桌子從頭到尾沒有動，換的只是上面放什麼。
供桌是一個身分，不是一張桌子。

en.content:
A rented place has no shrine room, so today the desk is the altar.

Clear the plates and tomorrow it's a desk again.
en.editorNote: For anyone doing a small-apartment version of the mid-seventh-month offering.
variations: The table never moved. Only what sat on it changed.
Altar is a job, not a piece of furniture.

items.sourceNote: 2026 開學季準備與「收心」相關的生活型報導，作為題材背景

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週，大人會開始講「收心」。

收心的意思是把心收回來。可是心整個暑假都在你身上，並沒有跑去別的地方。

所以真正要收的是幾點睡、幾點起床。
而這兩件事收不收，那天早上都會到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 家人叫你收心的那幾天，可以小聲說這句。
variations: 收心操做完，心還在原地，只是你比較早睡。
心沒有離家出走，離家出走的是作息。

en.content:
The week before school starts, adults begin saying "settle down."

Settling down means bringing your mind back. But your mind was on you all summer. It never went anywhere.

So the thing that actually needs settling is what time you sleep and what time you get up.
And either way, that morning arrives.
en.editorNote: For the week before school starts, when someone tells you to settle down.
variations: You can settle all you want. Bedtime is the only part that moves.
Your mind didn't run off. Your sleep schedule did.

items.sourceNote: 2026 新學期文具採買清單類報導，作為新筆記本題材的背景

zh-tw.content:
新學期會買一本新的筆記本。第一頁的字通常特別工整。

工整的原因很單純：那是第一頁，你還有時間慢慢寫。

翻到第十頁，字就變回你本來的字。
第一頁那個，只是它的展示版。
zh-tw.editorNote: 買了新本子、順手寫下新計畫時的自嘲。
variations: 你的字沒有變醜，是第一頁太努力。
本子的前三頁很像另一個人在寫。

en.content:
A new term comes with a new notebook, and the handwriting on page one is always unusually neat.

The reason is simple: it's page one, and you still have time.

By page ten it's back to your actual handwriting.
Page one was just the display model.
en.editorNote: For the day you buy a fresh notebook and write out new plans.
variations: Your handwriting didn't get worse. Page one was trying too hard.
The first three pages look like someone else wrote them.

items.sourceNote: 瓦倫達效應相關討論（越在乎越失手），作為「越用力越不自然」的背景參考

zh-tw.content:
叫人自然一點，那個人就會立刻不自然。

真正自然的那張，都是還沒喊三二一的時候拍的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 幫朋友拍照拍到第十七張還是很僵的時候傳給他。
variations: 自然這件事，一被要求就會消失。
好看的那張通常在你以為還沒開始拍的時候。

en.content:
Tell someone to look natural and they instantly stop looking natural.

The natural shot is always the one taken before anyone counts down.
en.editorNote: For the seventeenth stiff photo of a friend who keeps asking how they look.
variations: Natural is the one thing that disappears the moment you request it.
The good picture happened before you said you were taking one.

items.sourceNote: 墨菲定律科普文章，作為「越怕出事越出事」反向現象的背景參考

zh-tw.content:
壞掉的東西，在你找人來看的那天會自己好。

它不是被修好，是它知道有人來了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 師傅到場後機器忽然一切正常時的解釋。
variations: 它壞了三個禮拜，只有那三十分鐘是好的。
人一走，它就會繼續壞給你看。

en.content:
Broken things fix themselves the day you finally call someone to look at them.

It wasn't repaired. It just heard footsteps.
en.editorNote: For the moment the technician arrives and everything works perfectly.
variations: It was broken for three weeks and fine for thirty minutes.
It starts breaking again the second the door closes.

items.sourceNote: 墨菲定律生活案例報導，作為「別人接手就成功」的反直覺情境背景

zh-tw.content:
你轉不開的那個瓶蓋，換一個人轉就開了。

你已經幫他轉鬆了，只是差最後那一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 把罐頭交給別人、對方一秒打開時說的話。
variations: 開瓶蓋的功勞，通常記在最後那個人身上。
你不是沒力氣，是你負責前面那九成。

en.content:
The jar you couldn't open opens for the next person who tries.

You already loosened it. You just ran out one twist early.
en.editorNote: For handing off a jar and watching someone open it in one second.
variations: Credit for the jar always goes to whoever twisted last.
You did ninety percent of it and none of the celebrating.

items.sourceNote: 墨菲定律與心理預期的討論文章，作為「越在意越沒下文」的背景參考

zh-tw.content:
改到第八版的那則訊息，沒有回音。
隨手打的那句，五分鐘就回了。

用力是會被聞到的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳出去之後開始盯著手機的那個晚上。
variations: 你改的不是句子，是你有多在意。
最好的版本，通常是你沒存草稿的那個。

en.content:
The message you rewrote eight times got no reply.
The one you typed without thinking got answered in five minutes.

Effort has a smell.
en.editorNote: For the night you hit send and start watching your phone.
variations: You weren't editing the sentence. You were editing how much you cared.
The best version is usually the one you never saved as a draft.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學句型整理文章，作為「同義替換／狀態互換」句法的參考

zh-tw.content:
一捲膠帶的開頭，在你找到之前，一直都貼在那捲膠帶上。
它沒有走，只是跟旁邊那圈長得太像。

找到之後，它就是開頭。
找不到的時候，整捲都是中間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拿著膠帶轉了三圈、指甲在上面刮來刮去的時候。
variations: 膠帶不會弄丟開頭，它只是把開頭藏在自己身上。
摳出來的那一小條，就是今天最大的成就。

en.content:
The start of a roll of tape has been sitting on the roll the entire time.

It didn't go anywhere. It just looks too much like the layer underneath it.

Once you find it, it's the beginning. Until then, the whole roll is middle.
en.editorNote: For spinning a roll of tape three times with your fingernail out.
variations: Tape never loses its edge. It just hides the edge on itself.
That little strip you finally peel up is the day's biggest win.

items.sourceNote: 2026 電商免運門檻與湊單討論，作為「為了省運費多花錢」的數字素材

zh-tw.content:
購物車距離免運，還差三十九元。
你加了一件一百二十元的東西，六十元的運費就不見了。

六十元省下來了，一百二十元也花出去了。
兩句話都是真的，只是站在不同邊算。
zh-tw.editorNote: 結帳頁跳出「再買 39 元享免運」的那三秒。
variations: 免運不是不用錢，是換一個欄位付。
你省下的是運費，不是錢。

en.content:
Your cart is four dollars short of free shipping.

So you add a twelve-dollar thing, and the six-dollar shipping fee disappears.

You saved six. You also spent twelve. Both sentences are true, depending on which side you count from.
en.editorNote: For the checkout banner that says "add $4 more for free shipping."
variations: Free shipping isn't free. It's shipping, paid in a different aisle.
You saved the fee. You did not save the money.

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學與反雞湯專題，作為「先變糟才變好」反轉語感的參考

zh-tw.content:
打掃的第一步，是把東西全部拿出來。
第二步，是決定它們要放回哪裡。
第三步，天黑了。

所以整理是有進度的，只是進度會先往反方向走一段。
zh-tw.editorNote: 地板上堆滿東西、你坐在正中間滑手機的那個下午。
variations: 房間變亂，是它變乾淨的必經過程。這句話可以撐很多天。
拿出來十分鐘，放回去一輩子。

en.content:
Step one of cleaning: take everything out.
Step two: decide where it all goes back.
Step three: it's dark outside.

Cleaning does make progress. The progress just runs backwards for a while first.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you end up sitting in the middle of the pile, scrolling.
variations: A messier room is a required stage of a cleaner room. That excuse stretches for days.
Taking it all out takes ten minutes. Putting it back takes a lifetime.

items.sourceNote: 網路流行語幽默手法拆解，作為「自我否定式假設」句型的參考

zh-tw.content:
如果早知道真的能早一點知道，它就不會叫早知道了。

它每次都準時抵達，只是它對的是結束，不是開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 事情搞砸之後，第一個從嘴巴裡冒出來的那句話。
variations: 早知道不是資訊，是一種語氣。
會早知道的人，其實也是後來才知道，只是講得比較大聲。

en.content:
If hindsight actually showed up early, we wouldn't have to call it hindsight.

It's never late. It just sets its clock by the ending instead of the start.
en.editorNote: For the first sentence out of your mouth after something goes wrong.
variations: Hindsight isn't information. It's a tone of voice.
The people who knew better found out at the same time you did. They just said it louder.

items.sourceNote: 網路熱議日常物件話題，取『保護貼氣泡』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
貼保護貼那天，中間跑進一顆氣泡。你按了三分鐘，它只是換到旁邊。

一年後撕下來，正面全是刮痕，那顆氣泡還在原地。

刮痕是它替你擋的，氣泡是它自己的事。它一整年都不完美，也一整年都完成了工作。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拿來安慰那種被小瑕疵卡住、卻忘了東西其實一直有在運作的人。
variations: 保護貼上的刮痕，是它的工作紀錄。
那顆氣泡沒有變小，只是你後來不看它了。

en.content:
A bubble slipped under the screen protector the day you put it on. You pressed at it for three minutes and it moved half an inch.

A year later you peel the thing off. The front is a mess of scratches. The bubble is exactly where it was.

The scratches were its job. The bubble was its own business. It spent a whole year being imperfect and a whole year doing the work.
en.editorNote: For anything slightly flawed that's still doing its job — including the person who keeps noticing the flaw.
variations: The scratches on a screen protector are its performance review.
The bubble never got smaller. You just stopped looking at it.

items.sourceNote: 近期用藥與健康相關報導，取『療程要吃完』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
藥袋上印著一行字：症狀改善仍須服完整個療程。

第四天你就不咳了。藥還剩三天。

你的身體覺得結束了，藥覺得還沒。兩邊都是真的，而且只有一邊會被你聽進去。

剩下那三包，會在抽屜裡待到你搬家。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在「感覺已經好了但流程還沒跑完」的時刻，勸別人或勸自己把事情做完。
variations: 好了跟療程結束，中間那幾天最容易出事。
抽屜裡那幾包藥，記錄的是你哪一次提早覺得自己沒事了。

en.content:
The pharmacy bag says: finish the full course even if symptoms improve.

By day four the cough is gone. There are three days of pills left.

Your body thinks it's over. The medicine thinks it isn't. Both are telling the truth, and only one of them gets listened to.

Those last three doses will sit in a drawer until you move out.
en.editorNote: For the stretch where you feel fine and the process isn't done — say it to a friend, or to yourself.
variations: Feeling better and being better are about three days apart.
The leftover pills in your drawer are a record of every time you called it early.

items.sourceNote: 台灣出遊與交通熱搜整理，取『高鐵自由座』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
自由座的意思是，你可以自由地找位子，找不到就自由地站著。

票上寫的是從這裡到那裡，沒有一個字提到坐。

所以站到台中的那個人，票沒有比較不值錢。他買的東西全部拿到了，只是拿的姿勢不太一樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 安慰那種「有拿到，但拿到的是最克難版本」的場合，例如站票、最後一排、備取上榜。
variations: 自由座唯一保證的自由，是你可以自由地走去下一節車廂。
站著到站跟坐著到站，站名是同一個。

en.content:
An unreserved ticket means you're free to look for a seat, and free to stand when there isn't one.

The ticket says here to there. Nowhere does it say sitting.

So the guy who stood the whole way didn't get less than he paid for. He got all of it. He just got it upright.
en.editorNote: For anyone who got exactly what they wanted, in the least comfortable version available.
variations: The only freedom an unreserved ticket guarantees is the freedom to walk to the next car.
Standing and sitting pull into the same station at the same minute.

items.sourceNote: 生活新聞版面日常題材，取『罰單上的時間紀錄』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
罰單上會寫日期、時間、地點，精準到分鐘。

那天你其實什麼都不記得。不記得那條路在下雨，也不記得自己要去哪裡。

它留下來的不是你的錯，是你人生中最普通的那一分鐘。而那一分鐘，只有它幫你記著。

代價一千二。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配舊收據、舊照片講「幫你記住平凡日子的東西」很好用，也可以純粹自嘲。
variations: 你人生被記錄得最完整的那幾分鐘，全寫在罰單上。
一千二買一段回憶，貴，但確實買到了。

en.content:
A speeding ticket lists the date, the time, the exact stretch of road. Down to the minute.

You remember none of it. Not the weather, not where you were going, not what was playing.

What it kept wasn't your mistake. It was the most ordinary minute of your life, and it's the only thing that bothered to write it down.

Cost: forty bucks.
en.editorNote: Pairs well with an old receipt or photo — the things that keep a record of your dull days. Works as self-deprecation too.
variations: The most thoroughly documented minutes of your life are all on traffic tickets.
Forty dollars for a memory you didn't ask for. Still a memory.

items.sourceNote: 2026 年 8 月全國分區城鎮韌性（防空）演習相關報導，取『演習當下的街景』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
警報一響，街上的人要在三十秒內走進最近的騎樓。

三十秒後整條路就空了，只剩下號誌燈自己在那邊換顏色。

騎樓底下站滿了人，沒有人講話，因為大家都在看手機上還剩幾分鐘。

半小時後解除，同一批人走回同一條路，把三十分鐘前沒做完的事接著做完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合任何「被強制暫停一下再原地繼續」的場合：演習、火警測試、系統維護、會議中斷。
variations: 演習期間街上沒有人，是因為街上的人都走到旁邊去了。
那三十分鐘唯一改變的事，是那三十分鐘過去了。

en.content:
When the siren goes off, everyone on the street has thirty seconds to get under the nearest awning.

Thirty seconds later the road is empty and the traffic lights go on changing colors for nobody.

Under the awning nobody talks, because everybody is checking their phone for how many minutes are left.

Then the all-clear sounds, the same people walk back onto the same street, and finish whatever they were doing half an hour ago.
en.editorNote: For any forced pause — a drill, a fire alarm, scheduled maintenance — where everything resumes exactly where it stopped.
variations: There's nobody on the street during the drill because everybody stepped off the street.
The only thing those thirty minutes changed is that they're over.

items.sourceNote: 台灣小吃話題榜整理，取『鹽酥雞的九層塔』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
鹽酥雞的九層塔不用錢，所以它到底值多少錢，沒有人算得出來。

你說不要加，老闆的夾子會在半空中停大概兩秒。

那兩秒裡他什麼都沒問，但整條街都聽見了那個問題。

最後你說還是加吧，他笑了一下，抓了比平常更大一把。
zh-tw.editorNote: 講「附贈的那個其實才是重點」很好用，宵夜文、夜市貼文、朋友請客時都能配。
variations: 九層塔沒有標準份量，標準是老闆今天的心情。
免費的那一把，是整袋裡你最先吃完的。

en.content:
The handful of fried basil that comes with your popcorn chicken is free, so nobody can tell you what it's worth.

Say you don't want it and the vendor's tongs stop in midair for a solid two seconds.

He doesn't ask you anything, but the whole night market hears the question.

You say fine, add it, and he grins and gives you more than usual.
en.editorNote: For the small free extra that turns out to be the entire reason you ordered.
variations: There's no standard portion of basil. The standard is how the vendor feels tonight.
The free handful is the part of the bag you finish first.

items.sourceNote: 台灣日常生活熱搜整理，取『保溫瓶忘了喝』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
星期五倒進保溫瓶的那杯咖啡，星期一打開還是溫的。

保溫瓶不會判斷你還要不要喝，它只負責讓溫度停在你關上蓋子的那一刻。

所以那杯咖啡不是放了三天，是被留在星期五。

你把它倒掉的時候會有點抱歉，畢竟這三天裡只有它一直守著約定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容那種「你早就放下了，它還在原地盡責」的東西或關係，也可以單純當生活小廢文。
variations: 保溫瓶最厲害的地方，是連你忘記這件事都一起保溫了。
蓋子打開的那一秒，星期五才真的結束。

en.content:
You poured a coffee into the thermos on Friday, screwed the lid on, and forgot about it.

Monday you open it and it's still warm.

A thermos doesn't decide whether you still want it; it just holds the temperature at the moment the lid closed.

Pouring it out feels slightly rude, because for three days it was the only one keeping its end of the deal.
en.editorNote: For the object, habit, or person that kept doing the job long after you stopped paying attention.
variations: A thermos keeps your coffee warm and keeps your forgetting warm right along with it.
Friday doesn't actually end until somebody opens the lid.

items.sourceNote: 旅遊與票券消費話題整理，取『早鳥票』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
早鳥票便宜，條件是你要在很久以前就決定那天要去。

那時候你什麼都還不知道，不知道那天會不會下雨，也不知道那天的自己想不想出門。

省下來的那幾百塊，換掉的是「到時候再說」這個選項。

當天在現場買的那張最貴，而它唯一的優點是：買的時候，你已經確定自己想去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 揪團、搶票、報名活動前後都能貼，也適合解釋「為什麼便宜的方案總是綁住你」。
variations: 早鳥價買的不只是票，是三個月後那天的你的行程。
便宜的那張票，是替未來的你做決定換來的。

en.content:
Early bird tickets are cheap on one condition: you have to decide months ahead that you'll want to go that day.

Back then you knew nothing — not the weather, not your mood, not whether you'd even feel like leaving the house.

The couple hundred you saved was the price of giving up the option to change your mind.

The ticket you buy at the door costs the most, and its one advantage is that by then you're sure you want to be there.
en.editorNote: Good for group plans, ticket drops, and anyone wondering why the cheap option always comes with a leash.
variations: An early bird ticket isn't just a ticket. It's a schedule you handed to a version of yourself you haven't met.
The discount is what you get for making the decision before you had any information.

items.sourceNote: 台灣手搖飲品牌排行與新店話題整理，取『新店排隊』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
「這家在賣什麼」前面那個人回頭問，後面那個人也跟著探出頭看了一眼。

「不知道欸，我是看有人排才排的」他說完，兩個人一起往前挪了兩步。

四十分鐘後，兩杯飲料同時從窗口遞出來，冰塊都還沒開始化。

他們喝了第一口，互看一眼，給出的評語一模一樣：還可以啦。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在新店開幕、朋友傳排隊照過來，或你自己排到一半開始懷疑人生的時候。
variations: 隊伍會變長，是因為前面已經有人站在那裡了。
排四十分鐘換到的評語，通常只有三個字。

en.content:
The guy in front turns around and asks what this place is even selling.

The guy behind him says he has no idea, he got in line because there was a line.

Forty minutes later both cups slide across the counter at once, ice still solid.

They take the first sip, look at each other, and land on the exact same verdict: it's fine.
en.editorNote: For the moment you realize the line was the entire reason you joined the line.
variations: A line gets long because somebody was already standing there.
Forty minutes of waiting usually buys you a two-word review.

items.sourceNote: 八月全台活動整理，取『無人機燈光秀取代煙火』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
還住在舊房子的時候，河邊放的是煙火，聲音先到，圖案後到。

現在同一片天空換成三百台無人機，安安靜靜排出一個爬牆的紅色人影。

煙火結束是因為它燒完了，無人機結束是因為電池要回去充。

兩種都在同一片天空上散掉，差別在於誰決定散掉的時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用來講那種「東西還在，只有規則換了人管」的變化，看表演、看年度回顧都能配。
variations: 煙火自己決定什麼時候結束，無人機是被決定的。
同一片天空，今年比較安靜，也比較準時。

en.content:
Back when I still lived in the old apartment, the show over the river was fireworks, sound arriving first and the picture second.

Now the same patch of sky gets three hundred drones that quietly assemble a red figure climbing a wall.

Fireworks end because they burn out, and drones end because the batteries have to go back and charge.

Both of them dissolve over the same water, and the only difference is who decides when.
en.editorNote: Good for anything that looks the same as last year but now runs on somebody else's schedule.
variations: Fireworks decide when they are finished, and drones get told.
Same sky as last year, quieter this time, and right on schedule.

items.sourceNote: 兒少成長帳戶相關政策報導整理，取『十八年後才能領的戶頭』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
如果有人在小孩出生那週替他開了一個戶頭，那這個戶頭會比他更早學會等待。

如果裡面的錢要等到十八歲才領得出來，那前面十七年它做的事，就是安安靜靜地變大。

如果他十八歲那天一次領光，那也是他的自由，畢竟那筆錢本來就是為了那天存的。

如果他那天沒有一次領光，那十八年才真的算存過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊長線的事，存錢、養小孩、任何要等很久才看得到結果的東西都能配。
variations: 十八年後領到的那筆錢，是十八年前一群還不認識你的大人幫你決定的。
錢放著不動的那幾年，它一直在做同一件事。

en.content:
If somebody opens an account for a baby the week she is born, the account learns how to wait before she does.

If the money can't be touched until she turns eighteen, then all it does for seventeen years is quietly get bigger.

If she empties it the day she's allowed to, that's her call, because that's the day it was saved for.

If she doesn't empty it that day, then it actually got saved for eighteen years.
en.editorNote: For savings plans, kids, and anything else whose payoff sits further out than your patience.
variations: The money you collect at eighteen was decided by people who had never met you.
Left alone, it spends those years doing exactly one job.

items.sourceNote: 便利商店經營趨勢整理，取『關東煮鍋裡的蘿蔔』作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
我是關東煮鍋裡那顆蘿蔔，中午就下鍋了，到現在還在同一格。

泡越久我越入味，這件事店員知道，站在鍋子前面的你大概也知道。

可是每個人看我一眼之後，都會去夾旁邊那顆看起來比較白、比較新的。

所以鍋子裡最好吃的那一顆，永遠是最後才有人願意夾走的那顆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容那種越熬越好、卻越來越沒人選的人事物，宵夜文或職場感嘆都能用。
variations: 入味需要時間，而時間會讓你看起來不新鮮。
最後一顆被夾走的，通常是泡最久的那顆。

en.content:
I'm the daikon in the convenience store hot pot, and I've been in this compartment since noon.

The longer I soak the better I taste, which the clerk knows and you standing there probably know too.

Still, everyone looks at me once and then reaches for the whiter one sitting next to me.

So the best piece in the whole pot is always the one nobody is willing to take yet.
en.editorNote: For anything that only gets better with time while looking worse the whole way there.
variations: Flavor takes time, and time is what makes you look past your prime.
The last one taken is usually the one that has been in there longest.

items.sourceNote: 台灣人喝手搖飲會先敲吸管的台日文化差異報導，重新創作成場景

zh-tw.content:
她拿到飲料，把吸管從袋子裡抽出來，在掌心敲了兩下才對準封膜戳下去。

封膜破掉的聲音很小，坐在對面的日本同事卻整個人愣住，問她剛剛為什麼要先敲。

她想了三秒，什麼理由都講不出來，最後說從小看大人都是這樣。

那天她第一次發現，這個做了二十幾年的動作，從頭到尾沒有人教過她。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊那些從來沒被解釋過的生活習慣，也很適合配台灣日常的照片發文。
variations: 習慣不需要理由，理由是被問到之後才開始找的。
最自然的那個動作，通常也是最沒人教過的那個。

en.content:
She got her drink, slid the straw out of its wrapper, tapped it twice against her palm, then punched it through the seal.

The pop was barely a sound, but her coworker visiting from Osaka just stared and asked why she hit it first.

She thought about it for three seconds, couldn't produce a single reason, and said the grown-ups all did it that way.

That afternoon she found out nobody had ever taught her the move she'd been doing for twenty-some years.
en.editorNote: For the habits you picked up without anyone ever telling you why.
variations: A habit doesn't need a reason until somebody asks for one.
The most natural thing you do is usually the thing nobody taught you.

items.sourceNote: 2026 年八月高溫與季風低壓槽的天氣觀察，取高溫天數作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
氣象站的數字說，今年夏天已經有三十七天飆過三十六度，比去年整整多了九天。

他把這則新聞唸給坐在門口的阿公聽，阿公聽完就講了一句以前也很熱。

那天下午他拿溫度計量門口那張塑膠板凳，四十一度，阿公照樣坐了兩個小時。

三十七天裡面，阿公一天都沒有走進屋子裡吹過冷氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫長輩那種數字說服不了的固執，夏天抱怨天氣的時候也很好用。
variations: 數字一年比一年大，坐在板凳上的人沒有變。
溫度計量得出板凳，量不出願意坐上去的人。

en.content:
The weather station counted thirty-seven days above ninety-seven degrees this summer, nine more than last year.

He read the number out loud to his grandfather, parked by the front door as usual, and got back that it used to be hot too.

That afternoon he laid a thermometer on the plastic stool outside, a hundred and six, and Grandpa sat on it for two hours anyway.

Across all thirty-seven of those days, he never once came inside for the air conditioning.
en.editorNote: For elders whose habits no thermometer has ever moved.
variations: The number climbs every year and the man on the stool doesn't.
You can measure the stool, never the person who keeps sitting on it.

items.sourceNote: 時事話題頁瀏覽，取辦公室網路與迷信小動作作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
我把手機殼換成透明的那個禮拜，公司網路開始一天斷三次。

IT 來看過兩次，說是機房那邊的設備老了，跟誰用什麼殼完全沒有關係。

坐我旁邊的同事也這樣講，我心裡也很清楚沒有關係。

可是舊的那個黑色殼，昨天下午已經從抽屜裡拿出來換回去了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容那種明知道沒關係、還是乖乖換回來的迷信小動作。
variations: 知道沒有關係，跟願意賭一把，是兩件不同的事。
科學解釋我收下了，殼還是換回去了。

en.content:
The week I switched to a clear phone case, the office wifi started dropping three times a day.

IT came by twice and said the hardware in the closet is just old, and nobody's phone case factors into it.

The guy sitting next to me said the same thing, and I know perfectly well there's no connection.

The old black case came back out of the drawer yesterday afternoon.
en.editorNote: For the superstitious little fix you make even after being told it changes nothing.
variations: Knowing there's no connection and being willing to risk it are two different things.
I accepted the explanation and swapped the case back anyway.

items.sourceNote: 手搖飲聲量排行報導，取夏天揪團聚餐的群組互動作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
同學會的群組一開，有人先丟餐廳連結，有人問哪一個週末，有人說都可以配合。

接著有人推薦另外一家，有人問停車好不好停，有人補一句我沒意見。

第十四則訊息是一張笑到流淚的貼圖，第十五則是同一張貼圖再傳一次。

真正打電話去訂位的那個人，從頭到尾一句話都沒在群組裡講過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容揪團時熱鬧歸熱鬧、事情還是有人默默做完的場面。
variations: 群組裡最安靜的那個，通常就是把事情辦好的那個。
訊息一百則，訂位電話只有一通。

en.content:
Somebody opens the reunion chat with a restaurant link, somebody asks which weekend, somebody says whatever works for everyone.

Then somebody floats a second place, somebody asks about parking, somebody adds that they don't mind either way.

Message fourteen is a crying-laughing sticker, and message fifteen is that exact sticker sent again.

The person who actually picked up the phone and booked the table never typed a word in there.
en.editorNote: For group chats where the noise and the actual planning come from different people.
variations: The quietest name in the thread is usually the one who handled it.
A hundred messages, one phone call.

items.sourceNote: 中華郵政營業據點與延時服務資訊瀏覽，取櫃檯填單等候的場景作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
前面那位先生在填匯款單，寫到一半停下來，把筆放回櫃檯上那條鐵鍊拉得到的最遠處。

他退開兩步看了自己寫的字一眼，又走回去把同一行地址重新描了一次。

描完之後那一行還是原來那幾個字，只是變得比較黑。

我手上這張單子，同一個欄位已經被我描到第三次了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容排隊辦事時那種明知道沒用、手還是會多做一次的小動作。
variations: 寫得再用力，字也還是那幾個字。
多描一次不會比較快，但手就是會這樣做。

en.content:
The man ahead of me is filling out a remittance slip, and halfway through he sets the pen down as far as the little chain on the counter will let it go.

He steps back to look at his own handwriting, then walks up and traces the same line of the address a second time.

Afterward it is the exact same address, only darker.

On my form, I have now gone over the same box three times.
en.editorNote: For the pointless little ritual your hands perform while you wait your turn.
variations: Pressing harder does not change the letters.
Tracing it again won't make the line move.

items.sourceNote: 台北深夜營業藥局整理文，取半夜跑一趟藥局的心情作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
凌晨一點多站在還亮著燈的藥局門口，我到底是真的不舒服，還是只是想確認自己有沒有不舒服？

剛剛量出來的三十六度八，這個數字算高還是算正常？

如果什麼問題都沒有，那我現在為什麼會站在這裡？

值班的藥師遞了一小盒東西過來，說先回去睡，睡不著明天再來一趟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜心裡毛毛、又說不出哪裡怪的時候發，配一張深夜街景也很搭。
variations: 半夜跑那一趟，通常只是想聽別人講一句沒事。
量了三次體溫，量到的都是同一個數字。

en.content:
It's past one in the morning and I'm standing outside the only pharmacy still lit up — am I actually unwell, or do I just want someone to confirm whether I'm unwell?

My temperature came out at 98.2 a minute ago; is that high, or is that normal?

If nothing is wrong with me, why am I out here at this hour?

The pharmacist on the night shift hands me a small box and says go home, sleep, and come back tomorrow if you can't.
en.editorNote: For the late-night worry that sends you out for an answer nobody can actually give you.
variations: The 1 a.m. trip is usually about hearing someone say it's fine.
Three readings, same number, every time.

items.sourceNote: 銀行臨櫃排隊與抽號碼牌的報導，取等候區規則作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
號碼牌抽取後即刻生效，未抽取者視同尚未開始等待。
您的號碼是幾號，取決於您幾點抽的。
螢幕上的數字只會往前，不會回頭，錯過的人請重新抽一張。
本區座位共十二張，坐滿之後仍可繼續等待，只是要站著。
若您已等待超過二十分鐘，請留意：您已經等待超過二十分鐘。
本行不保證輪到您的時候，您還記得自己是來辦什麼的。
離開前請確認手上沒有多拿別人的號碼牌，那一張不會讓您變快。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合等辦事情等到發呆時發，配一張叫號螢幕的照片效果最好。
variations: 等待的長度，等於您已經等了多久。
號碼牌唯一的功能，是證明您有在排隊。

en.content:
Your ticket takes effect the moment you pull it; anyone who has not pulled one is considered not yet waiting.
The number you receive depends on what time you took it.
The display only counts forward, never back. If you miss yours, please pull another.
This area seats twelve. You may continue waiting once they are full, standing.
If you have been waiting more than twenty minutes, please note: you have been waiting more than twenty minutes.
We cannot guarantee that you will still remember what you came in for.
Before leaving, check that you are not holding someone else's ticket. It will not make you faster.
en.editorNote: For any queue where the ticket is the only proof that you're in it.
variations: The length of the wait equals how long you have waited.
A number tells you how many people are ahead of you. That is all it tells you.

items.sourceNote: 手搖飲消費崩潰時刻排行榜報導，取取餐區等候的觀察作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
取餐檯上目前有：三杯貼著微糖少冰、兩杯貼著全糖多珍珠。
一張叫到十七號的單子，可是現在店裡沒有人是十七號。
一疊塑膠提袋，永遠是最上面那張最難撕開。
兩隻手同時伸向同一杯，其中一隻默默縮了回去。
一支被放在角落的原子筆，旁邊沒有任何需要簽名的東西。
一台冰塊機每隔幾分鐘倒一次，倒完之後店裡才有人敢繼續講話。
一杯做好三分鐘還沒人來拿的紅茶，它會一直在那裡，直到有人把它拿走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合等飲料等到開始觀察環境的時候，配取餐檯的照片剛剛好。
variations: 沒有人來拿的那一杯，會等到有人來拿為止。
取餐檯上最安靜的東西，是那杯已經做好的。

en.content:
On the pickup counter right now: three cups marked less sugar less ice, two marked full sugar extra pearls.
One receipt calling number seventeen, and nobody in the shop is seventeen.
A stack of plastic carry bags, where the top one is always the hardest to peel open.
Two hands reaching for the same cup, one of them quietly pulling back.
A ballpoint pen parked in the corner with nothing nearby that needs signing.
An ice machine that dumps every few minutes, after which people feel safe talking again.
One black tea, finished three minutes ago, still sitting there, and it will keep sitting there until somebody takes it.
en.editorNote: For the stretch of time where you've run out of things to do but your drink isn't up yet.
variations: The cup nobody picks up waits until somebody picks it up.
The quietest thing on the counter is the drink that's already done.

items.sourceNote: 全台早餐店超過兩萬家、產值兩千億的產業報導，提到一塊鐵板就能開店，取煎台本身作為敘事者發想

zh-tw.content:
這塊鐵板從開店那天起就沒換過位置，油網先鋪一層，蛋餅皮下去了才輪到蛋。

排隊的人以為決定味道的是配方，其實是我已經熱到第幾個小時。

第一份跟第三十份下鍋時，我的溫度差了一截，這件事只有那把鏟子知道。

所以最好吃的那一份，通常落在第二批來的人手上，最早到的那位反而錯過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊「同一家店同一道餐點，早去晚去味道就是不一樣」的時候發，配一張煎台照片剛好。
variations: 同一份蛋餅，換一個時段下鍋就換一個味道。
第一個到的人負責幫後面的人把鐵板熱起來。

en.content:
This steel griddle hasn't moved an inch since the shop opened. Oil goes down first, then the crepe skin, and only then the egg.

The line outside thinks the recipe decides how it tastes. What actually decides is how many hours I have already been hot.

Order one and order thirty hit completely different temperatures, and only the spatula ever notices.

So the best plate of the morning usually lands with the second wave, and whoever showed up first misses it.
en.editorNote: For the idea that the same dish from the same shop tastes different depending on when you walk in.
variations: Same batter, different hour, different breakfast.
The first customer's real job is heating the griddle for everyone else.

items.sourceNote: 影印一張只要一元、店家怎麼賺錢的網路討論報導，取影印機本身作為敘事者發想

zh-tw.content:
整條街都覺得我印一張只賺一塊錢，卻沒有人算過我一天要重複同一個動作幾次。

真正讓這間店撐下去的，是那些印壞了不好意思講、默默再按一次的人。

我把同一頁吐出來第三次的時候，旁邊那位同學才發現，原稿本來就是歪的。

歪的東西影印一百份，會得到一百份一樣歪的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容「方向錯了，再努力也只是把錯的東西複製更多份」的情況，交報告季節特別有共鳴。
variations: 印再多份，也修不好原稿上的那條歪線。
重按一次的人，才是養活這台機器的人。

en.content:
The whole block thinks I only earn a cent a page, and nobody has ever counted how many times I repeat the same motion in a day.

What actually keeps this shop alive are the people who ruin a copy, say nothing, and quietly press the button again.

The third time I spat out the same sheet, the student standing beside me finally noticed the original was crooked to begin with.

Copy a crooked thing a hundred times and you get a hundred crooked things.
en.editorNote: For when effort is pointed at the wrong original — you just get more copies of the mistake.
variations: No number of copies will straighten the original.
The people who press the button twice are the ones paying for this machine.

items.sourceNote: 農業部節氣頁面說明處暑代表暑氣終止、但台灣此時高溫仍頻繁，取季節交界的錯位感作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
【商品】立式電風扇一台，三段風速，定時鈕還轉得動。
【使用期間】五月中開機，一路吹到處暑。
【現況】馬達正常，搖頭正常，關掉後扇葉還會自己多轉三圈。
【瑕疵】後蓋是四個月份的灰，擦得掉，擦掉就跟新的一樣。
【降價原因】節氣說暑氣到此為止，今天的溫度沒收到通知。
【備註】買家自取，賣家不負責判斷你需不需要它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合處暑前後、日曆說要轉涼但體感完全沒轉涼的時候發，配一張家裡電扇的照片最好笑。
variations: 日曆換季換得比天氣快。
扇葉關掉還會自己轉三圈，那三圈不算加班。

en.content:
ITEM: One standing floor fan, three speeds, timer knob still turns.
IN SERVICE: Switched on mid-May, ran clean through to the end of summer.
CONDITION: Motor fine, oscillation fine, blades coast three extra turns after you shut it off.
FLAWS: Four months of dust on the back grille. It wipes off, and then it looks brand new.
WHY THE PRICE DROP: The calendar says the heat ends here. Today's temperature did not get the memo.
NOTE: Buyer picks up. Seller will not decide for you whether you still need it.
en.editorNote: For the stretch where the calendar has moved on to autumn and the weather absolutely has not.
variations: The calendar changes seasons faster than the air does.
Those three extra spins after you hit off don't count as overtime.

items.sourceNote: 加油與停車小額發票中獎的報導，取自助加油機不吐紙本發票的處理紀錄作為題材發想

zh-tw.content:
【案號】受理當下產生，與您的問題無關。
【申告內容】自助加油付款成功，發票口沒動靜。
【現場處置】拍兩下沒反應，拍第三下還是同一台機器。
【處理結果】發票已開立，存入載具，紙本不曾存在。
【客戶回應】那我剛剛在等的是什麼。
【結案說明】那張紙在您掃載具那秒就決定不出現。
【滿意度】本問卷以簡訊寄出，時間不定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容「事情早就處理好了，只有你還站在原地等」的荒謬感，載具族應該很懂。
variations: 紙本沒出來，因為它從一開始就不打算出來。
拍第三下，機器還是那台機器。

en.content:
CASE NO.: Generated on intake. Unrelated to your problem.
REPORTED: Self-serve pump charged successfully, receipt slot did nothing.
ON SITE: Two taps, no response. A third tap, still the same machine.
RESOLUTION: Receipt issued and filed to your carrier. The paper copy never existed.
CUSTOMER SAID: Then what have I been standing here waiting for.
CLOSING NOTE: That slip stopped existing the second you scanned your carrier.
SURVEY: Sent by text message. Timing unspecified.
en.editorNote: For the absurdity of waiting on something that was already handled before you started waiting.
variations: The paper never came because it was never coming.
Third tap, same machine.

items.sourceNote: shower-thoughts style observation, fully rewritten into an object monologue set at a Taiwanese breakfast shop griddle

zh-tw.content:
一天被拿起來大概兩百次，每次放回來的位置都差那麼一點，所以整個早上我都在慢慢往鐵板邊緣移動。

上次被裝滿是哪一天沒有人記得，只有搖起來變輕的那個早上才會有人注意到我。

隔壁那罐醬油膏比我高，也比我常被誇獎，可是決定鹹淡的是最後那兩下手腕，而那兩下從來沒有人量過。

十點半以後就沒人再碰我了，我在原地看那塊鐵板慢慢降溫，整間店要到那時候才真的安靜下來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享在講「默默做事的人」或早餐店日常的貼文底下，也很適合當作自嘲式的工作心得。
variations: 被拿起來兩百次，被記得零次。
決定鹹淡的那兩下，從來沒有人量過。

en.content:
I get picked up about two hundred times a morning, and I never land back on the exact same spot, so by ten I've drifted halfway to the edge of the griddle.

Nobody remembers the day I was last refilled. The only morning anyone notices me is the morning I rattle light.

The soy paste bottle next to me is taller and gets far more compliments, though what decides the seasoning is those last two flicks of a wrist, and nobody has ever measured those.

After ten thirty nothing touches me again, and I stand there watching the griddle cool down, which is when the shop finally goes quiet.
en.editorNote: Good for posts about the invisible work that holds a place together, or a self-deprecating note about your own job.
variations: Picked up two hundred times, remembered zero.
Nobody has ever measured the two flicks that decide the taste.

items.sourceNote: everyday-absurdity prompt list; rewritten into an original two-person exchange in a cinema aisle after the credits

zh-tw.content:
「你走這麼慢做什麼。」

「我在等我的腳自己想起來要怎麼走路。」

「片尾都跑完了，走道燈也亮了，你手上那桶爆米花還剩一半。」

「剩下這一半是我兩個小時前買的，那時候我以為我會吃完。現在它比整部電影還難結束。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 看完電影傳給一起去的那個人剛剛好，也適合用在任何「明明結束了卻還沒走出來」的時刻。
variations: 「走道燈亮了。」「我的腳還在等下一幕。」
半桶爆米花，比兩小時的劇情還難收尾。

en.content:
"Why are you walking this slowly?"

"I'm waiting for my legs to remember how walking works."

"The credits finished, the aisle lights are on, and you're still holding half a bucket of popcorn."

"I bought this half two hours ago, back when I thought I'd finish it. Now it's harder to end than the movie was."
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever you saw the film with, or use it for any moment that's technically over and somehow still going.
variations: "Aisle lights are on." "My legs are still waiting for the next scene."
Half a bucket of popcorn, harder to wrap up than the plot.

items.sourceNote: public reading-room rules about temporary-leave holds and auto-released seats; rewritten as an original live-scene piece

zh-tw.content:
三號桌的人離開十九分鐘了，桌上留著一支筆、一件外套，還有一本翻在同一頁的書。

牆上的螢幕正在倒數，跳到三十分鐘的那一刻，那個位子會自動變回綠色，外套會被收去櫃檯。

門口站著兩個人輪流抬頭看螢幕，誰都沒有講話，因為先開口的那個等於承認自己在等。

現在是第二十六分鐘，三號桌的人回來了，坐下，把書翻到下一頁，倒數重新從三十開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前後的自習室日常，也適合形容任何「規則明明寫著，大家還是各憑本事」的場面。
variations: 位子空著不代表沒有主人，只代表倒數還沒跑完。
第二十六分鐘回來的人，把三十分鐘重新買了一次。

en.content:
Desk three has been empty for nineteen minutes, holding one pen, one jacket, and a book still open to the same page.

The screen on the wall is counting down, and the moment it hits thirty the seat flips back to green and the jacket goes to the front desk.

Two people stand near the door taking turns looking up at the screen, neither of them speaking, because whoever speaks first has admitted they're waiting.

Minute twenty-six: the owner of desk three walks back in, sits down, turns to the next page, and the countdown starts over at thirty.
en.editorNote: Study-room life around the start of term, and a fit for any place where the posted rules and the actual system quietly disagree.
variations: An empty seat isn't unclaimed, it's just not done counting down.
Coming back at minute twenty-six buys the whole thirty again.

items.sourceNote: technically-true humor collection; rewritten into an original bystander-reversal scene at a post office counter

zh-tw.content:
二號櫃檯前面那位小姐把箱子放上磅秤，數字停在五點二，她愣了兩秒，又把箱子抱了下來。

她蹲在旁邊那張桌子前拆開膠帶，抽走一包衛生紙，重新黏好，再放上去，這次是四點九。

櫃員說這樣可以了，她鬆一口氣，把那包衛生紙塞進自己的背包，好像剛剛真的省下了什麼。

我抱著我這箱走過去的時候，已經先決定好等一下要先拿出哪一件了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在寄件、行李超重、或任何「為了跨過一條線而臨時做出取捨」的日常時刻。
variations: 五點二跟四點九之間，隔著一包衛生紙。
還沒放上磅秤，我已經知道要犧牲誰了。

en.content:
The woman at counter two sets her box on the scale, watches it settle at 5.2, freezes for two seconds, and lifts it back off.

She crouches at the side table, peels the tape open, pulls out a pack of tissues, seals it again, and puts it back on the scale: 4.9.

The clerk says that works, she exhales, and she tucks the tissues into her own backpack like she just saved something real.

By the time I carry my box over, I've already picked which item is coming out of mine.
en.editorNote: For shipping days, overweight luggage, or any moment where clearing a line means deciding what to sacrifice.
variations: The distance between 5.2 and 4.9 is one pack of tissues.
My box isn't on the scale yet and I already know what's coming out.

items.sourceNote: loyalty-card usage tips article; rewritten as an original set of fine-print redemption terms printed on a breakfast shop card

zh-tw.content:
本卡集滿十格，可兌換冰奶茶中杯一杯。
一、每筆消費滿五十元蓋一格。四十九元不蓋，四十九元再加一顆蛋剛好五十，這是本店被問過最多次的算法。
二、一次蓋兩格的那次不算，那次老闆左手煎蛋餅右手蓋章。
三、兌換限早餐時段，也就是本店有開的時段，而本店只開早餐時段。
四、本卡遺失恕不補發，本店亦無留存紀錄，您蓋到第幾格，全世界只有您知道。
五、兌換後本卡回收，您從零格重新開始，狀態與您第一次推門進來那天完全相同。
六、本辦法如有修改，將直接印在本卡背面。您手上這張是舊的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在店家小卡、會員活動頁面下方的細則區，或任何「規則寫得很清楚但讀完更困惑」的場合。
variations: 本店不記得您蓋到第幾格，所以第幾格這件事，由您自己負責相信。
換到的那一杯會讓您回到零格，也就是回到您還沒開始的那天。

en.content:
Ten stamps on this card earns one medium iced milk tea.
1. One stamp per NT$50 spent. NT$49 earns nothing; add one egg and NT$49 becomes NT$50, which is the question we get asked most.
2. The time you got two stamps at once does not count. The owner was flipping an egg pancake with one hand and stamping with the other.
3. Redemption is limited to breakfast hours, meaning the hours we are open, which are only breakfast hours.
4. Lost cards cannot be replaced and we keep no records. How many stamps you had is known to you alone.
5. The card is collected on redemption and you restart at zero, in the exact condition you were in the first day you walked in.
6. Any changes to these terms will be printed on the back of this card. The one in your hand is the old version.
en.editorNote: Fits the fine-print block on a shop card or a rewards page, or any moment where the rules are stated clearly and explain nothing.
variations: We do not track your stamps, so how many you have is something you get to believe on your own.
The drink you earn returns you to zero, which is where you were before any of this started.

items.sourceNote: forum thread on taxi rides and driver conversation; rewritten into an original outcome-first commute account

zh-tw.content:
我最後是走路到公司的，車錢照跳，收據還在口袋裡。

十分鐘前我坐在後座，窗外那條路的紅色車燈連成一整條，誰都沒有動。

上車那一刻我還很有把握，我說走大路應該比較順，司機點頭，然後真的走了大路。

再更早一點，我站在路口算過一次：走路二十八分鐘，搭車二十分鐘，我選了小的那個數字。

所以我花了兩百塊把那八分鐘買下來，再親手還回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在通勤抱怨、為了省時間反而更花時間、或任何「決策當下很合理、事後看很荒謬」的分享。
variations: 買那八分鐘花了我兩百塊，還回去一毛都不用。
走大路比較順這句話，在大路塞成一團的那天依然成立，只是幫不上忙。

en.content:
I ended up walking to the office. The meter kept running anyway and the receipt is still in my pocket.

Ten minutes before that I was in the back seat, watching the taillights on that road fuse into one long red line that nobody was moving through.

When I got in I was confident. I told the driver the main road usually flows better, he nodded, and he did take the main road.

Earlier still, I stood at the corner and did the math: twenty-eight minutes walking, twenty minutes by car. I picked the smaller number.

So I paid two hundred to buy those eight minutes, then handed them back myself.
en.editorNote: For commute complaints, saving time by losing time, or any decision that made sense right up until it didn't.
variations: Those eight minutes cost two hundred to buy and nothing to give back.
The main road usually flows better stays true on the days it doesn't. It just stops helping.

items.sourceNote: forum post about eulogies and things left unsaid; rewritten into an original two-line exchange with an unspoken third beat

zh-tw.content:
「你姑姑說，你小時候最黏他。」

「還好啦，就一般。」

我皮夾裡那張日曆紙已經摺到快破了，上面是他寫的一組市話號碼。那支電話三年前就沒有人接，可是只要我一直沒有撥，它在我這裡就還算通著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在懷念長輩的貼文、或任何「當場說得很輕、心裡放得很重」的場合。
variations: 一組沒有人接的號碼，只要沒有撥出去，就永遠停在還沒確認的狀態。
我每年換皮夾都會把那張紙先拿出來，再放進新的夾層，然後告訴自己下次再丟。

en.content:
"Your aunt says you followed him everywhere when you were little."

"Not really. About the same as anyone."

The scrap of calendar paper in my wallet is folded soft at the creases, and on it is a landline number in his handwriting. Nobody has answered that line in three years, but as long as I never dial it, on my end it still works.
en.editorNote: For posts remembering someone older, or any moment where the words said out loud weigh far less than the ones that weren't.
variations: A number nobody answers stays unconfirmed as long as you never dial it.
Every time I get a new wallet I move that scrap over first, then tell myself I'll throw it out next time.

items.sourceNote: forum thread about buying a single screw at a small hardware shop; rewritten into an original three-visit repair account

zh-tw.content:
第一次我拿著斷掉的那根過去，老闆瞄了一下，從抽屜抓一根給我，說這種的不用錢。

第二次我學乖了，開口就說六角、三公分、白鐵，他還是瞄了一下，然後給我另外一根。

第三次我把整組東西拆下來抱過去，他這次沒有看我，接過去轉了兩下，說問題不在螺絲，在那塊板子。

所以前兩次我買到的都是對的螺絲，只是一直鎖在錯的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在修東西修到懷疑人生、或任何「做對的事情做了很多次，方向卻一直是錯的」的時刻。
variations: 對的零件裝在錯的位置上，會壞得非常準時。
跑到第三趟才知道，該換的東西從來就沒放在螺絲那一格抽屜裡。

en.content:
The first time I brought the snapped one in, the owner glanced at it, pulled a replacement from a drawer, and said this kind is free.

The second time I came prepared and led with hex head, three centimeters, stainless. He glanced at it anyway and handed me a different one.

The third time I unbolted the whole assembly and carried it in. He didn't look at me at all, turned it over twice, and said the problem isn't the screw, it's that panel.

So both of the screws I bought were the right screws. I had just been putting them in the wrong place.
en.editorNote: For repairs that outlast your patience, or any stretch where you did the correct thing repeatedly in the wrong direction.
variations: The right part in the wrong slot fails right on schedule.
It took three trips to learn the screw was never the thing that needed replacing.

items.sourceNote: PTT thread on how often an apartment block actually washes its water tank; reworked into an original rhetorical-question chain

zh-tw.content:
公告貼出來說這個週末要洗水塔，那在洗之前，這幾年從龍頭流出來的到底是什麼？

洗完放出來的第一桶是黃的，這桶黃的算是洗乾淨的證據，還是還沒洗乾淨的證據？

如果一年洗一次就夠，那第十一個月的水，跟剛洗完那個月的水，是同一種水嗎？

既然大家都同意該洗，為什麼永遠要有人先開口？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在社區群組討論公共維護、或任何「明明每個人都知道該做，卻沒有人要當那個提起的人」的場合。
variations: 沒有人反對洗水塔，只是也沒有人願意當那個提議的人。
水乾不乾淨這件事，好像只有洗的那一天才存在。

en.content:
A notice goes up saying the building's water tank gets cleaned this weekend — so what exactly have we been drinking for the past few years?

If the first bucket after the cleaning comes out yellow, is that yellow the proof it got cleaned, or the proof that it hasn't been?

If once a year is enough, is the water in month eleven the same water as the water in the month it was washed?

And if everyone agrees it needs doing, why does someone always have to be the one to say it out loud?
en.editorNote: For building-group chats about shared maintenance, or any situation where everyone knows a thing needs doing and nobody wants to be the one who says it.
variations: Nobody objects to cleaning the tank. Nobody volunteers to suggest it either.
Whether the water is clean seems to exist only on the day someone cleans it.

items.sourceNote: PTT question thread about switching off the pump during a scheduled water outage; rewritten as an original question chain

zh-tw.content:
施工通知要大家先把抽水馬達關掉，可是關掉之後，水塔裡剩下的那些水算誰的？

如果整棟的人都想著先囤一點，那水是被提早用完，還是本來就會用完？

師傅說水壓自己也上得去，只是很慢——那很慢跟沒有，中間差的是水，還是耐性？

既然天黑以前就會來，我為什麼還是每半個小時去轉一次龍頭？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在停水、跳電、系統維護這類「知道會恢復卻還是一直去確認」的時刻。
variations: 囤水這件事，囤的從來不是水。
會恢復的東西，我們照樣要親手確認過才安心。

en.content:
The outage notice says switch off the pump — but once it's off, who does the water already sitting in the tank belong to?

If every unit decides to stock up first, does the supply run out early, or was it always going to run out?

The plumber says mains pressure gets up there on its own, just slowly — so is the gap between slowly and never made of water, or of patience?

And if it's back before dark, why do I keep going to turn the tap every half hour?
en.editorNote: For water cuts, power cuts, or any scheduled downtime you keep checking on even though you know it will come back.
variations: Stockpiling water was never really about the water.
Things that will fix themselves still need checking by hand, apparently.

items.sourceNote: Taiwanese plumbing guide to float-valve failure and overflowing tanks; reworked into an original rhetorical-question chain

zh-tw.content:
水塔的浮球壞掉那天，水沿著外壁一直往下淌，那到底是它滿了，還是它不知道自己滿了？

一個零件的工作就是叫停自己，它故障的時候，是不是只能表現成停不下來？

師傅說先把桿子上下擺幾下看看，如果擺一擺就好了，那我剛剛煩惱的那三個小時算什麼？

換一顆新的不到兩百塊，我猶豫的真的是那兩百塊嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在拖很久才修的小毛病、或任何「知道自己該停下來卻停不下來」的自嘲場合。
variations: 負責喊停的那個零件壞了，就只會看起來很努力。
兩百塊的東西，我可以想三個小時。

en.content:
The day the tank's float valve gave out, water ran down the outside wall for hours — was the tank full, or did it just not know it was full?

If a part's entire job is telling itself to stop, can its failure look like anything except not stopping?

If the plumber says jiggle the rod a few times first, and jiggling fixes it, what were the three hours I spent worrying about it?

A new one costs less than lunch — so was the money ever the thing I was hesitating over?
en.editorNote: For small repairs you put off for months, or any self-aware moment about knowing you should stop and not stopping.
variations: When the part in charge of stopping breaks, it just looks very hard-working.
I can deliberate for three hours over something that costs six dollars.

items.sourceNote: Liberty Times report on a shared power bank rented in Japan that turned out to carry Taiwanese branding; rewritten as an original question chain

zh-tw.content:
在異國的車站租到一顆共享電源，殼上卻印著看得懂的中文，那這顆東西算是流浪，還是算通勤？

它被丟在哪裡就從哪裡繼續出租，那所謂「還回去」，是還給誰？

租過它的每個人都以為自己只是暫時拿著，可是有誰真的擁有過它？

如果一顆電池的一生就是被充滿再被用光，那我們自稱的自由，跟它差在哪裡？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在共享經濟、跨國旅行的巧合，或任何「東西比人跑得更遠」的感慨。
variations: 共享的意思是，誰都用得到，誰都不必負責。
它去過的地方比我多，可是它沒有一個地方是家。

en.content:
If you rent a shared power bank at a station abroad and the case is printed in the language from home, is this thing travelling or commuting?

If it gets re-rented from wherever the last person left it, who is "returning it" returning it to?

Everyone who rented it assumed they were only holding it for a while — did any of them ever own it?

If a battery's whole life is being filled up and drained again, what exactly makes ours different?
en.editorNote: For the shared economy, odd coincidences while travelling, or any moment when an object has been further than you have.
variations: Shared means everyone gets to use it and nobody has to answer for it.
It has been more places than I have, and not one of them is home.

items.sourceNote: Liberty Times local report on Taipei narrowing drain grate slots from about 2.4-3cm to 0.6cm; reworked into an original question chain

zh-tw.content:
零點六公分，是新款水溝蓋留給雨水的縫；三公分，是舊的那種留給高跟鞋的。

同一條路上兩種蓋子並排躺著，雨走的縫變窄了，那水是變少了，還是只是變慢了？

改過的人說這叫進步，可是鞋跟被吃過一次的人，現在走到哪裡都會先低頭看一眼，她被進步到了嗎？

縫窄到什麼都掉不下去以後，我們還會記得腳下有一整條河嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在公共設施改善、無障礙話題，或任何「問題解決了、習慣卻留下來」的討論串。
variations: 短版：縫補好了，低頭的習慣沒補回去。
延伸版：進步這件事，通常只有還沒被卡過的人感覺得到。

en.content:
Six millimeters is the gap the new drain covers leave for rainwater; three centimeters is what the old ones left for high heels.

Both kinds lie side by side on the same street, and now that the slot is narrower, is there less water, or is it just slower?

The people who swapped them call it progress, but the woman whose heel once went in still looks down at every one of them — has the progress reached her?

Once the gap is too narrow for anything to fall through, will we still remember there is a whole river under our feet?
en.editorNote: For conversations about public infrastructure, accessibility, or any fix that arrives after the habit it caused has already set.
variations: Short version: They closed the gap; nobody closed the habit of looking down.
Extended: Progress is usually only visible to the people it never had to rescue.

items.sourceNote: TVBS report on 5cm street drainage slots catching walking canes and injuring users; rewritten as an original counting-based question chain

zh-tw.content:
從家門口走到市場，要跨過十七面水溝蓋，這個數字是我某天很閒真的數出來的。

數完以後我照樣每一面都跨過去，踩上去其實也不會怎樣，那我到底在閃躲什麼？

有幾面踩下去會「叩」一聲，有幾面不會，會響的那幾面我記得特別清楚，可是我從來沒查過它為什麼響。

一條路上被我最認真對待的，居然是十七個我完全不打算了解的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在通勤路線的小觀察、強迫症式習慣，或任何「熟到不能再熟卻從沒搞懂」的自嘲。
variations: 短版：我熟悉它們的聲音，卻沒問過原因。
延伸版：每天閃躲十七次的東西，其實從來沒有傷害過我。

en.content:
There are seventeen drain covers between my front door and the market, a number I got by actually counting them one very idle afternoon.

I still step over every one of them, even though nothing happens when you step on them — so what am I dodging?

A few of them go clunk under your foot and the rest don't, and I remember exactly which ones make the noise, though I have never once looked up why.

The things I treat most carefully on that street turn out to be seventeen things I have no plans to understand.
en.editorNote: For small commuting rituals, harmless compulsions, or any route you know by heart without knowing anything about it.
variations: Short version: I know their sound and never asked what makes it.
Extended: Seventeen things I dodge daily, none of which has ever hurt me.

items.sourceNote: Yam News report on Kaohsiung's intersection-care program for elderly pedestrians and a 40.5% drop in deaths; reworked into an original question chain

zh-tw.content:
這個路口給行人十八秒，斜前方那位阿伯走到一半，燈就開始閃了。

他沒有跑也沒有停，用原來的速度把剩下的一半走完，好像那個數字跟他沒有任何關係。

把十八秒訂下來的人，量的是誰的腳程？

如果有人走不完，是他太慢，還是這條路從一開始就量錯人了？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在高齡友善、都市設計、或任何「標準是為平均值訂的，可是沒人剛好是平均值」的場合。
variations: 短版：秒數是給會跑的人訂的。
延伸版：走不完的人沒有比較慢，只有比較誠實。

en.content:
This crossing gives pedestrians eighteen seconds, and the old man ahead of me is halfway across when the signal starts flashing.

He doesn't run and he doesn't stop; he walks the second half at exactly the speed he walked the first, as if the number had nothing to do with him.

Whose stride were they measuring when they settled on eighteen?

And if somebody can't finish, is he too slow, or was the street measured against the wrong person from the start?
en.editorNote: For age-friendly design, urban planning gripes, or any standard set to an average that nobody actually is.
variations: Short version: The countdown was written for people who can run.
Extended: The ones who can't make it aren't slower, just more honest about it.

items.sourceNote: Liberty Times 3C report on cross-country screen-time rankings, with Taiwan at 7h14m a day; rewritten as an original question chain

zh-tw.content:
七小時十四分，據說是一個人一天平均盯著會發光的東西的長度。

醒著的時間有四成都花在螢幕上，那剩下的六成，我們到底在看什麼？

我試過把手機放到另一個房間，結果整個下午都在想它有沒有響。

所以被拿走的到底是時間，還是「有沒有人在找我」這件事？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在數位排毒、螢幕使用時間統計出爐時，或任何「戒不掉但也說不出戒什麼」的自嘲。
variations: 短版：放遠一點，反而看得更久。
延伸版：我戒掉的那個東西，其實叫做「有人在找我」。

en.content:
Seven hours and fourteen minutes is, apparently, how long the average person spends each day staring at something that glows.

That's about four-tenths of the hours we're awake — so what are we looking at during the other six?

I tried leaving my phone in another room once, and spent the entire afternoon wondering whether it had buzzed.

So what actually got taken, the time, or the question of whether anyone is looking for me?
en.editorNote: For digital detox attempts, the annual screen-time report, or any habit you can't quit and can't quite name either.
variations: Short version: Put it further away and you'll look at it longer.
Extended: What I was giving up was the chance that someone wanted me.

items.sourceNote: vocus write-up of the FamilyMart x Chuka Ichiban collaboration dishes whose lettering only surfaces after sauce is poured in; reworked into an original two-hearings piece

zh-tw.content:
外婆把那個要倒醬油才會浮出字的醬油碟收進櫥櫃最上面一層，只交代了一句「這個不要拿出來用」。

表弟收到的意思是碟子有紀念價值、破了就補不回來；我收到的意思是每沾一次就要笑一次，一頓飯會拖到菜都涼掉。

那天晚上她自己倒了一點進去，字浮起來，她端到燈下端詳，又端回桌上放好。

碟子到今天還在最上面那一層，兩個意思也還在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在家裡那種捨不得用的餐具、限量聯名周邊，或任何「一句交代被兩個人各自收好」的場合。
variations: 短版：一句交代，兩個人各自收到一個版本。
延伸版：那個碟子沒被用過，可是兩種用法都被記住了。

en.content:
Grandma put the dish whose lettering only surfaces once you pour sauce into it on the very top shelf of the cabinet, with a single instruction: don't take this one out.

What my cousin received was that the dish is a keepsake and a broken one can never be replaced; what I received was that every dip turns into a laugh and dinner drags on until the food goes cold.

That evening she poured a little in herself, watched the letters rise, carried it over to the lamp to look, then carried it back and set it down.

The dish is still on that top shelf today, and so are both meanings.
en.editorNote: For the dishes at home nobody is allowed to use, limited-run collab merch, or any one-line instruction two people each file away their own way.
variations: Short version: One instruction, two people, two versions filed away.
Extended: The dish never got used, and both ways of using it got remembered.

items.sourceNote: Global Views Health chart ranking sodium in 20 common seasonings, with soy sauce near 5,000 mg per 100 g against a 2,400 mg daily ceiling; rewritten as an original piece

zh-tw.content:
同事點完餐補了一句「我的醬油碟先不用給我」，這句話一落地，整桌就分成兩邊。

一邊收到的是他在算鈉，一百公克醬油大約五千毫克，一個成年人一天的上限也才兩千四；另一邊收到的是他嫌那家店的醬料台永遠設在最遠的角落。

他自己給的說法是那盤東西還沒上，碟子先擺著也是擺著。

三個版本在同一頓飯裡並排放好，沒有人開口問哪一個要留下來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在減鈉、健檢紅字後的聚餐，或任何「一句客氣話被全桌各自翻譯」的討論。
variations: 短版：一句客氣話，一桌人翻出三個版本。
延伸版：他要的只是不要現在拿，其餘都是我們自己加上去的。

en.content:
A coworker finished ordering and added, hold off on the sauce dish for me — and the moment it landed, the table split in two.

One side received it as sodium math, since soy sauce runs about 5,000 milligrams per 100 grams and an adult's daily ceiling is 2,400; the other side received it as a complaint about a condiment counter parked in the farthest corner of the shop.

His own account was that his plate hadn't arrived yet, so an empty dish would just be sitting there either way.

Three versions sat side by side through the whole meal, and nobody asked which one we were keeping.
en.editorNote: For low-sodium resolutions, the dinner after a bad checkup, or any polite half-sentence a whole table translates for itself.
variations: Short version: One polite half-sentence, one table, three translations.
Extended: All he wanted was not right now; the rest of it we added ourselves.

items.sourceNote: Heho nutrition explainer on brewed versus chemically hydrolyzed soy sauce and how to read the label; reworked into an original two-hearings piece

zh-tw.content:
我爸在賣場把兩瓶醬油翻到背面比成分，最後把貴的那瓶放進推車，只說了五個字：這種才叫醬油。

我媽接到的版本是他覺得便宜那瓶對身體不好；我姊接到的版本是他又在展示自己看得懂標示上的釀造兩個字。

他把兩瓶的背標都拍了照，回家以後誰也沒有再提起這件事。

五個字出了賣場，變成兩件毫不相干的事，被帶走的醬油只有一瓶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在採買比價、家人各自解讀的日常，或任何「一句短話被家裡分成好幾種意思」的場合。
variations: 短版：五個字，出了店門就變成兩件事。
延伸版：他拍了照片，卻沒有再跟任何人說那張照片要幹嘛。

en.content:
At the store my dad flipped two bottles of soy sauce around to compare labels, dropped the expensive one into the cart, and said five words: this is what soy sauce means.

The version my mom got was that he thought the cheap bottle was bad for you; the version my sister got was that he was showing off being able to find the word brewed on a label.

He photographed the back of both bottles, and once we were home nobody brought it up again.

Five words left the store and became two unrelated things, and only one bottle came home.
en.editorNote: For grocery-aisle price comparisons, families who each decode the same remark differently, or any short line that splits into several meanings on the way home.
variations: Short version: Five words, and by the door they were two different things.
Extended: He took the photos and never told anyone what they were for.

items.sourceNote: SETN feature on the southern Taiwanese way of eating black persimmon tomatoes with a ginger-and-soy dipping sauce; rewritten as an original piece

zh-tw.content:
台南朋友端上一盤切好的黑柿番茄，旁邊擱了一個醬油碟，裡頭是薑泥、糖粉和醬油調出來的。

第一次吃到的人聽見「要這樣才對」，接到的是番茄本來就該配這個吃；主人講那句的時候，講的是要沾滿再翻面，不然醬會全部沉在碟底。

一整盤番茄被兩種吃法分著吃完了，碟子裡最後一滴也沒剩。

同一句話、同一個碟子，兩邊都吃對了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在南北飲食差異、外地朋友第一次上桌，或任何「同一句指示被兩種人各自照做」的閒聊。
variations: 短版：同一句話，兩種吃法，同一個碟子。
延伸版：那句指示講的是動作，被聽成的是規矩，最後盤子一樣空。

en.content:
A friend from Tainan brought out a plate of sliced black persimmon tomatoes with a small dish beside it, filled with grated ginger, powdered sugar, and soy sauce.

The first-timer heard you have to do it this way and received it as a rule about what tomatoes are supposed to be eaten with; what our host meant, saying it, was coat the slice and flip it, or the sauce all settles at the bottom.

The whole plate got finished two different ways, and not a drop was left in the dish.

Same sentence, same dish, both sides did it right.
en.editorNote: For north-south food debates, a guest's first time at the table, or any single instruction two people follow correctly in different ways.
variations: Short version: One sentence, two ways of eating, one dish between them.
Extended: The instruction was about a motion and got heard as a rule, and the plate came back empty either way.

items.sourceNote: 591 News piece on everyday props for a home handover check, including using a level to see whether door and window frames sit true; reworked into an original question-ending piece

zh-tw.content:
師傅把水平儀壓在門框上，氣泡往右邊靠了半格，他說這種程度不用處理。

我問他半格是多少，他想了一下，說大概就是門合起來以後你不會注意到的那麼多。

那支水平儀在他的工具袋裡放了十一年，中間沒有拿去校正過。

所以偏掉的到底是這個門框，還是那顆從十一年前就沒有被扶正過的氣泡？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在裝潢驗收、工具保養話題，或任何「負責量的那個東西，自己沒有被量過」的場合。
variations: 短版：量門框的那支尺，十一年沒有人量過它。
延伸版：他說不用處理的那半格，是門框給的還是尺給的？

en.content:
The installer pressed his level against the door frame, watched the bubble settle half a mark to the right, and said that much doesn't need fixing.

I asked how much half a mark was, and after a pause he said it's about as much as you won't notice once the door is shut.

That level had been riding in his tool bag for eleven years, and it had never gone back for calibration.

So which one is off here, this door frame, or a bubble nobody has set straight since eleven years ago?
en.editorNote: For handover inspections, tool maintenance talk, or any time the thing doing the measuring has never been measured itself.
variations: Short version: The tool that measured the door frame hasn't been measured in eleven years.
Extended: That half a mark he waved off — did it come from the frame or from the tool?

items.sourceNote: Courcasa explainer on how the trade uses 順平 and 抓水平 for floors with no agreed definition between them; rewritten as an original question-ending piece

zh-tw.content:
彈珠一放上去就往同一個牆角滾，我連續放了三顆，三顆都停在踢腳板旁邊。

驗屋的人蹲下來把水平儀貼在地板上，說這個落差還在容許範圍裡，磁磚本來就做不到完全平。

我們兩個人看著那三顆彈珠擠在同一個角落，沒有人先把它們撿起來。

容許範圍是誰量出來的，是尺上面的刻度，還是這三顆一直往同一邊滾的彈珠？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在交屋現場、地板順平與抓水平的爭議，或任何「標準說可以、東西說不行」的場合。
variations: 短版：刻度說在範圍內，彈珠說在角落。
延伸版：那三顆彈珠沒有讀過容許範圍，還是滾到同一邊。

en.content:
The marble rolled toward the same corner the moment I set it down, and all three I tried came to rest against the baseboard.

The inspector crouched, laid his level flat on the floor, and said the drop was still within tolerance, since tile is never perfectly flat to begin with.

The two of us watched those three marbles crowd into the same corner, and neither of us picked them up first.

Who worked out that tolerance — the marks along the tool, or three marbles that keep rolling the same way?
en.editorNote: For handover day, arguments over how level a floor has to be, or any time the standard says fine and the object says otherwise.
variations: Short version: The scale says within tolerance; the marbles say the corner.
Extended: Nobody read the tolerance table to those marbles, and they still rolled the same way.

items.sourceNote: Tohatsu hardware catalogue page describing bubble, digital, pocket and magnetic levels and what each is used to true up; reworked into an original question-ending piece

zh-tw.content:
那幅畫掛上去的第一個禮拜，每個進門的人都說左邊高了一點。

我把左邊調低，來的人換成說右邊高；調回去之後，最早說左邊高的那個人剛好出國三個月。

它現在停在一個所有人都沒有意見的位置，而那個位置我調了七次才調到。

那七次裡面，有沒有哪一次它其實是正的？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在佈置爭議、一群人審美意見打架，或任何「調到大家閉嘴不等於調對了」的討論。
variations: 短版：調到沒有人有意見，跟調正是兩件事。
延伸版：畫最後停下來的地方，是大家講累的地方。

en.content:
For the first week after that painting went up, everyone who walked in said the left side was a little high.

I lowered the left, and the next visitors said the right was high; I put it back, and the person who first said left happened to leave the country for three months.

It now hangs at a position nobody has an opinion about, and it took me seven adjustments to land there.

Out of those seven, was there one where it was actually straight?
en.editorNote: For decorating debates, too many opinions in one room, or any fix that ended when people stopped complaining rather than when it was right.
variations: Short version: Nobody complaining and actually straight are two different things.
Extended: The painting stopped where the comments ran out.

items.sourceNote: SKCIC guide on adjusting a circular bubble vial by turning the instrument 180 degrees and correcting half the observed offset; rewritten as an original question-ending piece

zh-tw.content:
五金行老闆說水平儀要定期校正，量完把它轉一百八十度再量一次，兩次讀數的差距一半就是誤差。

我把家裡那支轉了一圈，氣泡在兩個方向停在不同的位置，差了大約一格。

它從被買回來到那天為止，量過一個書架、兩片層板和一台冰箱，全部都判定是正的。

那三樣東西現在還在原來的地方，要重新量的是它們，還是這支剛剛才被抓到會偏的尺？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在工具保養、量測誤差，或任何「一直說沒問題的那一方，自己從來沒被檢查過」的場合。
variations: 短版：轉一百八十度，尺自己承認差了一格。
延伸版：它判定過的東西都沒有動，動搖的是判定。

en.content:
The hardware store owner said a level needs regular calibration: take a reading, spin it a hundred and eighty degrees, take another, and half the gap between them is your error.

I turned the one at home around, and the bubble settled in a different spot each way, off by about one mark.

Between the day it was bought and that afternoon, it had checked a bookshelf, two shelf boards, and a refrigerator, and had called every one of them straight.

All three are still where they were, so which gets measured again, them, or the tool that just got caught leaning?
en.editorNote: For tool maintenance, measurement error, or any time the one who kept saying it's fine had never been checked.
variations: Short version: Turn it around and the tool admits it's a mark off.
Extended: Nothing it approved has moved; the approval has.

items.sourceNote: National Cultural Memory Bank collection record for a 竹簍, a woven bamboo container early Taiwanese farm households used to hold crops; reworked into an original two-timepoint piece

zh-tw.content:
民國七十幾年，阿公在竹簍的底板上用油性筆寫了三個字：裝地瓜。

那三個字被地瓜磨掉了一半，剩下一個裝字，還有半個地字。

它放在倉庫門邊，裡面疊著另外兩個一模一樣的竹簍。

一個東西只要還裝得下東西，它就還是一個裝東西的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在老物件的用途討論、倉庫整理，或任何「功能還在、標示已經看不清楚」的場合。
variations: 短版：底板上的字被它裝過的東西磨掉了，它還在裝。
延伸版：字磨掉了，用途沒磨掉，因為用途從來就不寫在底板上。

en.content:
Back in the seventies my grandfather took a marker to the base board of the bamboo basket and wrote three characters on it: holds sweet potatoes.

Sweet potatoes have since rubbed half of those characters away, leaving the word holds and the top half of one more.

It sits by the storeroom door with two identical bamboo baskets stacked inside it.

As long as a thing can still hold things, it is still a thing that holds things.
en.editorNote: For talking about old tools, cleaning out storage, or any time the function survives long after the label stops being readable.
variations: Short version: The label was worn off by the things it held, and it still holds things.
Extended: The writing wore away and the use did not, because the use was never in the writing.

items.sourceNote: National Taiwan Craft Research and Development Institute entry on bamboo weaving, noting that farm and fishery containers are woven from thicker, hard-wearing strips; rewritten as an original two-timepoint piece

zh-tw.content:
那個竹簍剛編好的時候，篾片還會刮手，阿嬤下田都拿一塊布把提把纏起來。

纏了三十年，提把被磨得比布還滑，布先破掉，總共換過四次。

上個月它被掛到牆上，旁邊貼了一張手寫卡片，寫著這是農家用來裝東西的器具。

它掛在那裡的用途，就是讓看到的人知道它是一個用來裝東西的器具。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在老農具展示、家裡的東西被當成擺設，或任何「東西退休以後改行證明自己」的場合。
variations: 短版：它掛在牆上的工作，是證明它會工作。
延伸版：布換過四次，提把一次都沒換，最後被留下來的是提把。

en.content:
When that bamboo basket was newly woven the split strips still scratched, so my grandmother wrapped a strip of cloth around the handle before heading out to the field.

Thirty years of wrapping later the handle is smoother than the cloth, and the cloth was the part that wore through, four times over.

Last month it went up on a wall with a handwritten card beside it saying this is a farm tool for carrying things.

Its job up on that wall is to let anyone who sees it know that it is a tool for carrying things.
en.editorNote: For farm tool displays, household objects that got promoted to decoration, or anything that retired into proving what it used to do.
variations: Short version: Its job on the wall is proving that it can do a job.
Extended: The cloth was replaced four times, the handle never once, and the handle is what got kept.

items.sourceNote: Cyberisland feature comparing early Taiwanese farm work and yard life with today's methods; reworked into an original two-timepoint piece

zh-tw.content:
門口那把竹掃把買回來的第一天，掃完一次院子，地上多了一層它自己掉的竹屑。

它掃了十二年，院子每次都乾淨，竹屑也每次都有。

它剩下半把的那天，掃出來的竹屑終於變少了。

一把會掉屑的掃把要掃到不掉屑，就得先掃到沒有屑可以掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在耗材、器具壽命，或任何「解決問題的東西本身就是問題來源」的討論。
variations: 短版：掃把掃掉的東西裡面，有一部分是掃把。
延伸版：它掃得越久院子越乾淨，它也越短。

en.content:
